title: Graduate Materials Joining Engineer
description:
About us

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

What you'll join

Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you?

If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance ground breaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come.

What you'll do

  • Support the development and delivery of welding, joining and manufacturing solutions for fusion projects, working with design teams, suppliers and inspection specialists to help ensure technical, quality and regulatory requirements are met.
  • Contribute to project execution and continuous improvement activities, including preparing technical documentation, specifications and reports, coordinating procurement and manufacturing activities, monitoring quality standards, and helping to resolve non-conformances.
  • Build expertise in welding and joining technologies, gaining experience in qualification and inspection processes, participating in design reviews, external visits and outreach activities, and working in line with UKAEA quality, health, safety and inclusion principles.

How you'll develop

On the graduate scheme here at the UK Atomic Energy Authority, you will have 20% of your time focused on professional and personal development. This will include a series of core development activities to fast track your business acumen, along with skills for technical, project management and people leadership.

The remaining 80% of time is role-based, working within a team growing your technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. Working with your line manager, you will get the opportunity to experience different roles and responsibilities within projects to broaden your understanding and help decide your future career route.

What you'll need

  • Degree in Science or Engineering from 2025 to 2027.
  • Driven, with a strong appetite to learn and take on new challenges.
  • Able to collaborate effectively and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Well organised and adaptable with the ability to plan and prioritise workload.

Benefits

We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include:

  • £35,227 base salary.
  • Final salary defined benefit scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution.
  • 25 days annual leave, plus 3 days Christmas closure and 2.5 privilege days, in addition to UK bank holidays.
  • Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions.
  • Take part in our Skern Lodge residential to develop new skills and build your network.

Our commitment to ED&I

UKAEA’s mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce. We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, while ensuring all appointments are made on merit.

UK Atomic Energy Authority is committed to being accessible. Please email earlycareerstalent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require any help or adjustments.

AI may be used for preparation purposes only. All responses submitted during interviews and assessments must be your own work.

To maintain a fair recruitment process, candidates are limited to two applications across our Early Careers programmes. If you apply for multiple roles, we may contact you to discuss which opportunities best match your skills and interests.

Applications are due to close at 23:59 on 8th November 2026. As we're expecting strong interest, we encourage you to apply early, as the vacancy may close sooner if we receive a high volume of applications. More information can be found here.

title: Cadet Technician Programme - UAE Nationals Only
description:
Ready to take your career to new heights? Dream big, fly higher, join Etihad.

As the proud national airline of the UAE, we are committed to empowering the next generation of leaders.

The Etihad Cadet Technician Programme offers UAE Nationals the opportunity to launch a career with one of the world’s fastest-growing airlines. This hands-on training programme will not only equip you with the technical expertise needed to succeed, but also provide you with the opportunity to collaborate, challenge yourself, and develop as a future leader in our industry.

What to expect

We are offering a dynamic and rewarding two-year training and development programme, designed to launch your aviation career and prepare you for progression to become a Licensed Aircraft Technician. The combination of theoretical knowledge and on-the-job training will provide you with practical experience in the field and prepare you to take on responsibilities across all areas of aircraft maintenance, covering a range of aircraft types.

What you will achieve

  • Enroll for a recognised Aviation Maintenance training programme and complet the GCAA-approved aircraft maintenance technician course.
  • Gain practical on the job experience under supervision and gain the necessary 12 months of experience to qualify for the grant of GCAA license and Aircraft maintenance certification Authorisation.
  • Obtain the CAT A license from GCAA
  • Obtain the aircraft maintenance certification authorisation
  • Graduate as licensed Aircraft Technician.

Accountabilities

  • Complete the GCAA approved training syllabus and Training programme requirements.
  • Maintain an overall 75% pass rate of all Modules Exams in the stipulated times.
  • Comply with performance requirements set by GCAA, Training Institute and the Company.
  • Complete on-the-job training within assigned timeline post theory qualification.
  • Diligently execute and complete Schedule of Work (logbook) with the tasks assigned.
  • Successfully attend and pass scheduled mandatory training in accordance with Etihad Airways Policy.
  • Participate and successfully pass the Technical staff competency Assessments whenever assigned.
  • Ensure that all work performed at Etihad and completed in accordance with its processes and procedures is done in a safe manner in conformance with the company's procedures, and in compliance with the applicable GCAA regulations.
  • Carry out work in compliance with company, health and safety and airport procedures and regulations.
  • Keep yourself updated with the applicable regulation amendments, company procedures and the latest maintenance best practices.
  • Be responsible of own work after having completed a task that has been performed in accordance with approved data as assigned by Certifying Staff.

Why choose Etihad?

At Etihad, we’re committed to developing the next generation of aviation leaders. With world-class training, mentorship, and on the job experience, you’ll gain the experience and skills needed to thrive in a dynamic industry.

  • Are a UAE national with a valid family book
  • Are between 18 and 29 years old
  • Have a high school certificate or equivalent, including Maths/Physics/Science with a 60% overall score
  • Have a strong command of the English language
  • Have completed or been permanently exempted from UAE National Service (males only)

Etihad is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation through the next generation of Emirati talent. From our home in Abu Dhabi, we are building meaningful career pathways that empower UAE Nationals to grow, lead and make a lasting impact across our airline. As part of our Journey 2030 ambition, we’re investing in the development of future leaders who will help define the next chapter of Etihad and the aviation industry. Join us and take your place in shaping the future.

To learn more visit

Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. title: Industrial Machine Assembly - 1st Shift
description:

title: Landscaper – Property Management
description:
About the Role

We're hiring a Landscaper to take ownership of the grounds across our Milwaukee properties. This is primarily a grounds and landscaping role, with a smaller share of your time supporting our Cleaning Technician on move-out turnover tasks — and backing them up entirely when they're out.

This is a full-time, field-based position, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with seasonal adjustments for snow removal coverage. You'll be moving between all five of our Milwaukee properties regularly, working closely with our Cleaning Technician counterpart, and reporting directly to Brittany, our Property Services Manager.

What You'll Do

  • Own the day-to-day appearance of the grounds at all five properties — this is your territory
  • Mow, edge, and maintain lawns on a consistent schedule
  • Pull weeds and keep landscaped beds clean and maintained
  • Walk each property regularly to pick up trash and debris before it accumulates
  • Handle snow and ice removal from walkways, entrances, and common areas during winter months, working alongside the rest of the snow crew — this isn't a solo job
  • Flag any larger grounds or exterior issues (irrigation, fencing, trees) to Brittany
  • Assist with move-out cleanouts — removing abandoned furniture and bulk items left behind
  • Change locks and rekey units as part of the turnover process
  • Support move-out and turn timelines when the Cleaning Technician needs an extra set of hands
  • Backup coverage: you and our Cleaning Technician cover for each other. If they're out sick or running behind, we'll need you to step in on cleaning tasks — including stove and fridge cleans — so things don't fall behind. It's part of how the two roles support each other.

Who This Role Is For

Strong fit if you:

  • Genuinely enjoy landscaping and grounds work, not just tolerate it
  • Take ownership of an area and keep it consistently sharp
  • Are reliable, show up on time, and don't need to be reminded twice
  • Can step up and cover a cleaning task when your teammate is out, without complaint

Not a Fit For You

  • Are looking for a repair/maintenance technician or renovation role
  • Want a role that's entirely cleaning-focused — that's our Cleaning Technician position

Qualifications

  • Valid driver's license and reliable personal vehicle (required — you'll be moving between properties daily)
  • Personal cell phone for daily coordination and photo documentation (required)
  • Hands-on landscaping or grounds-keeping experience preferred
  • Comfortable with physical, outdoor work in all seasons, including snow removal
  • Reliable and on time, every day — this role depends on it, since the backup system only works if both people show up
  • Willing to step into cleaning tasks when needed to cover for your counterpart
  • Authorized to work in the United States
  • A strong plus: experience in property management or multifamily grounds maintenance, or experience operating landscaping equipment

Pay

  • $16/hour to start
  • $18/hour automatically after your first 90 days
  • Monthly gas stipend for travel between properties

Benefits & Growth

  • Full benefits package (medical, dental, vision)
  • Generous PTO — above industry average
  • Uniform, tools, and equipment provided
  • Hands-on training and room to grow as our portfolio expands

A Final Note

We're a small, growing company that takes care of our people. We hire carefully because we want this to be a long-term fit — not a revolving door. If you take pride in your work and show up consistently, you'll thrive here.

Apply now!

  • Define, implement and sustain hardened security baselines across Windows, macOS, mobile devices, browsers and productivity platforms, aligned to the Essential Eight, CIS benchmarks and Rest standards.

title: Medical Laboratory Scientist – Hematology, Full-Time, Evenings
description:
The Medical Laboratory Scientist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A Medical Laboratory Scientist performs test procedures in a clinical laboratory and conveys the results to the physician or designee in an accurate and timely manner for the purpose of patient diagnosis and treatment

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Technical responsibilities:
  • Performs all aspects of pre-analytic workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure orders are entered correctly, specimens collected are appropriate for the test ordered and are correctly processed/transported.
  • Verifies order where necessary
  • Verifies non-patient information (e.g., collection time) according to established protocol.
  • Handles unresolved orders, troubleshoots where needed.
  • Verifies with physicians and/or nurses prior to laboratory information system (LIS) order entry to resolve unclear, duplicate or otherwise ambiguous orders.
  • Verifies specimens for add-on tests are available and acceptable and generates add-on test orders.
  • Recognizes when fraud and abuse compliance issues require adjustments to the test order
  • Collecting, receiving and processing of specimens:
  • Verifies specimens are correctly and completely labeled upon receipt. Evaluates specimens for appropriateness and takes necessary corrective action. Appropriately documents unacceptable specimens and proper notifications as needed.
  • Prioritizes specimen processing based on established priorities.
  • Aliquots specimens according to established protocols.
  • Performs all aspects of analytical testing appropriate for the specific laboratory section,following established written protocols and standard operating procedures (SOP)
  • Maintains test system integrity:
  • Performs preventive maintenance on instruments/equipment in a timely fashion according to defined schedule.
  • Verifies reagents and supplies meet defined acceptability criteria upon receipt and prior to use; takes action to ensure unacceptable items are removed from use.
  • Ensures that sufficient reagents and supplies necessary for test performance are available. Notifies senior staff when minimum inventory level is encountered.
  • Performs and records all necessary quality control (QC) required for test system performance.
  • Evaluates QC results and takes necessary corrective actions according to established protocol.
  • Performs specimen preparation:
  • Performs any necessary pretest specimen preparation according to protocols (e.g., microbiology plating, cell cultures, filtering, extraction, separation, elution, absorption, etc.)
  • Transfers or ships specimens to approved testing locations according to SOPs
  • Performs tests:
  • Prioritizes testing based on assignment or established priorities, completes testing within defined turn-around-times (TAT).
  • Recognizes the need for and follows any age-specific protocols
  • Responds effectively to changes in the workflow by coordinating a simultaneous series of tests when needed or adjusting work to incorporate STAT tests or fluctuations in work volume.
  • Monitors daily workflow and priorities to assure meeting service levels.
  • Performs technical review and interpretation:
  • Reviews results for completeness, correctness, and consistency within defined test system
  • Evaluates test results/reactions and provides accurate interpretations as appropriate to include correlation with, and integration of, other patient data as necessary.
  • Performs visual interpretation/identifications as appropriate.
  • Recognizes unusual test results/interpretations and completes indicated reflex testing or other follow-up actions.
  • Follows established notification protocols for critical values, phone/fax/e-mail results requests, abnormalities.
  • Troubleshoots and solves problems:
  • Recognizes test system performance problems and takes necessary corrective actions
  • Recognizes when unresolved problems need to be escalated and takes necessary follow-up action.
  • Prints pending logs and follows-up to ensure pending tests are completed or cancelled when appropriate.
  • Post-test specimen storage:
  • Stores specimens and related materials (blood, slides, tissues, etc.) according to protocols for location and duration.
  • Retrieves specimen and related materials when needed
  • Post-analytical responsibilities:
  • Performs all aspects of the post-analytical workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure accurate results are reported within established time frames, specimens are retained appropriately, test results and/or current status are available upon inquiry, and billed charges are correct for testing performed.
  • Verifies and reports results:
  • Verifies results according to procedure.
  • Performs computer functions necessary for releasing results.
  • Generates written reports according to established protocol.
  • Reviews electronic or printed reports when applicable, recognizes problems and escalates according to protocol.
  • Amends reports:
  • Corrects erroneous reports and amends reports according to procedure
  • Responds to inquiries:
  • Responds to requests for information according to established protocol for confidentiality and release of information
  • Recognizes when unresolved inquiries need to be escalated and takes action
  • Stores documents and records:
  • Stores documents and records according to established protocol.
  • Charge capture/billing:
  • Performs billing and/or enter credits for tests and services when applicable.
  • Recognizes billing problems and escalates accordingly
  • Universal responsibilities:
  • Ensures quality of operations:
  • Follows written standard operating procedures (SOP).
  • Operates instruments/equipment according to protocol.
  • Uses computers according to established protocol; follows downtime procedures as required.
  • Performs required quality system responsibilities
  • Meets proficiency and competency standards of the department.
  • Participates in the training of new employees and students
  • Performs operational review of new SOPs.
  • Participates in new test development, validations and implementation.
  • Attends at least one personal development session per year
  • Performs other duties as assigned, or as needed, to ensure continued quality operations
  • Ensures safety of operations:
  • Follows all required safety procedures, uses personal protective equipment (PPE) appropriate for tasks performed.
  • Maintains cleans and organized work area
  • Provides service excellence:
  • Answers telephone when needed, using NM telephone etiquette
  • Maintains patient confidentiality including protected health information (PHI)
  • Assists patients, visitors and other contacts whenever need occurs

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Technology, Medical Laboratory Science, Clinical Laboratory Science, Chemistry, Biology, or Allied Health qualifying the applicant to take the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or equivalent certification examination.
  • License/Certification and Regulatory Agency
  • General MLS or MT (ASCP) Certification or eligible or
  • Categorical BB, C, H or M (ASCP) Certification or eligible
  • If hired after 1/19/2025 must be ASCP certified (or equivalent certification) within one year of employment

title: Captain - A330
description:
It’s an exciting time to join Etihad. We continue to grow at pace, with our network expanding, new aircraft joining the fleet, and ambitious plans to double our fleet by 2030. As one of the world’s fastest-growing airlines, we’re investing in our people, our operations, and the future of aviation.

As a Captain, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the next chapter of our growth, leading one of the world’s youngest and most modern fleets while upholding the highest standards of safety, professionalism, and operational excellence. Based in Abu Dhabi, you’ll enjoy a vibrant lifestyle, tax-free salary, comprehensive benefits, concessionary travel, and outstanding opportunities to develop your career, including leadership, training, fleet management, and wider Flight Operations roles.

What we offer

Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589) per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits:

  • Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children
  • Income protection scheme
  • 42 days of annual leave
  • Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad’s exclusive discounts
  • End-of-service benefits
  • Accidental and life insurance coverage
  • Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world

The Role

As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad’s highest standards of professionalism.

  • Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times
  • Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown
  • Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management
  • Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies
  • Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad’s commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction

What you'll bring

To be considered for the role of Captain A330, you must meet the criteria below:

  • A minimum of 7000 hours total flying time.
  • A minimum of 2500 PIC hours as commander.
  • A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on type.
  • Flown A330 within the last 12 months
  • Type rating on A330 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining
  • Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL
  • Current on A330
  • Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical
  • Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining
  • Current TRE/TRI is an advantage
  • English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher
  • In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world’s most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we’re creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.

To learn more visit

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Contract Closeout Specialist
description:
BryceTech is seeking a Contract Closeout Specialist to support SZK within the U.S. Space Force by managing the final closeout of assigned Government contracts. This position ensures contractual end items have been delivered, inspected, and accepted, and that all outstanding administrative, financial, and reporting actions are resolved before recommending contracts for closeout. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Government contract administration, closeout documentation, compliance requirements, and coordination with contracting officers, program managers, finance personnel, and other stakeholders to ensure contracts are properly and efficiently closed in accordance with applicable regulations and procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Perform final closeout reviews of assigned Government contracts to verify that all contractual requirements and obligations have been satisfied
  • Confirm delivery, inspection, and acceptance of contractual end items and ensure supporting documentation is complete
  • Verify that all administrative, financial, property, deliverable, and reporting actions have been resolved before recommending contract closeout
  • Review contract files, modifications, invoices, payment records, deliverable documentation, and other supporting records for completeness and accuracy
  • Identify outstanding contractual actions, documentation gaps, discrepancies, and unresolved issues that could delay closeout
  • Coordinate with contracting officers, contract specialists, program managers, finance personnel, contractors, and other stakeholders to resolve open items
  • Track contract closeout status, outstanding requirements, milestones, and suspense dates to support timely completion
  • Prepare closeout documentation, checklists, status reports, and recommendations in accordance with applicable Government requirements and organizational procedures
  • Ensure contract records are properly organized, documented, and maintained in accordance with applicable records management and retention requirements
  • Apply relevant Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) requirements, agency procedures, contract terms, and organizational policies to closeout activities
  • Communicate closeout risks, discrepancies, and recommended corrective actions to appropriate Government and program leadership
  • Maintain accurate tracking systems and provide regular updates on closeout progress, issues, and completion status
  • Support process improvements that increase the accuracy, consistency, and efficiency of contract closeout activities
  • Manage multiple assigned contracts and competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and compliance with established procedures
  • Active DoW Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility (TS/SCI)
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, contract management, finance, accounting, acquisition, or a related field
  • Three to ten years of relevant experience in Government contracting, contract administration, contract closeout, acquisition support, or a related field
  • Demonstrated expertise in performing final closeout reviews of assigned contracts, including verifying delivery, inspection, and acceptance of contractual end items and confirming that all administrative and reporting actions have been resolved before recommending closeout
  • Experience reviewing contract files and supporting documentation to verify that contractual requirements, deliverables, and obligations have been satisfied
  • Experience identifying, tracking, and resolving outstanding contract actions, documentation deficiencies, financial discrepancies, and other issues that may prevent contract closeout
  • Familiarity with applicable Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) requirements, Government contract administration procedures, and contract closeout practices
  • Experience coordinating with contracting officers, contract specialists, program managers, finance personnel, contractors, and other stakeholders to complete closeout actions
  • Ability to review contractual and financial documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple contracts, track suspense dates, and meet established deadlines
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook, and the ability to maintain accurate contract tracking records
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document findings, communicate outstanding requirements, and provide clear closeout recommendations
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and support mission requirements in a structured Government contracting environment

Position is contingent upon contract award.

BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Histology Lab Assistant, Surgical Pathology Full-Time Days
description:
The Histology Lab Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Histology Lab Assistant provides support to the histology and surgical pathology laboratory with entry-level histology tasks related to specimen processing and routine preparation of surgical and autopsy microscopic slides. This position is responsible for communication with pathologists, residents, and coordinators regarding specimen problems. The position is also required to participate in the laboratory occurrence management program.

Responsibilities:

  • Provides histology laboratory support using automation and manual methods to stain and coverslip microscopic slides. Labels slides, collates with paperwork, and submits to appropriate pathologist or resident. Documents appropriate tracking information. Submits slides and protocols to appropriate resident, pathologist, or staff.
  • Reviews protocol files for Gross Only specimens and/or outstanding paperwork. Monitors logs to ensure all routine H&E slides are submitted.
  • Performs and documents basic embedding procedures for routine surgical and autopsy tissues.
  • Performs and documents routine paraffin block reconciliation. Prioritizes blocks based on established guidelines.
  • Records all documentation consistently and legibly. Maintains manual and electronic records for easy retrieval of data as necessary. Investigates, escalates, and documents any discrepancies appropriately.
  • Answers routine inquiries related to blocks, slides, and case status. Direct inquiries regarding technical information to the appropriate laboratory staff.
  • Practices the proficient and safe use of all equipment necessary for the completion of all duties and responsibilities within defined turn-around times (i.e., tissue processor, embedding center, automated stainer and cover slipper, etc).
  • Cleans, disinfects, performs, and documents routine instrument maintenance per SOP. Reports equipment or instrument malfunctions appropriately.
  • Files paraffin blocks on a daily basis.
  • Transports specimens, blocks, and slides as necessary.
  • Maintains a clean and safe work environment to ensure efficient workflow and compliance with all regulatory requirements. Cleans and disinfects laboratory areas per SOP. Perform minor spill cleanup per SOP when necessary.
  • Monitors laboratory inventory in the front histology area to ensure supply levels are appropriate and adequate. Promptly notifies coordinator of any supply issues.
  • Fosters department and laboratory teamwork through effective communication.
  • Participates in Safety and Infection Control activities.
  • Assists with orientation and training of new staff in front histology area.
  • Takes initiative for personal development by attending teleconferences, educational sessions, and required meetings, etc.
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Required:

  • High School diploma.
  • Computer experience with keyboard proficiency.
  • Familiarity with medical terminology.

Preferred:

  • A.S. degree in the biological, life sciences, medical laboratory technology, or other related field.
  • Prior work experience in laboratory support or health related experience

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information

title: Utilization Management - Inpatient Clinical Specialist
description:
Utilization Management Inpatient Clinical Specialist

Work from home within Washington, Oregon, Idaho or Utah

Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside in Idaho and Utah


Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.


Who We Are Looking For:


Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of Utilization Management Inpatient (UM IP) Clinical Specialist are living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Clinical Services team, our UM IP Clinical Specialist receives, researches, and takes action related to documentation and requests from a variety of sources related to Inpatient Utilization Management cases. The UM IP Clinical Specialist does not make clinical decisions, but partners with licensed health professionals on appropriate actions and responses to support efficient and effective clinical reviews – all in service of making our members’ health journeys easier.


Are you someone who has strong clinical experience and passion for healthcare? Are you ready to take your career to the next level and make a real difference in the lives of our members? Then this role may be the perfect fit.


What You Bring to Cambia:


Qualifications:


  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Clinical experience is required
  • At least 2 years of clinical experience preferred
  • CMA or CNA preferred

Skills and Attributes:


  • Clinical experience, preferably in the inpatient hospital setting, strong communication skills, both oral and written, to effectively interact with other clinical staff.
  • Computer skills, including Microsoft Office, Outlook, internet search. As well as experience with healthcare systems and documentation, EMRs, billing, and claims, with a preference for significant prior experience navigating and documenting in an EMR.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, and coding, including CPT, DX, and HCPCs. Applying this knowledge to investigate and research complex issues and inquiries related to Inpatient Utilization Management case work, using critical thinking skills and collaborating with clinical staff to resolve them.
  • You'll work independently with a high volume case load, prioritizing tasks, meeting deadlines, and achieving operational standards, while also being able to work effectively in a team environment while being able to adapt to changes in the healthcare insurance industry.
  • You'll perform job duties and responsibilities for an UM IP Clinical Specialist, utilizing strong organization, data entry, and administrative skills to ensure accurate and efficient work, while maintaining confidentiality and focus on meeting customer needs in a fast-paced environment.

What You Will Do at Cambia:


  • You'll utilize clinical knowledge and critical thinking to research and review IP UM requests, ensuring completeness of information and taking action to obtain necessary details, while also completing non-clinical tasks to close cases accurately and efficiently.
  • You'll communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including providers and team members, to accomplish role functions and facilitate written notifications in compliance with regulatory and quality entities.
  • You'll exhibit excellent time management skills to ensure timeliness of UM activities, meeting regulatory and quality requirements, and follow strict guidelines to ensure all work meets corporate standards for accuracy, timeliness, quality, and compliance with federal, state, BCBSA, and accreditation regulations.
  • You'll organize and maintain reference documents, policies, and procedures, and demonstrate a professional and ethical work environment, promoting a positive and respectful atmosphere with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • You'll perform detailed research and problem-solve using sound decision-making skills to ensure IP UM case accuracy and completeness, and contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for improvement within systems and workflows.
  • Initiate referrals to adjacent teams as needed.
  • You'll discuss discharge planning with providers as needed, and may assist with systems testing, while adhering to accountability, member focus, and all performance criteria established by the department, including timeliness, production, and quality standards for all work.

Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.


  • Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho: The expected hiring range is $25.90 - $37.30 an hour, the full salary range is $24.40 - $42.20 an hour and the bonus target is 5%.

About Cambia


Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.


Why Join the Cambia Team?


At Cambia, you can:

  • Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.
  • Earn a competitive salary and enjoy generous benefits while doing work that changes lives.
  • Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed.
  • Give back to your community by participating in Cambia-supported outreach programs.
  • Connect with colleagues who share similar interests and backgrounds through our employee resource groups.

We believe a career at Cambia is more than just a paycheck – and your compensation should be too. Our compensation package includes competitive base pay as well as a market-leading 401(k) with a significant company match, bonus opportunities and more.


In exchange for helping members live healthy lives, we offer benefits that empower you to do the same. Just a few highlights include:


  • Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members, including mental health benefits.
  • Annual employer contribution to a health savings account.
  • Generous paid time off varying by role and tenure in addition to 10 company-paid holidays.
  • Market-leading retirement plan including a company match on employee 401(k) contributions, with a potential discretionary contribution based on company performance (no vesting period).
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid parental time off (eligibility requires 12 months of continuous service with Cambia immediately preceding leave).
  • Award-winning wellness programs that reward you for participation.
  • Employee Assistance Fund for those in need.
  • Commute and parking benefits.

Learn more about our benefits.


We are happy to offer work from home options for most of our roles. To take advantage of this flexible option, we require employees to have a wired internet connection that is not satellite or cellular and internet service with a minimum upload speed of 5Mb and a minimum download speed of 10 Mb.


As part of our security requirements, new hires will need access to a personal mobile device to set up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) upon joining the company. MFA is an important layer of protection for accessing Cambia systems and is required for all employees.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer dedicated to a drug and tobacco-free workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by law. A background check is required.

If you need accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please email . Information about how Cambia Health Solutions collects, uses, and discloses information is available in our Privacy Policy.

title: Community Partner Coordinator
description:

title: AI Engineer with AWS Experience
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer with AWS experience

Location: India (Remote)

About Quantum Strides LLC

Quantum Strides LLC is a premier System Integrator and IBM Business Partner specializing in the implementation of IBM TRIRIGA and IBM Maximo. With our headquarters in Herndon, Virginia, USA, and our global presence through subsidiaries and teams in India, the Philippines, and Canada, we are pioneering innovative solutions in the generative AI space. Our aim is to leverage AI technology to streamline enterprise operations and foster business growth.

Position Overview

We are in search of an experienced AI Engineer with AWS and AWS Bedrock experience to enhance our team. This role demands a solid background in Data Science and Machine Learning, with at least 4+ years of experience in the field. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying generative AI models and solutions using AWS cloud services and solutions that integrate with Large Language Models (LLMs) and enterprise software systems like IBM TRIRIGA and IBM Maximo, driving insights and efficiencies across business operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and deploy machine learning and AI models using AWS services such as AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, EC2, and S3 generative AI solutions leveraging LLMs to augment the capabilities of enterprise software systems.
  • Work collaboratively with teams to integrate AI models with enterprise data, ensuring the extraction of meaningful insights.
  • Utilize AWS Bedrock to build and manage foundational models, ensuring high performance and scalability.
  • Utilize AWS tools and best practices for monitoring, logging, and maintaining AI models in production.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI/ML technologies and AWS services, particularly AWS Bedrock.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI/ML technologies and AWS services, and apply them to enhance existing solutions.
  • Develop intuitive chatbots using Natural Language Processing (NLP) for seamless user interactions via speech or text.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to AI models and AWS infrastructure.
  • Document AI solutions, including design, implementation, and maintenance processes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Masters degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 4+ years of experience in the Data Science and Machine Learning space.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, Java, or similar.
  • Experience with Large Language Models and NLP.
  • Strong experience with AWS services relevant to AI/ML, including AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, EC2, S3, Glue, and Athena.
  • Proven track record of developing chatbots and conversational AI solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Why Join Us?

Quantum Strides LLC is dedicated to creating an inclusive, innovative, and growth-conducive work culture. We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and numerous opportunities for professional advancement. Join our team to be at the forefront of AI-driven enterprise solution innovation.

title: Dog Groomer-Part Time
description:
Experienced Dog Groomer - Part-Time
Pet Wants Mira Mesa | San Diego, CA - Mira Mesa/Miramar
Part-Time: Approximately 20-25 hours per week
Pay: From $22/hour + 100% of tips

About Pet Wants Mira Mesa

At Pet Wants Mira Mesa, we believe pets are family. We're a locally owned pet nutrition and supply store specializing in fresh, high-quality pet food, healthy treats, supplements, and premium pet products.
We've recently added professional grooming to our store and are growing our grooming clientele. We're looking for experienced groomers who want to join us as we build a high-quality, pet-focused grooming program.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a groomer who values quality over rushing through appointments, enjoys getting to know their clients and their pets, and would like to be part of a newer salon as it grows.

The Position

This is a part-time hourly position averaging approximately 20-25 hours per week.
Weekend availability is important. We're hiring groomers with the goal of sharing weekend coverage between them.
Unlike many grooming positions, this is not a commission-only position. You'll receive a competitive hourly wage and keep 100% of your tips, providing more predictable compensation while our grooming clientele continues to grow.
We generally practice straight-through grooming, meaning you'll manage your client from check-in through grooming and final handoff to the pet parent. This allows you to get to know the dog, communicate directly with the owner, and provide a more personal grooming experience.
As appointment volume grows, we anticipate adding bather/grooming assistant support.

Responsibilities

  • Provide professional grooming services including bathing, drying, haircuts, styling, brushing, de-shedding, nail trimming and related services.
  • Safely handle dogs of different breeds, sizes, ages and temperaments.
  • Maintain a pet-first approach, with safety, comfort and humane handling taking priority.
  • Consult with pet parents at check-in to understand grooming requests and set appropriate expectations.
  • Communicate with owners at pickup about the groom and any relevant skin, coat or other observations.
  • Maintain accurate grooming and client notes.
  • Keep grooming tables, tubs, equipment and the salon area clean, sanitized and organized.
  • Follow salon safety, sanitation and dog-handling procedures.
  • Build positive, long-term relationships with grooming clients and their pets.
  • When appropriate, help pet parents identify products that may support their pet's skin, coat and overall wellness.
  • Represent our brand at local events and build lasting customer relationships.

Qualifications

  • 1-2+ years of professional dog grooming experience preferred (please plan to show your Book of Work)
  • Comfortable performing complete grooms independently.
  • Knowledge of common breed cuts, coat types and grooming techniques.
  • Experience using professional grooming tools and equipment.
  • Gentle, patient and confident handling of dogs.
  • Strong attention to safety and animal comfort.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Dependable, punctual and professional.
  • Comfortable working independently while also being part of a small, collaborative team.
  • Willingness to work weekend shifts.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

Tools & Equipment

Pet Wants provides the major professional salon equipment and grooming supplies, including grooming tables, tubs and professional drying equipment.
Groomers provide their own preferred clippers, shears and personal hand tools.
We also aid with professional tool sharpening to help keep your equipment performing at its best.

Compensation & Benefits

  • From $22/hour, with commission upside based on your productivity.
  • 100% of customer tips.
  • Approximately 20-25 hours per week.
  • Paid time off (PTO).
  • Paid sick time.
  • 401(k).
  • Employee discount on Pet Wants food, treats and merchandise.
  • Assistance with grooming-tool sharpening.
  • Professional salon equipment provided.
  • Opportunity to grow with a developing grooming program.

Why Pet Wants Mira Mesa?

We're building our grooming salon around a simple idea: take good care of the pet, take good care of the customer, and don't sacrifice quality just to push more dogs through the salon.
Because our grooming business is still growing, appointment volume can vary. Our hourly compensation model gives groomers more predictable pay without making their income entirely dependent on the number of dogs booked that day.
As the salon grows, we expect the grooming team to grow with it - including adding bather/assistant support as volume warrants.
Most importantly, we're looking for groomers who want to help us create the kind of salon where pet parents feel comfortable bringing their dogs back again and again.

Interested?

Please apply with your resume or a brief description of your grooming experience. We'd also love to see photos or a portfolio of your recent grooming work.
We look forward to meeting you - and hopefully welcoming you to the Pet Wants Mira Mesa team.

title: Telephony Performance & Optimisation Lead
description:
**The Vacancy**

Make a real impact on how we serve our customers!

We’re investing in the future of our customer contact centre and looking for a Telephony Performance & Optimisation Lead to help us unlock the full potential of our cloud-based telephony platform.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead the development of innovative telephony solutions that improve customer experience, support colleagues and create operational efficiencies. You’ll support our New Cumberland programme by helping to assess the impact of change on customer journeys and implement telephony, self-serve and customer contact solutions that support customers, colleagues and the successful adoption of new ways of working.

Working closely with our Customer Care, Operations, Digital and Technology teams, you’ll be the driving force behind telephony innovation, ensuring we maximise the value of our platform while delivering great outcomes for customers and colleagues alike.

This will be a fixed term contract for a period of 12 months.

**The Benefits**

- **Salary -** up to £49,680 p.a. – depending on skills and experience.
- **Holidays** - 25 days holiday plus public holidays and the opportunity to buy and sell up to 3 days.
- **Learning and** **Development opportunities** - We want you to grow in your role. We’ll work together to support your personal and professional development.

- **Health and Wellbeing** - a calendar of events and activities throughout the year, Mental Health & Wellbeing champions, and Cycle to Work scheme plus a personal wellbeing day.
- **Community Day** - We offer our people an extra paid day off every year to help local charities and community organisations.

**Main Responsibilities**

- Develop and deliver a roadmap of telephony improvements that support the Society’s strategic objectives.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer journeys through automation, self-service and enhanced telephony solutions.
- Enhance call routing, IVR and customer contact processes to improve service and reduce customer effort.
- Analyse customer contact data, performance metrics and trends to identify improvement opportunities.
- Lead the implementation of new telephony functionality from concept through to delivery and adoption.
- Work closely with Customer Care teams to improve colleague experience and operational efficiency.
- Build strong relationships with suppliers and technology partners to maximise platform capability and value.
- Produce meaningful reporting and insight to measure performance and demonstrate the benefits of change initiatives.
- Act as the Society’s telephony subject matter expert, providing guidance and recommendations on future developments.
- Ensure telephony solutions remain compliant with relevant regulatory and governance requirements.

**About You**

You’ll be passionate about improving customer experiences and finding smarter ways of working. You’ll enjoy turning ideas into practical solutions and be motivated by the opportunity to make a visible impact across the organisation.

You may currently work in telephony, contact centre operations, customer experience, service transformation or operational improvement, and be looking for an opportunity to take ownership of a platform with significant untapped potential.

You’ll bring:

- Experience of working with cloud-based telephony or contact centre platforms.
- A track record of process improvement, delivering service improvements and operational efficiencies.
- Experience using data and insight to identify opportunities and drive decision-making.
- An understanding of customer journeys and how technology can enhance customer experience.
- Experience managing stakeholders and working collaboratively across multiple teams.
- An interest in emerging technologies, including automation and AI-powered customer service solutions.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects.

Experience within financial services or another regulated environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

**Skills, Abilities and Behaviours**

**Customer Focus**

- Committed to delivering excellent customer outcomes.
- Understands the importance of balancing customer needs with business objectives.

**Analytical and Insight Driven**

- Able to interpret data, identify trends and make evidence-based recommendations.
- Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement.

**Innovative and Forward Thinking**

- Curious about new technologies and ways of working.
- Seeks opportunities to improve processes, services and customer experiences.

**Communication and Influencing**

- Confident communicator who can engage effectively with colleagues at all levels.
- Able to translate technical concepts into clear, practical business solutions.

**Collaboration**

- Builds positive working relationships across teams and functions.

title: Senior Director, Experience / Creator Events
description:
THE·TEAM is proud to provide representation and marketing services to talent, brands and properties across 28 countries and more than 70 cities worldwide. Our brands and properties group partners with iconic brands and rights holders to turn relevance into revenue through integrated strategy and consulting, creative, live experiences and commercialization. description:

  • Several years of experience in project management, preferably within robotics, automation, industrial technology, or a related technical environment

title: Director of Clinical Services - Lake Macquarie & Charlestown
description:
Ramsay Health Care is seeking an experienced hospital operations or clinical leadership executive to lead and improve performance across Lake Macquarie Private Hospital and Ramsay Surgical Centre Charlestown, within the Ramsay Newcastle Network. You will provide clear operational leadership across both sites, ensuring safe, efficient and high-quality patient-centred care while driving alignment and integration across services. Working closely with clinicians, VMOs and executive stakeholders, you will build team capability and accountability, improve patient flow and workforce effectiveness, and enhance the patient and staff experience. You will also play a key role in supporting sustainable service growth, financial and operational performance, cost efficiency and continuous improvement across the network. This is an opportunity to help shape healthcare delivery across the Newcastle and Lake Macquarie region and deliver meaningful outcomes for the communities we serve.

What You’ll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve, but are not limited to:

  • Overseeing operational performance across both Lake Macquarie Private Hospital and Ramsay Surgical Centre Charlestown, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality care delivery across both sites.
  • Leading patient flow, capacity management, and operational coordination to support timely access to care and optimal use of hospital resources.
  • Supporting workforce planning and development across clinical and non-clinical teams to ensure strong capability, engagement, and service continuity.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with Visiting Medical Officers (VMOs), specialists, and clinical stakeholders to support high-quality patient outcomes.
  • Contributing to budget development, financial management, and cost control initiatives in partnership with hospital and corporate leadership teams.
  • Driving initiatives that enhance patient experience, doctor engagement, and staff satisfaction across both facilities.
  • Supporting service development and growth initiatives, including the optimisation of new and existing clinical services across the region.

What You’ll Bring

As a champion of The Ramsay Way – People Caring for People – you bring a strong clinical leadership approach, fostering collaborative relationships with key stakeholders, developing high-performing teams, and guiding people through organisational change.

In this role, you will also:

  • Demonstrated senior leadership experience within a hospital or healthcare operations environment, ideally across complex or multi-site services.
  • Previous experience as a Director of Clinical Services (DCS), Associate Director of Clinical Services (ADCS), or equivalent senior hospital leadership role, strongly preferred due to the scale and complexity of the portfolio.
  • Strong understanding of private hospital operations, clinical service delivery, and the healthcare regulatory environment.
  • Proven capability in operational leadership, including patient flow, workforce coordination, and service optimisation.
  • Strong commercial and analytical capability, with an understanding of key drivers of both clinical quality and operational performance.
  • Experience leading or contributing to service improvement, operational transformation, or growth initiatives.
  • Highly developed stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with VMOs, clinicians, and executive leaders.
  • Understanding of clinical governance, safety, and quality frameworks within healthcare settings.

Essential Qualifications:

  • Current registration as a Registered Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (AHPRA).
  • Postgraduate clinical qualifications.

About The Sites

Lake Macquarie Private Hospital is a 187-bed acute medical and advanced surgical hospital located in Gateshead, 15km south of the Newcastle CBD. The hospital is connected via an overhead walkway to the Lake Macquarie Specialist Centre, which provides on-site radiology, pathology services, and specialist consulting suites. The hospital serves the Newcastle and Lake Macquarie communities as well as the broader Hunter New England region. The hospital is also home to the region’s first private emergency department, established in 2015, providing 24/7 emergency care with dedicated resuscitation, triage, and procedure facilities. Lake Macquarie Private Hospital is certified against the 8 National Safety and Quality Health Service Standards, reflecting a strong commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement. It is also home to the Ramsay Cancer Centre, the only comprehensive private oncology service in the Hunter region, offering integrated medical oncology, radiation oncology, research, and support services.

Ramsay Surgical Centre Charlestown, a newly established, purpose-built day surgery facility opened in 2025. The centre provides modern short-stay surgical services with three operating theatres, three treatment rooms, 12 inpatient beds, and contemporary recovery facilities. Services include endoscopy, plastic surgery, oral and maxillofacial surgery, ENT procedures, Mohs dermatology, and more. Conveniently located opposite Charlestown Square with easy access and free parking, it is designed to deliver a seamless patient experience.

About Us

Founded in Australia in 1964, Ramsay Health Care is the nation’s largest private hospital operator and a recognised global leader in healthcare delivery. Across Australia, Ramsay operates 76 hospitals and 12 surgical centres, caring for more than 1.1 million patients each year with the support of over 30,000 dedicated professionals. Guided by our ethos, “People Caring for People,” we are committed to delivering exceptional patient care, building meaningful relationships, and driving continuous improvement and sustainable growth. In addition to our hospital network, Ramsay operates a growing community pharmacy network of more than 35 locations. Through our culture, The Ramsay Way, we place our people at the centre of everything we do—fostering collaboration, empowering teams, and achieving outstanding outcomes for patients and communities.

Benefits

  • A competitive remuneration package, complemented by a comprehensive range of employee benefits.
  • Strong opportunities for professional development and clear pathways for career progression.
  • Access to Ramsay Rewards, providing exclusive discounts with leading retailers and service providers.
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the delivery of high-quality healthcare and contribute to the ongoing transformation of the industry.

To Apply

All applications should include your CV outlining your experience and skills in line with the above criteria. Applications close Saturday 31st October 2026.

resolution.

description:

This role will assist in designing world-class projects utilizing state-of-the-art technologies. As a BIM Technician, you’ll be an integral part of our multidisciplinary engineering design team. We foster a collaborative atmosphere where creativity thrives, and ideas are valued. RESPEC invests in its employees and offers continuous learning opportunities, mentorship, and a supportive environment for your career development.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Get ready to dive into the world of BIM software! You will work primarily in Revit and have the opportunity to leverage Autodesk Forma, AutoCAD, and Bluebeam Revu sessions to enhance your workflows. These powerful platforms empower you to digitally prototype and document precise, clash-free designs that bring facility projects to life.
  • Impactful work: Your role will directly contribute to the success of construction projects. From modeling wood, steel, concrete, and masonry structures to producing plans, elevations, and details, your work will shape the future of our built environment.
  • Visualize and Coordinate: We believe in thinking beyond 2D blueprints. As a BIM Technician, you’ll visualize complex structures to ensure seamless coordination across disciplines. Your ability to recognize spatial conflicts and help optimize designs will be invaluable.
  • Library Management: Curate and maintain our BIM and CADD library, ensuring seamless access to essential resources and support files.

Our ideal candidate enjoys collaborating with a team and diving into new challenges, and will have the following qualifications:

  • Minimum associate’s degree in engineering/architectural drafting and/or directly related degree from an accredited institution

  • Proficiency in BIM and CAD software (Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD)

The Entry-Level Structural BIM Technician will receive training and guidance in structural BIM production, Revit modeling, drafting standards, construction documentation, and project-specific procedures. The individual is expected to progressively develop the technical skills necessary to produce accurate structural models and drawings with increasing independence.

Compensation: Salary is $27 per hour. depends on experience and expertise. Compensation includes a comprehensive fringe-benefits package. title: Embryologist II- Reproductive Endo Infertility Full Time Days
description:
The Embryologist II reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Embryologist II is an experienced, fully-trained embryologist who has a thorough knowledge of assisted reproduction. This position is primarily responsible for performing procedures for artificial reproductive technology including complete human egg fertilization and embryo culturing. This includes microscopic identification of oocytes contained in follicular fluid following the aspiration procedure, classifying the oocytes depending on nuclear characteristics (a measure of oocyte maturation), preparation of granulose cells for co culture, sperm preparation (washing, isolation, buffer treatment, count, motility analysis), oocyte insemination, microscopic identification of fertilized eggs, cryopreservation of excess embryos, preparation of embryos for transfer to the uterus, thawing of cryopreserved embryos for transfer to the uterus.

The Embryologist II performs advanced micromanipulation techniques including embryo biopsy and ICSI to facilitate fertilization and monitors media quality to assure ability to support growth of embryos.

Responsibilities:

  • Performs advanced micromanipulation of embryos and oocytes including embryo biopsy and ICSI
  • Performs laboratory assignments correctly and reliably, including routine procedures and quality control tests, as described in the Laboratory Procedure Manual. Certain amount of assignments will take place on weekend and after regular working hours.
  • Contribute to patient management by communication laboratory findings and interpretations of the findings with physicians, nurses and patients, if appropriate.
  • Assist laboratory director in maintaining and updating laboratory supplies and equipment.
  • Assist laboratory director in data collection and analysis.
  • Assist laboratory director in laboratory preparedness for CAP
  • Participate in continuing education activities.
  • Participate in continuing quality improvement programs of the foundation and laboratory.
  • Participates in training of new staff as requested

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in biological or chemical sciences or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years’ experience in a relevant role.
  • Previous experience in advanced micromanipulation, tissue culture, sterile techniques and egg iteration.

Preferred:

  • Certification as ART

title: Software Engineer, Strategic Defense
location: Costa Mesa, California, United States; Huntsville, Alabama, United States; Irvine, California, United States; Reston, Virginia, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States; Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Defense team at Anduril protects the United States and its allies from ballistic, hypersonic, and air-breathing threats. Those threats now arrive in seconds, maneuver mid-flight, and come in volleys designed to overwhelm the legacy systems meant to stop them — so we're building a software-defined command and control layer that can see, decide, and act faster than any human operator could alone. Our team spans autonomy, tracking, simulation and wargaming, hardware, systems engineering, and test and evaluation to build an accredited fire control system fielded rapidly and at scale. We are at the forefront of incubating and maturing AI-native offerings for the integrated air and missile defense domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

This application is for experienced coders with 3+ years of experience who will complete live coding interviews and it does not require active clearance but you must be eligible.

As a Software Engineer in Strategic Defense, you will write code side-by-side with elite peers to solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more. You’ll make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way to ensure Anduril products achieve a variety of desired outcomes in ambiguous situations where more is on the line than money or corporate gains. By working hand-in-hand with powerhouse teams in AI, Edge Hardware, Space Solutions, Networking, and Test Engineering you will craft cutting-edge, end-to-end systems that redefine mission success for major strategic capabilities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own software solutions that are deployed to customers at the edge of innovation and necessity
  • Write code to improve robust C2 products and scale mission capabilities to broaden our impact
  • Collaborate across multiple engineering teams to plan, build, and test functionality of complex systems
  • Partner with end-users to turn needs into features quickly while balancing user experience and engineering constraints
  • Travel 10 - 30% with the team to build, test, and deploy capabilities in the real world where they’re needed most

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3-8+ years writing production software in languages like C++, Rust, Go, or Python that real users or systems depend on
  • You've owned a feature or service end-to-end including design, implementation, deployment, and dealing with it when it breaks
  • You've debugged problems in code you didn't write and systems you didn't design
  • You can explain technical tradeoffs to people who aren't software engineers (operators, hardware engineers, customers)
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A desire to work on critical software that has a real-world impact
  • Exposure to robotics, distributed systems, networking, or real-time systems
  • Experience with mid and upper tier Air Defense Command and Control (C2) programs
  • Have worked where software touches physical hardware
  • Experience building software solutions involving significant amounts of data processing and analysis
  • Degree in a relevant field like Computer Science, Math, or Physics
  • Willing to travel up to 20% to Asia Pacific

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. The Registered Neurodiagnostic Technologist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

  • This position provides neurological testing and/or monitoring in any or all of the following clinical areas and modalities: A. standard, long-term, or ambulatory Electroencephalography (EEG); B. Electromyography (EMG) and Nerve Conduction Studies.
  • This position may also provide neurological testing and/or monitoring in any or all of the following additional clinical areas and modalities: A. Visual, auditory, or somatosensory Evoked Potentials (EP) or Electronystagmography; C. Intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring (IONM).
  • The Registered Neurodiagnostic Technologist works closely with other members of the Neurological Testing Center (NTC) staff, including physicians.

Responsibilities:

Essential Functions and How They Are Accomplished:

  • Complete all required paperwork before study is performed including relevant patient history. Clarify unclear or inappropriate orders. Complete billing information upon completion of procedure.
  • Independently prepare patient for test and/or monitoring by accurately placing recording electrodes and using established protocols required for the procedure.
  • Recognize technically inadequate signals and obtain troubleshooting assistance if necessary.
  • Recognize abnormalities/potential changes and respond appropriately by communicating to a Coordinator, or appropriate neurologist.
  • Maintain equipment in clean and organized condition, including stocking supplies as needed.
  • Record study and enter appropriate notations and clinical observations.
  • Encourage teamwork through interdepartmental communication and constructive problem resolution.
  • Provide training for new Neurodiagnostic Technicians and student preceptors.

Patient Care/Age Specific Responsibilities and Qualifications:

  • Provide patient with procedure explanation, address questions, and reassure and relax patient (as appropriate), and prepares patients for their procedure. Provide assistance to older adults as necessary through assessment of impairments that affect testing procedures.
  • Provides basic personal hygiene assistance to any patients as necessary.
  • Primarily requires interaction with patients of adult and geriatric age. Interaction with neonates will be required for technicians performing EEG's.

Additional Functions:

  • Provide technical or administrative coverage in other areas of NTC as necessary.
  • Participate in departmental in-services, monthly staff meetings, and continuing education.
  • Assist in report typing, distribution, filing and other storage duties as assigned.
  • Provide consistent feedback and suggestions for improvement to NTC Resource Coordinator and/or Manager.
  • Provide written and/or verbal feedback to NTC Resource Coordinator and/or Manager on Neurodiagnostic Technician and/or student preceptor's performance.

Quality Management Responsibilities:

  • Participates in organizational and departmental quality improvement activities.
  • Communicates customer satisfaction issues to appropriate individuals.
  • Provides ideas and suggestions for process improvements within the department.

Required Education/Experience and License/Certification:

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • CPR certified in basic cardiac life support (BLS) through the American Heart Association (AHA).
  • Registry in respective discipline (EEG, EMG) corresponding with the clinical area of work for the institution.
    • Registered Electroencephalographic Technologist (R.EEG.T) through the American Board of Registration of Electroencephalographic and Evoked Potential technologists (ABRET) for EEG
    • Registered Nerve Conduction Technologist (R. NCS T.) through the American Association of Electrodiagnostic Technologists (AAET) OR Certified Nerve Conduction Technologist (CNCT) through American Board of Electrodiagnostic Medicine (ABEM) for EMG
  • In lieu of registry, candidate may be considered who are board registry eligible, and complete registration within 12 months of hire date.
