### Description

**The City of Santa Ana is looking for individuals who are results-oriented, possess great attitude, demonstrate creativity and innovation, work efficiently, show a record of success and have a passion for public service. Having highly talented employees provides the best service to our community.**

Under direction of a Principal Planner, performs complex analysis of current or advanced planning projects and plans, organizes and supervises the work of personnel assigned to programs and/or special projects in assigned section to support achievement of the Planning Division goals.

**_The current vacancy is in the Advance Planning Division of the Planning and Building Agency. This public-facing role is involved in stakeholder engagement for complex urban initiatives. The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional interpersonal skills and a proven ability to diplomatically navigate diverse and sensitive community perspectives._**

**Applications will be accepted on a continuous basis until a sufficient number of qualified applications have been received.  The deadline for the first review of applications is 11:59 PM on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.  Applicants are encouraged to submit applications early. Applicants who submit applications after the first review deadline are not guaranteed to be considered for this recruitment.  This recruitment may close at any time without notice after the first review deadline.**

### Essential Functions Include But Are Not Limited To

In assigned program or project, supervises and/or performs complex professional and technical planning duties as follows: conducts research, analyzes findings and makes recommendations. Prepares environmental documentation; plans and coordinates action plans and activities pertaining to environmental impact reports. Reviews and analyzes development proposals for conformance to the City's General Plan and Zoning and Development Standards Guidelines. Reviews plans with property owners, civic leaders and policy review boards. Attends offsite meetings. Performs site inspections. Prepares and presents required reports, including recommendations regarding development proposals, to the City's policy making bodies. Collects and analyzes planning data to be utilized in the review and restructuring of the City's General Plan and the Zoning and Development standard documents. Prepares, updates and maintains City's overall General Plan including development of Area Specific Plans. Supervises and coordinates long range planning activities. May coordinate public counter operations for the Planning Division. Supervises, trains and evaluates professional, technical and support staff. Performs other related functions as assigned.

### Minimum Qualifications

Four years of progressively responsible professional level experience in municipal or regional planning administration, two of which must have been in a lead capacity. Education equivalent to graduation from an accredited college or university with a Bachelor’s degree in urban planning, public administration or related field (with a Master's degree preferred), or any equivalent combination of training and experience which provides the following knowledge, skills and abilities.

**DESIRABLE KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

Knowledge of: State General Planning Laws; municipal zoning ordinance administration; California Environmental Quality Act; California Subdivision Map Act; principles and practices of municipal planning; research methods and sources of statistical data; principles and practices of supervision.

Ability to: Plan and organize special planning projects and programs; supervise, train and evaluate professional, technical and support staff; interpret laws and ordinances; analyze data and make sound recommendations; prepare comprehensive reports; communicate clearly and concisely, orally and in writing; utilize principles of Total Quality Service in Planning Division operations; develop and maintain effective working relationships with developers, property owners, business and community leaders, regulatory agencies, other city employees and the general public.

SPECIAL MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Must possess and maintain a valid California Class C Driver’s License as a condition of employment.

Valid American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) certification is required prior to completion of the probationary work test period, and is a condition of continued employment in this classification.

Must be willing and able to work irregular hours including weekends, as needed.

### Selection Process

All applicants are required to complete and submit a City application form online and answer the supplemental questionnaire. Resumes or faxed copies will not be accepted in lieu of the City online application. **Stating "See Resume" is not an acceptable substitute for a completed application.**   To apply, click on the "Apply" link located at the top of this page. New users must create an account first. Click on this link for instructions on how to set up your account and apply for the first time: [Online Employment Application Guide](https://www.governmentjobs.com/home/applicationguide#create-an-account#).

Applications will be reviewed by the Human Resources Department.  Those applicants possessing the most pertinent qualifications will be invited to continue in the selection process, which will include:

**Oral Interview Examination (Tentatively scheduled for November 10, 2026)**: (Weight of 100%) will evaluate the candidates' experience, training, education, and abilities in relation to those factors which are essential for successful performance on the job. Candidates need a minimum passing score in order to be placed on the eligible list.

title: Teknisk profil med blik for produktsikkerhed og AI
description:
Har du kendskab til Eco-design eller LVD Produkter? Har du gode AI-kompetencer? Og vil du gøre en forskel for virksomheder og forbrugere i Danmark?

Hos Erhvervsstyrelsens afdeling for markedsovervågning i Esbjerg søger vi to tekniske sagsbehandlere til området Produkter. Du skal arbejde med produktsikkerhed og gode rammevilkår for erhvervslivet - og være med til at udvikle den måde, vi løser opgaverne på. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har teknisk forståelse og kan bruge AI-værktøjer sikkert og kritisk til at styrke kvalitet, ensartethed og effektivitet i vores arbejde.

Du får ansvar for sagsbehandling inden for et eller flere tekniske områder og hjælper virksomhederne med at efterleve reglerne. Samtidig bidrager du til at udvikle en mere risikobaseret og datainformeret markedsovervågning i Danmark og EU.

Din rolle og opgaver

Som teknisk sagsbehandler bliver du en del af området Produkter i Erhvervsstyrelsens afdeling for markedsovervågning i Esbjerg. Her arbejder ca. 50 engagerede kolleger fordelt på tre teams. Vores fælles mål er, at produkter på det danske marked er sikre, og at virksomhederne konkurrerer på lige vilkår. Vi har forskellige faglige baggrunde og bringer vores viden i spil på tværs.

De faglige områder spænder bredt og omfatter blandt andet LVD produkter, maskiner, fritidsfartøjer, gasprodukter, ecodesign og energimærkning, fyrværkeri, byggevarer, legetøj og tekstiler.

Afhængigt af dine kompetencer og interesser bliver du tilknyttet et eller flere af områderne. Lige nu søger vi især medarbejdere med viden om LVD (elektriske produkter) og ecodesign og energimærkning. Du skal samtidig have lyst til at arbejde på tværs af fagområder og løbende sætte dig ind i nyt stof.

Dine AI-kompetencer skal i spil i udviklingen af vores fælles arbejdsgange. Du skal kunne få øje på opgaver, hvor AI skaber reel værdi, afprøve og forbedre konkrete løsninger og dele dine erfaringer med kolleger. Det kan for eksempel være støtte til informationssøgning, analyse, kvalitetssikring eller prioritering af tilsyn. Du forholder dig kritisk til resultaterne og bruger værktøjerne ansvarligt med blik for faglig kvalitet, datasikkerhed og myndighedsrollen.

Vi samarbejder tæt med andre myndigheder i Danmark og internationalt. Derfor skal du have lyst til at bringe din viden i spil og skabe gode relationer til virksomheder, myndigheder og øvrige interessenter.

Markedsovervågning kræver, at vi vælger den metode, der giver bedst effekt i den konkrete situation. Vi vejleder virksomhederne i et klart sprog og prioriterer kontrol og tilsyn dér, hvor risikoen er størst. Her kan data og AI være med til at kvalificere vores vurderinger - altid med faglig og menneskelig kvalitetssikring.

Du vejleder med udgangspunkt i virksomhedernes behov og gældende regler. Når du behandler konkrete sager og henvendelser, trækker du både på din faglige dømmekraft og din evne til at kommunikere præcist med forskellige målgrupper.

Hvad bringer du med?

Vi søger dig, der:

  • har en relevant teknisk uddannelse, for eksempel som maskinmester eller ingeniør, eller en anden relevant teknisk baggrund kombineret med stærk digital forståelse.
  • har kendskab til LVD, ecodesign eller energimærkning - eller en stærk motivation for hurtigt at opbygge den nødvendige faglighed.
  • har praktisk erfaring med generative AI-værktøjer og kan omsætte dem til bedre arbejdsgange. Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med promptdesign, automatisering, dataanalyse eller implementering af AI i sagsbehandling og procesoptimering.
  • trives med variation og kan strukturere og prioritere dine opgaver.
  • er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære nyt - både fagligt, teknisk og digitalt.
  • kommunikerer sikkert på dansk og engelsk, både skriftligt og mundtligt, og kan skabe en konstruktiv dialog - også i internationale samarbejder.
  • har interesse for samspillet mellem teknik og jura og forståelse for de krav, der gælder i en offentlig myndighed.
  • arbejder engageret, deler din viden og bidrager aktivt til et godt samarbejdsmiljø.
  • kan se dig selv i Erhvervsstyrelsens vision om at gøre det enkelt og attraktivt at drive ansvarlig virksomhed i Danmark.
Hvem er vi?

Erhvervsstyrelsen er en del af Erhvervsministeriet og er placeret på flere forskellige lokationer i landet. Disse stillinger er placeret i Esbjerg i vores afdeling for markedsovervågning.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et job med mening, hvor du hver dag bidrager til øget sikkerhed for danskerne og gode vilkår for virksomhederne
  • et højt fagligt niveau og mulighed for at udvikle både din tekniske profil og dine AI-kompetencer.
  • engagerede kolleger, der deler viden, afprøver nye løsninger og har det godt sammen.
  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår på gældende overenskomst
  • En moderne arbejdsplads i Esbjerg med fokus på trivsel og fleksibilitet
Du kan læse mere om Erhvervsstyrelsen her.

Sådan søger du

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så klik på ”Søg stilling”-knappen og følg instrukserne. Din ansøgning med CV og eksamenspapirer skal være modtaget senest 8. november. Vi forventer at afholde 1. samtaler den 13. november og 2. samtaler 18.-19. november.

Du vil blive ansat på en gældende overenskomst alt efter, hvilken baggrund du kommer med. Din titel vil blive teknisk sagsbehandler og arbejdet er som udgangspunkt i Esbjerg.

Har du spørgsmål til selve stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til chef Helle Andersen på tlf. 29 23 96 93 eller chef Thomas Obel Jørgensen på 29 23 96 67 (Send evt. en sms, så ringer vi dig op).

Har du spørgsmål til ansættelsesvilkår, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Rekrutteringspartner Mie-Pil Simmelsgaard-Madsen på tlf. 91 33 70 45.

Vi vil gerne have dig som ny kollega fra 1. januar 2027.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Senior Materials Officer
description:
The Senior Materials Officer is responsible for sourcing, procuring, and coordinating aircraft materials required to support scheduled and unscheduled Heavy Maintenance activities. The role ensures the timely and cost-effective availability of parts, components, and repair solutions to minimize aircraft downtime and support on-time aircraft release.

Accountabilities:

  • Coordinate with Production, Planning, and Engineering teams to resolve pre-input material shortages and support maintenance schedules.
  • Source and procure aircraft parts, components, repairs, loans, and exchanges in compliance with company requirements.
  • Monitor material shortages and repetitive defects, providing recommendations to Planning and Strategic Procurement teams to mitigate future risks.
  • Represent Materials during daily operational meetings and proactively manage potential work stoppages, critical shortages, and AOG situations.
  • Conduct regular purchase order reviews to optimize costs, delivery performance, and supplier effectiveness.
  • Liaise with OEMs, repair vendors, and internal stakeholders to develop repair and material support solutions.

  • Bachelor’s or equivalent technical degree with minimum 5 years aviation inventory management experience.
  • Strong knowledge of aircraft spares procurement, repairs, loans and exchanges, PBH, pooling arrangements, and supply chain best practices.
  • Working knowledge of aircraft maintenance documentation, including IPC, CMM, AMP, and MPD.
  • Familiarity with repair management, warranty claims, RSPLs, and OEM support agreements.
  • Strong negotiation, supplier management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Experience working within ERP/MRO systems (AMOS, SAP, TRAX, Ramco, Wings, MXI or equivalent) is preferred.
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced operational environment with competing priorities

title: Senior Delivery Manager (AI-Driven Delivery)
description:
We're looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to bring emerging trends in GenAI, Data, and Cloud into how we deliver for our Fortune Global 500 clients — not just what we deliver, but how the delivery itself is run.

You use AI as a delivery instrument: to forecast risk, evaluate team productivity, accelerate reporting, and sharpen decision-making. If you don't yet have deep AI delivery experience, you make up for it with strong hands-on technical depth and a clear appetite to lead AI-native delivery. If a constantly changing environment doesn't stop you from exceeding stakeholder and team expectations, and you can scale both products and teams across 50, 100, 200+ people, you're the leader we need.

Responsibilities

  • Lead projects from kick-off through go-live and post-production, aligning stakeholders around clearly defined success criteria
  • Own the delivery process end to end: requirements, scope, risk, quality, and budget
  • Apply GenAI across the delivery lifecycle — productivity evaluation, risk detection, status reporting, and data-driven decisions
  • Set and enforce product quality benchmarks, engaging the team to meet them
  • Facilitate UAT and production deployments; manage releases and environments
  • Prepare the WBS, resource plans, and delivery roadmap
  • Act as the primary stakeholder contact, communicating status, risk, and progress with data, not opinions
  • Interface with clients daily — demos, expectation management, and upskilling engineers on AI-augmented ways of working
  • Establish governance models, run Agile ceremonies, and define escalation, change, and risk-management procedures
  • Foster a collaborative environment; mentor, coach, and resolve people-management issues
  • Implement organizational best practices and embed AI tooling into team workflows

Requirements

  • 7+ years leading teams and projects, with at least five successful commercial enterprise deliveries
  • Confidence to lead 50+ people, including direct people management
  • Hands-on use of GenAI for productivity evaluation, delivery insight, and decision-making — or strong technical depth (see below) plus a track record of adopting new tooling fast
  • Production experience delivering Digital, Data, or Cloud projects
  • Command of the full product lifecycle, from pre-sales to post-production support
  • Background setting up Dev, QA, and BA processes on projects
  • Solid grasp of Agile, SAFe, and Kanban
  • Emotional intelligence, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and cultural awareness
  • Fluent English
  • Prior hands-on engineering experience (development, architecture, or platform)
  • Comfort reasoning about system architecture, environment landscapes, sizing, and delivery techniques

Nice to have

  • Experience embedding AI/GenAI tooling into delivery or SDLC workflows

title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
description:
Red Oak Technologies is a leading provider of comprehensive resourcing solutions across a variety of industries and sectors including IT, Marketing, Finance, Business Operations, Manufacturing and Engineering.


Our client is a software and services company specializing in cloud computing and storage. They are looking for an Infrastructure Software Engineer to join their team. This role is a Direct Hire / FTE / Permanent / Full Time position. Position will be REMOTE. Candidates must be residing within the United States of America in order to be considered for the role.


**FTE / Direct Hire / Permanent / Full Time**

**Full Remote Role**

**If selected candidate is in the Bay Area, they will need to work 3 days a week in the Mountain View HQ office**


Position Summary:

In this role you will design and build a system that unifies scattered configuration, inventory, and observability data into a single infrastructure knowledge graph, and delivers multi-layer topology maps and service dependency maps on top of it. Users can overlay physical, logical, and service layers selectively, drill down hierarchically from a region to an individual node, and jump from any component to its related alerts, tickets, runbooks, and dashboards. The system serves as a shared operational view for the network, compute, SRE, and security teams, and becomes the foundation for fast root cause analysis, failure-domain analysis, and pre-change impact assessment.


Position Duties:

  • Design and maintain an infrastructure topology data model spanning physical, logical, and service layers — schemas, node and edge metadata, and cross-layer relationships
  • Build read-only, low-impact collectors and parsers that gather data from configuration management tools, network devices, hypervisors, and metrics/log systems
  • Build pipelines that reconcile declared configuration against observed state to detect and report drift
  • Develop the interactive web frontend and backend services providing multi-layer, hierarchical drill-down navigation, directional traffic and dependency flow visualization, and deep links into related systems
  • Design dependency-based blast radius calculation, failure-domain analysis, and change scenario simulation
  • Provide topology and dependency data as the foundation for alert correlation and automated root cause analysis (RCA), and integrate with incident response, alerting, and ticketing systems and AIOps pipelines — including human-in-the-loop review and approval workflows
  • Define data accuracy and freshness metrics; own the reliability and performance of the system itself
  • Gather requirements from consuming teams and expand adoption in stages (static artifacts → hosted service)


Position Requirements:

  • Understanding of hypervisor-based virtualization and compute host operations
  • Understanding of the data models and limitations of observability stacks (Prometheus, Open Telemetry, logging and tracing systems)
  • Sound judgment in designing data collection that minimizes impact on production systems
  • Ownership -Take ownership of projects, ensuring excellence in execution and accountability for results. Foster a sense of responsibility and pride in delivering high-quality work
  • Innovation - Drive innovation by proposing and implementing creative solutions to challenges. Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies, bringing fresh ideas to the table
  • Customer focus - Understand and prioritize customer needs, striving to exceed expectations in every interaction. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the delivery of customer-centric solutions
  • Teamwork - Embrace a collaborative and inclusive approach, working seamlessly with colleagues to achieve common goals


Education & Experience:

  • 5+ years in infrastructure, platform, SRE, or network automation, with hands-on experience across both cloud and on-premises environments
  • Working knowledge of L2/L3 networking: routing protocols (e.g. BGP), overlay networks (e.g. VXLAN), and the Linux networking stack
  • Experience building Python data pipelines, including schema definition and validation tooling
  • Experience modeling and processing data in analytical stores (columnar databases, graph databases, or similar)
  • Experience visualizing graph/topology data on the web (D3, Cytoscape, or similar) and handling the performance and readability challenges of large graphs


Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience operating large-scale multi-region cloud or IaaS environments
  • Experience building or integrating CMDBs, inventories, or network sources of truth (NetBox, Nautobot, or similar)
  • Experience with service dependency mapping, failure-domain analysis, or what-if / digital-twin style simulation
  • AIOps experience: alert correlation and noise reduction, anomaly detection, automated root cause analysis, and building incident response automation pipelines
  • Experience applying LLM-based agents to operational workflows — particularly using LLMs to parse and summarize unstructured sources (documents, free-form configuration, alert text) wrapped in deterministic validation and human review
  • Experience with automated diagram generation (draw.io, Graphviz, or similar)
  • Experience collaborating with security teams on exposure surface or attack path visualization

Reporting to the Vice President, Risk Adjustment, the Director of Risk Adjustment Prospective Programs is a strategic leader responsible for implementing, operationalizing, and optimizing the health plan's point-of-care, concurrent, and forward-looking risk adjustment initiatives. Unlike traditional retrospective 'chart chasing,' this role focuses entirely on prospective interventions, capturing accurate member health acuity before or during a provider encounter. This position executes the enterprise strategy and converts it into scalable workflows, controls, KPIs, EHR integrations, and provider-facing tools that reduce friction for independent clinicians and delegated IPAs.


The primary mandate of this position is to ensure the plan's risk adjustment program is a proactive, clinically driven model. Operating within a network structure comprised of independent, Fee-for-Service (FFS) practices and delegated Independent Physician Associations (IPAs), this Director leads programs such as in-home and virtual assessments, pre-visit suspecting, point-of-care documentation supports, and concurrent validation. This leader ensures chronic conditions are documented accurately to CMS compliance standards in real time, driving revenue accuracy and improving proactive clinical care management.

Commitment to Quality: The IEHP Team is committed to incorporate IEHP’s Quality Program goals including, but not limited to, HEDIS, CAHPS, and NCQA Accreditation.

At least five (5) years of leadership and management experience leading teams, projects, initiatives, and/or cross-functional groups. Demonstrated success improving compliant documentation capture, provider adoption, and submission integrity through EHR integrations and analytics driven suspecting

title: Graduate Vacuum Engineer
description:

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you?

If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance groundbreaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come.

title: Python Developer
description:

12 Month Contract to Hire

New York City

Python Developer

Our client is a private investment firm operating across multiple asset classes, primarily focused on fund-to-fund exchanges. The initial focus of this role will be supporting the firm's overnight suite of processes, providing visibility into the full technology and business landscape while gaining hands-on experience with existing systems. title: Range Safety & Flight Termination Engineer
description:
Range Safety & Flight Termination Engineer

Location: Huntsville, AL
Employment Type: Full-Time
Security Clearance: Active DoD Secret Clearance Required
Work Arrangement: Customer Site; Telework Permitted
Travel: Required


Position Overview

Created Solutions is seeking a highly skilled Range Safety & Flight Termination Engineer to support the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) Targets and Countermeasures Engineering Directorate under the TEAMS Next MDS Engineering program.


In this role, you will provide critical engineering expertise for flight termination systems (FTS) used across launch and reentry vehicles. You will support flight test activities, oversee FTS requirements and development, evaluate system performance, and ensure compliance with applicable range safety standards.


The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in flight termination systems, ordnance systems, and range safety engineering, along with the technical judgment and communication skills necessary to support complex missile defense programs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a Range Safety subject matter expert on behalf of the Targets Program Office during flight tests, Range Safety Working Groups, and flight termination testing.
  • Provide oversight of requirements development, allocation, and verification for target system flight termination products, including autonomous flight termination systems.
  • Conduct technical surveillance of FTS hardware and software throughout development, qualification, acceptance, integration, and final checkout.
  • Prepare technical reports documenting system status, analytical findings, and formal engineering recommendations.
  • Represent government stakeholder interests in technical working groups, customer forums, and formal design reviews.


Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Active DoD Secret security clearance.
  • Master's degree in a STEM discipline.
  • Minimum of 12 years of related professional experience.
  • Demonstrated technical expertise in flight termination systems and ordnance systems.
  • Proficiency with flight safety analysis products and applicable Range Commanders Council standards, including:
    • RCC-319: Flight Termination Commonality Standard
    • RCC-324: Range Safety Tracking Systems Commonality Standard
  • Working knowledge of range tracking architectures and technologies, including GPS, Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs), and C-band tracking.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare technical reports and deliver briefings to government and industry stakeholders.
  • Willingness and ability to travel in support of flight test activities and mission deployments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with Autonomous Flight Termination Systems (AFTS).
  • Hands-on experience supporting flight test operations.
  • Technical experience with RF systems, antennas, batteries, and ordnance devices.
  • Ten or more years of experience in the defense and aerospace industries.


Culture & Values

At Created Solutions, our motto, “Consider it done,” is more than a slogan—it reflects our commitment to innovation, excellence, and integrity. We seek team members who:

  • Thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Bring a problem-solving mindset and a strong work ethic.
  • Value collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Are committed to making a positive impact—both in their work and in their community.

Our company believes that all people are created equal for a purpose. We hold ourselves accountable to high standards in our work and in our mission to support our community through Created Outreach, our 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.


About Created Solutions

Founded in 2024 in Huntsville, AL, Created Solutions is a fast-growing small business delivering advanced engineering solutions to the DoD and NASA. We provide expert government support services in flight vehicle design, electrical and mechanical systems, material science, manufacturing, and hypersonic technologies—helping solve some of the nation's most complex and critical defense challenges.


Join us and be part of a team where purpose and excellence come together.

title: CRA II for Romania - Homebased - FSP Single Sponsor
description:
CRA II for Romania - Homebased - FSP Single Sponsor

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. title: Analyst, Responsible Investment
description:
At Rest, we help more than 2 million Australians to build a better financial future. With around $112 billion in funds under management, we focus on delivering strong long-term outcomes for our members — from their first job through to retirement*. Your best at Rest means focusing on what matters, being trusted to get on with it, and knowing your work genuinely makes a difference. That’s how we operate every day, guided by our values: Be Daring, Keep It Simple, Take Action and Have Grit.

Join us as an Analyst, Responsible Investment, where you’ll help integrate ESG considerations into investment decisions and support responsible investment outcomes across our portfolio. This is your opportunity to make a real contribution to the financial wellbeing of millions of Australians.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work in a high-performing and highly collaborative Responsible Investments (RI) team for a universal owner and long-term investor across global markets.

The analyst will play an important role in supporting the implementation of Rest's responsible investment approach, including integrating the material environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors into the investment process and decisions, and supporting ESG integration and active ownership in Private Markets. This role will primarily operate at the intersection of sustainability and financial materiality across taking a whole of fund lens with a focus on private markets.

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities

  • Assist with ESG data analysis, due diligence, and ongoing monitoring across a range of investment strategies.
  • Assist with the development and implementation of responsible investment tools, frameworks, and processes to inform investment portfolio monitoring and decision-making
  • Assist with the research, measurement, monitoring, analysis, and reporting on ESG and climate-related data, trends, metrics and targets, including the enhanced ESG criteria for the Sustainable Growth option
  • Assist with the annual review, updating or uplifting of strategy, policies, protocols, and risk standards; draft relevant sections for reports, disclosures and other communications.
  • Assist with the development of responsible investment questionnaires and disclosures that require internal coordination, e.g. RIAA, PRI, SuperRatings
  • Coordinate and draft responses for external disclosures and communications, including preparation for assurance and audit activities.
  • Enhance skills and knowledge of relevant industry standards, guidance and initiatives to improve capabilities internal and external to the organisation.
  • Contributing to the overall effective operation of the RI&S team by delivering a consistently high standard of work in a timely manner, and contributing to any other relevant duties.
  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Business, Economics, Applied Finance, Environmental Science, Engineering or similar.
  • ESG certifications and/or sustainability qualifications highly regarded.

Required experience, understanding or credentials including:

  • Demonstrated work experience in a similar sustainability, responsible investment, financial services, consulting, or business role.
  • Strong business acumen and familiarity with listed equities and/or fixed income.
  • Working knowledge of ESG metrics, disclosure standards, reporting frameworks, sector benchmarks, and performance indices relating to responsible investment and sustainability (e.g., UN PRI, ISSB, PCAF).
  • Strong quantitative skills, including experience identifying, collecting, processing, and generating large ESG datasets. Preferably familiar with ESG data and investment management systems.
  • Working knowledge of carbon footprinting and awareness of climate-related scenario analysis and portfolio decarbonisation.
  • Understanding of emerging themes, concepts, and trends in RI and sustainability, as well as how ESG factors can be integrated into investment decision-making to optimise risk-adjusted returns and advance sustainability outcomes.
  • Attention to detail, strong intellectual curiosity, growth mindset and a passion for learning.
  • A strong team player with a willingness and flexibility to support the RI&S team deliver against multiple and sometimes competing priorities

.What you'll find at Rest

  • Hybrid working
  • 5 Rest Days (wellbeing days) each year in addition to annual leave
  • Eligible employees are entitled to 22 weeks paid parental leave (gender neutral)
  • Continued super contributions during parental leave
  • Learning and development opportunities, including AI & Data Academy, leadership programs, LinkedIn Learning, study assistance and professional memberships
  • Income Protection Insurance
  • Option to purchase additional leave
  • Recognition through our Rest Excellence Awards

If you share our values and this sounds like the kind of place you’d do your best work, we’d like to hear from you. Apply now.

Rest is committed to creating a flexible work environment and culture that embraces diversity, equity, and inclusion - where people feel welcome, safe to be themselves and inspired to do their best.

We value the different backgrounds, lived experiences and abilities our diverse team brings. We welcome and encourage applications from candidates of all ages, cultural backgrounds, faiths, gender identities, sexual orientations and thinking styles. This includes people with disability, neurodiverse individuals, Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander peoples and those with disrupted work history due to career or other breaks.

We welcome applications from all candidates. To be considered, you will need the right to work in Australia.

title: Planlægger og svejsekoordinator til vedligeholdelsesafdeling på Danmarks største kraftværk
description:
I denne rolle vil du sikre høj kvalitet i vedligehold gennem grundig planlægning og klargøring af arbejdsordrer. Du får en central rolle i at omsætte vedligeholdsbehov til detaljerede, gennemarbejdede opgaver samt udføre risikovurderinger og sikre korrekt estimering af tid og ressourcer. Samtidig bidrager du til løbende forbedringer af vedligeholdsprocesser og dokumentation. Du vil derudover have ansvaret for en del af svejsesagerne på de tre kraftværker.

**Velkommen til BioEnergy

**Du bliver del af den lokale Asset Maintenance-organisation på Avedøreværket, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger sikrer høj kvalitet i det daglige vedligehold gennem struktureret planlægning og grundig forberedelse af opgaver. Afdelingen modner og klargør opgaver, sikrer stærk dokumentation og driver løbende forbedringer. Vi har end-to-end-ansvar for vedligehold – inkl. eksekvering via egne teknikere og leverandører – med fokus på sikkerhed, økonomi, kvalitet og teknisk rådighed.

I vores team arbejder vi tæt sammen, deler viden og lærer af hinanden. Vi bringer forskellige kompetencer i spil, støtter udvikling og skaber en kultur præget af tillid, ansvar og løbende forbedringer.

**I jobbet vil du:

**

  • arbejde bredt med vedligeholdelsesopgaver på tværs af kraftværkernes tekniske anlæg og fagområder
  • have ansvar for svejserelaterede opgaver i tæt samarbejde med kolleger
  • modtage og kvalitetssikre vedligeholdelsesordrer, så opgaverne får det rette grundlag fra start
  • besigtige arbejdssteder, igangsætte risikovurderinger og involvere supervisorer og leverandører tidligt i planlægningen
  • planlægge og koordinere behovet for reservedele og materialer samt indsamle og videregive den nødvendige tekniske dokumentation
  • sikre, at opgaverne er sikkerhedsmæssigt, teknisk og praktisk modne, inden de frigives til udførelse.

**For at få succes i denne rolle forventer vi, at du:

**

  • har en teknisk faglig uddannelse kombineret med relevant erfaring inden for vedligehold – alternativt fx en uddannelse som maskinmester
  • har solid erfaring som svejsekoordinator
  • arbejder struktureret og analytisk og har blik for de detaljer, der er afgørende for en sikker og effektiv udførelse
  • samarbejder naturligt på tværs af faggrupper og kommunikerer klart med både kolleger, supervisorer og leverandører
  • kan læse, forstå og anvende teknisk dokumentation
  • har praktisk forståelse for QHSE, risikovurdering og Management of Change.

Selvom din profil ikke matcher alle punkterne, har du måske andre kompetencer, der vil være relevante. Mener du, at du kan bidrage til teamet, så send os din ansøgning.

**Form fremtiden med os

**Send din ansøgning og CV til os så hurtigt som muligt.

Hvis du ønsker at anmode om justering af arbejdsmetoder eller arbejdsmønstre eller hjælp til rekrutteringsprocessen, så send en e-mail til accommodation@orsted.com.

Bemærk venligst, at din ansøgning kun bliver taget i betragtning, hvis den indsendes via vores online karriereside. Vi tager ikke ansøgninger eller forespørgsler fra eksterne rekrutteringsbureauer eller bureauer i betragtning til denne stilling.

**Lønramme:

**For denne stilling er det forventede grundlønsniveau kr50,400.00 – kr75,600.00 for lokationen i jobannoncen. Den endelige løn fastsættes på baggrund af relevante kompetencer, erfaring og forventet opfyldelse af rollen inden for det angivne løninterval for at sikre et fair og konkurrencedygtigt tilbud. Denne jobannonce henvender sig primært til kandidater, der er tidligt i deres karriere eller fortsat opbygger erfaring inden for området. Lønniveauet vil derfor typisk ligge i den lavere del af det samlede interval for stillingen. Vi byder dog også ansøgninger fra alle kvalificerede kandidater velkommen, uanset erfaringsniveau. Hvor det er relevant, kan du desuden være berettiget til variabel løn og en omfattende fordelspakke.

**Vores fordelspakke:

**I denne stilling får medarbejdere, der opfylder berettigelseskravene, adgang til: arbejdsgiverbetalt pension (11 % indbetaling), fuld forsikringsdækning (ulykke, liv, kritisk sygdom og sundhedsforsikring); fem ugers betalt ferie plus 10 ekstra betalte fridage/feriefridage pr. ferieår; 3 % feriepengetillæg; adgang til Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality, herunder holdtræning, fysioterapi, massage og trivselstilbud; en multimediepakke (mobiltelefon, pc, og internet); medlemskab af personaleklub med sports- og kulturaktiviteter samt adgang til virksomhedens kantine (månedlig frokostordning eller dagsbilletter).

**Baggrundstjek før ansættelse:

**Denne stilling kræver et baggrundstjek som en del af ansættelsesprocessen, og jobtilbuddet er afhængigt af resultatet af dette tjek. Du vil modtage yderligere information i løbet af rekrutteringsforløbet. Baggrundstjekket udføres af en ekstern udbyder i overensstemmelse med lokal lovgivning.

title: Chaplain-Pastoral Care Casual Rotating
description:
See what our staff have to say about working at Northwestern Medicine! It Takes a Team!

The Chaplain Flex reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A chaplain offers spiritual guidance and pastoral care to patients, families, and hospital staff/medical staff. As representatives of spiritual and/or religious traditions, chaplains use insights and principles of psychology religion, spirituality, and theology.

Responsibilities:

  • Delivers a ministry of spiritual care, counseling, consultation, worship, prayer, sacraments, and spiritual/ emotional support services to patients, families, and hospital personnel/medical staff for the optimal holistic care of patients.
  • Identifies and clarifies ethical dilemmas. Findings will be shared with the Ethics Committee Chairs to determine whether an ethics consult is necessary per site policy/procedure.
  • Participates in and provides appropriate leadership in interdisciplinary clinical team activities related to planning and coordinating patient care, including care conferences, team meetings, nursing rounds, palliative care rounds, IDT meetings, and family conferences when appropriate.
  • Provides end of life support, bereavement support as needed.
  • Provides education to patients and hospital personnel/medical staff on Advanced Directives including Power of Attorney for Healthcare and Goals of Care conversations.
  • Develops and leads spiritual care services within the hospital in collaboration with other members of the Spiritual Care Department.
  • Serves as spiritual liaisons between the hospital and community (both religious and secular) with referrals and information with patient/family permission that is compliant with HIPAA regulations.
  • Escalates any concerns or issues following the NM chain of command policies.
  • Offers religious services to hospital personnel/medical staff as appropriate and when requested.
  • Accepts on call for spiritual care coverage, crises and emergencies as assigned including nights, weekends, and holidays. Manager may assign required minimum on-call shifts.
  • Assists in leading CALM/Mindful Moments as assigned or as needed.
  • Attends to cultural and spiritual dynamics that may improve patient treatment and family dynamics.
  • Maintains chapel/sacred spaces and workspaces in a neat fashion while keeping supplies available and stocked.
  • Maintains board certification and/or minimum annual CEU requirements as set by certifying bodies and organization/industry standards.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by the Manager of Spiritual Care

This position is casual (non-benefited) rotating.

Required:

  • Master’s degree in theology, religion, pastoral care, spiritual care, or divinity from an accredited institution or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • At least one (1) unit of Clinical Pastoral Education (CPE) or in process of completing one (1) unit of CPE within 90 days of hire date.

Preferred:

  • Ordination and/or in good standing within one’s faith tradition or certifying organization
  • Four (4) Units of CPE, Board Certification

title: AI, Governance & Incident Management Lead - Tech Security Operations
company: Liberty Specialty Markets Singapore Pte Limited
description:
General information

Country: Singapore

Creation Date: 03-Sep-2026

Employment Type: Permanent

Employment Type: Full time

Ref #: 1234573530

Description & Requirements

Role Title: AI, Governance & Incident Management Lead - Tech Security Operations

Department: Technology

Location: Singapore

Type: Permanent

Job Summary:

We're hiring a multi-disciplinary cybersecurity professional to own security operations, incident management, GRC, and AI-driven automation across our APAC insurance markets - running penetration tests, coordinating incident response with the global CSOC, bridging APAC threat intelligence, leading local regulatory procedures, and building AI/automation solutions that scale security operations regionally. You'll work with market CISOs and global policy owners to translate global standards into procedures that satisfy local regulators while staying enterprise-aligned, using AI and automation to reduce manual effort and speed detection and response.

Markets & Regulators: Singapore (MAS), Hong Kong (HKIA), Australia (APRA), Malaysia (BNM), China (NFRA), India (IRDAI)

Job Responsibilities:


  • Penetration Testing & Offensive Security - Plan and execute pen tests across web/API, mobile, cloud, and network environments; run purple team exercises with the CSOC; document findings with remediation guidance and verify fixes; manage external pen-test vendors, including regulator-mandated testing (APRA CPS 234, MAS TRM); explore AI-assisted tools for vulnerability discovery and attack path analysis.

  • Incident Response & Coordination - Act as APAC's regional incident coordinator through triage, containment, eradication, and recovery; drive incident bridges and post-incident reports; maintain IR runbooks reflecting each regulator's notification timelines (MAS 1-hour, APRA CPS 234, HKIA, BNM, NFRA, IRDAI); partner with Legal, Compliance, and Privacy on regulatory submissions; maintain a full incident evidence trail and use AI-powered triage/correlation to reduce MTTR.

  • Threat Intelligence & CSOC Liaison - Serve as the two-way link between APAC markets and the global CSOC/threat intel teams; curate and share region-specific threat intelligence; escalate local indicators and emerging threats; build relationships with peer organizations, ISACs, CERTs, and law enforcement across APAC.

  • AI & Security Automation - Design and implement AI/automation use cases using SOAR platforms, Python/PowerShell, and low-code tools (Power Automate, Logic Apps); build AI/ML solutions for threat detection, anomaly identification, alert enrichment, and predictive risk scoring; integrate LLMs/GenAI for report generation, drafting assistance, and natural-language querying; automate log analysis, alert triage, phishing analysis, vulnerability correlation, and compliance monitoring/evidence collection; build CISO dashboards and AI-driven user behaviour analytics; ensure all deployments meet AI governance requirements (e.g., MAS FEAT) with documented models and drift/bias monitoring.

  • Governance, Risk & Compliance - Develop and version-control local procedures/SOPs per market against global policy baselines; perform gap analyses and maintain a traceability matrix to policies and regulatory clauses; track and interpret requirements from MAS, HKIA, APRA, BNM, NFRA, and IRDAI via a per-market regulatory obligations register; drive closure of audit/regulatory findings through to evidence and sign-off; coordinate regulatory inquiries, audits, and incident notifications, keeping programs continuously audit-ready.

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Reporting - Partner with market CISOs on the security, automation, and compliance roadmap; report periodically on posture, findings, incident trends, automation ROI, and compliance status; coordinate across CSOC, threat intel, GRC, AI/ML, IT, Legal, HR, and risk functions; escalate blockers with decision-ready context; support training and rollout of new procedures/workflows.

Job Requirements:


  • 7+ years combined experience across penetration testing, incident response, security operations, or GRC; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience)

  • Hands-on offensive security skills (web/API, network, privilege escalation, post-exploitation) with tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, Nmap, BloodHound, and SIEM/SOAR/EDR platforms

  • Solid grasp of the IR lifecycle (NIST 800-61) with experience coordinating incidents end-to-end, and experience building automation workflows (SOAR, Python/PowerShell) and drafting policies/SOPs in a regulated industry

  • Working knowledge of the APAC threat landscape (MITRE ATT&CK, Diamond Model) and one or more regulators/frameworks: MAS (Notice 655/127, TRM), HKIA (GL20), APRA (CPS 230/234), BNM (RMiT), NFRA, IRDAI

  • Familiarity with control frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, COBIT) and experience translating gap assessments into remediation plans

  • Excellent executive/technical/regulator communication and stakeholder management across cultures, time zones, and seniority levels; highly organized across parallel market workstreams

Nice to Have


  • Certifications (OSCP, OSEP, CISA, CRISC, CISM, CIPP/A, ISO 27001 LA/LI) or AI/ML certifications (Microsoft AI Engineer, Google ML Engineer)

  • AI/ML in cybersecurity (LLMs, NLP, anomaly detection), SOAR platforms (XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Microsoft Sentinel), and GenAI integration (Copilot for Security, OpenAI APIs); familiarity with AI governance frameworks (MAS FEAT, Singapore Model AI Governance Framework, OECD AI Principles)

  • Insurance/financial services background; cloud security/IR experience (AWS, Azure); experience with regulatory notifications, inspections, and thematic reviews

  • Experience harmonizing security/GRC frameworks across countries; infrastructure-as-code/DevSecOps exposure

title: Cleaning Tech – Property Management
description:
About the Role

We're hiring a Cleaning Technician to take ownership of cleanliness across our Milwaukee properties, with a strong focus on move-out and rent-ready cleans. This is primarily a cleaning role, with a smaller share of your time supporting grounds upkeep — and backing up our Landscaper entirely when they're out.

This is a full-time, field-based position, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. You'll be moving between all five of our Milwaukee properties regularly, working closely with our Landscaper counterpart, and reporting directly to Brittany, our Property Services Manager.

What You'll Do

  • Perform move-out cleans immediately after a resident vacates, including deep cleaning of refrigerators and stoves, so the renovation team can begin work without delay
  • Perform the final rent-ready clean once renovation work is complete, so the unit is genuinely move-in ready for the next resident
  • Clean common areas, hallways, and shared spaces across all five properties on a consistent schedule
  • Flag any cleanliness or condition issues you notice to Brittany
  • Walk each property regularly to spot and remove trash and debris
  • Assist with general grounds upkeep and snow removal support when the Landscaper needs an extra set of hands
  • Backup coverage: you and our Landscaper cover for each other. If they're out sick or running behind, we'll need you to step in on grounds tasks — including mowing — so things don't fall behind. It's part of how the two roles support each other.

Who This Role Is For

Strong fit if you:

  • Have real cleaning/janitorial experience and skill, and genuinely enjoy that work
  • Pay close attention to detail — move-out and final cleans need to be done right the first time
  • Are reliable, show up on time, and don't need to be reminded twice
  • Can step up and cover grounds work when your teammate is out, without complaint

Not a Fit For You

  • Are looking to grow into a renovation or repair technician role — this is a dedicated cleaning position
  • Want a role that's entirely grounds/landscaping-focused — that's our Landscaper position

Qualifications

  • Valid driver's license and reliable personal vehicle (required — you'll be moving between properties daily)
  • Personal cell phone for daily coordination and photo documentation (required)
  • Hands-on cleaning or janitorial experience preferred
  • Comfortable with physical work, including bending, lifting, and sustained standing
  • Reliable and on time, every day — this role depends on it, since the backup system only works if both people show up
  • Willing to step into grounds tasks when needed to cover for your counterpart
  • Authorized to work in the United States
  • A strong plus: experience cleaning in a multifamily or hospitality setting, or experience with move-out/turnover cleaning specifically

Pay

  • $16/hour to start
  • $18/hour automatically after your first 90 days
  • Monthly gas stipend for travel between properties

Benefits & Growth

  • Full benefits package (medical, dental, vision)
  • Generous PTO — above industry average
  • Uniform, tools, and equipment provided
  • Hands-on training and room to grow as our portfolio expands

A Final Note

We're a small, growing company that takes care of our people. We hire carefully because we want this to be a long-term fit — not a revolving door. If you bring real cleaning skill and care about doing it right, you'll thrive here.

Apply now!

title: Data Engineer

We look forward to welcoming your application.

title: Administratief Medewerker (Backoffice) 40 uur - Den Haag
description:

Jij krijgt energie van een administratieve baan waarin je snel alles leert over ons vak. Met jouw aanpak en inzet zorg je dat alles op tijd en foutloos wordt afgehandeld. Je werkt rustig en professioneel, ook als het druk is. Je voelt je thuis in een team waar de lijnen kort zijn.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Senior Principal / Staff Engineer — Watchtower Labs

In-person only - Bellevue, WA

U.S. Citizenship required (DoD Clearance preferable)


How to apply

Email jobs@watchtowerlabs.ai with three bullets that prove you can do this. No long intro. No generic claims. Only outcomes with evidence. For example, “Created a new approach to D: enabled capability E that didn’t exist before.”.


This is not a “backend engineer” role in the usual sense.


This is a seat for a creator: someone who can take an undefined, high-stakes problem and produce a working system that survives reality: load, edge cases, adversarial conditions, security constraints, and changing requirements.


If you need a perfect spec, gentle timelines, and a clean handoff chain, do not apply. If you want to build what doesn’t exist yet and you’re wired for hard problems, read on. Instruction for applying below.


The mission

We build simulation and autonomy infrastructure that supports critical outcomes for US defense. The work is demanding because the domain is demanding: uncertainty, complexity, speed, and correctness all at once.

The work

You will own core systems behind a multi-agent simulation engine:

  • Design primitives: orchestration, state, time, execution models, and scaling strategy
  • Build and run distributed services that must be reliable, observable, and secure
  • Drive performance until it hurts: profiling, contention, memory, throughput, p99s
  • Build infrastructure that behaves under stress, not just in a demo
  • Make calls with incomplete info and be right often enough to move fast
  • Lead by doing: you’ll ship critical pieces yourself and pull others up with you


The bar

We’re looking for rare engineering traits:

  • Architect-level judgment: you see failure modes before they happen
  • Relentless ownership: you fix what you touch, and you touch what matters
  • Grit: you don’t get fragile when the system fights back
  • Curiosity: you chase first principles, not vibes
  • Competitive excellence: you care about being great, not merely “done”


Proven track record of tangibly contributing to complex systems.


What you should bring

  • Deep experience building real systems in production (distributed, performance-sensitive, mission-critical)
  • Comfort working across C#/.NET Core, Linux, Python (or equivalent mastery + fast learning)
  • Strong mental model of systems: concurrency, networking, data integrity, deploy/release, observability
  • Ability to thrive in-person with a high-output team and high standards


What you will get

  • The kind of problems that force you to level up
  • A team that values builders and moves fast without lying to itself
  • Work with real consequences and real pride when it ships

title: Platform Bioinformatician
description:
About the Role

Join a multidisciplinary AI and life sciences team building the cloud data platform that turns clinical, genomic, imaging, and other biomedical data into reliable, model-ready assets. This hands-on role combines platform engineering, data infrastructure, and bioinformatics workflows to support internal teams and external partners.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate cloud data infrastructure, including object storage, lakehouse architecture, catalogs, lineage, versioning, and access layers.

  • Design and maintain governed data warehouses for clinical records, molecular features, metadata, and versioned dataset releases.

  • Develop reproducible omics pipelines for data such as whole-genome sequencing, RNA sequencing, and proteomics using containerized workflows and cloud batch compute.

  • Implement data quality checks, biological validation, and visualizations that help teams identify issues across processing steps.

  • Build and operate production cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD systems, and distributed workload orchestration, with attention to reliability, security, observability, and cost.

  • 5+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering, including operating cloud infrastructure in a high-growth startup or technically demanding environment.

  • Deep AWS or GCP experience, including production Kubernetes, and experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools.

  • Production programming experience in Python and/or Go, plus experience designing CI/CD pipelines and deployment systems.

  • Experience building job orchestration or scheduling systems for distributed workloads; GPU or machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus.

  • Familiarity with biological, clinical, or other sensitive data and production data pipelines. Experience with Nextflow or similar workflow managers, lakehouse and warehouse design, data catalogs, Docker, and cloud batch compute is relevant.

  • Python, R, SQL, and familiarity with standards such as OMOP or FHIR are useful.

Compensation & Benefits

Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

On-site in San Francisco, California, United States.

title: Graduate Knowledge Engineer
description:
About us

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

What you'll join

Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you?

If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance ground-breaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come.

What you'll do

  • Contribute to the development of AI-enabled data and knowledge management solutions for fusion research, helping to structure, improve and share scientific and engineering information using modern software and data technologies.

  • Work collaboratively with scientists, engineers and stakeholders to develop high-quality software and data solutions, apply best practices, research emerging technologies, and support the adoption of new tools and ways of working.

  • Deliver technical outputs through effective task management, documentation and presentations, while building technical, professional and stakeholder engagement skills in an inclusive, collaborative and innovative environment.

How you'll develop

On the graduate scheme here at the UK Atomic Energy Authority, you will have 20% of your time focused on professional and personal development. This will include a series of core development activities to fast track your business acumen, along with skills for technical, project management and people leadership.

The remaining 80% of time is role-based, working within a team growing your technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. Working with your line manager, you will get the opportunity to experience different roles and responsibilities within projects to broaden your understanding and help decide your future career route.

What you'll need

  • Degree in Physics, Engineering, Maths, Computer Science, or similar from 2025 to 2027
  • An interest in data, information and knowledge management and computing architectures.
  • Driven, with a strong appetite to learn and take on new challenges
  • Able to collaborate effectively and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

title: Client Service Associate
description:
The Private Client Service Associate (CSA) plays a critical role in delivering an exceptional client experience within the Private Client Group. This position serves as a primary and or secondary point of contact for clients, supports Managing Directors, and ensures smooth execution of all operational and administrative activities. The CSA is responsible for managing day-to-day client service needs, coordinating with custodians, preparing meeting materials, and contributing to the overall efficiency and professionalism of the team. This individual must be highly organized, detail oriented, solutions focused, exceptional team player, and committed to maintaining the highest standards of client service. This role also requires strong collaboration across departments to ensure alignment, efficiency, and seamless service delivery to clients.

Client Relationship & Service Support

• Opening and closing accounts

• Charitable gifting

• Trust distributions

• General account maintenance and documentation

Meeting Coordination & Client Deliverables

title: Graduate R&D Engineer
description:
About us

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

What you'll join

Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you?

If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance ground-breaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come.

What you'll do

The Technology Development Group are responsible for providing projects and programmes across the organisation with the skills and knowledge required to bring low maturity ideas through to application-ready engineering solutions. The projects we work on are diverse; supported by senior colleagues, your core responsibilities will include:

  • Develop knowledge and understanding of fusion relevant technical topics, applying knowledge learned to assigned projects.
  • Develop efficient and realisable testing programmes for major research and power-plant design programmes.
  • Define new test rig and facility requirements; support their development; and manage build, commissioning, and exploitation.
  • Deliver technology maturation projects from proof of concept through to commercially relevant technologies, including the planning and delivery of benchtop and lab-scale testing.
  • Operate and enhance our existing range of flexible test facilities.
  • Research potential applications of fusion technologies in other industries.

Due to the variety of our work, there’s no such thing as a typical day for our Technology Development Graduate Engineers but you can expect to leverage your curiosity and passion for continuous learning; work on projects in technical areas to which you may not have previously had exposure, and work in an innovation focused environment where there may be significant uncertainty and problems may be open-ended. If this appeals, we would like to hear from you.

How you'll develop

On the graduate scheme here at the UK Atomic Energy Authority, you will have 20% of your time focused on professional and personal development. This will include a series of core development activities to fast track your business acumen, along with skills for technical, project management and people leadership.

The remaining 80% of time is role-based, working within a team growing your technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. Working with your line manager, you will get the opportunity to experience different roles and responsibilities within projects to broaden your understanding and help decide your future career route.

What you'll need

  • Degree in Science or Engineering from 2025 to 2027.
  • Driven, with a strong appetite to learn and take on new challenges.
  • Able to collaborate effectively and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Well organised and adaptable with the ability to plan and prioritise workload.
