title: Head of Product
description:
Type:: Full-time

Location: Remote, with a preference for candidates located in NY, TX, MD, or GA

Compensation: $140,000 - $180,000

Job Level: Director/VP (depending on experience)

ABOUT LEMONTREE

There are more food pantries in the US than there are McDonalds, but most families facing hunger don’t take that help. That’s why we started Lemontree–because it makes no sense for our neighbors to go hungry when there’s free food around the corner. We’ve helped one million households access the free food in their communities by bringing technology + empathy to the experience of food assistance. Learn more about us at .

Our Values

Service Over Self

We put the mission — helping people find food — ahead of ego, credit, or agenda. That means caring for the people we serve and the team around us, and going the extra mile when it makes a real difference. We're here for the work itself and what it makes possible for others.

Ownership

We get shit done and we carry our piece so the whole team can move forward. When we make a mistake, we name it early and openly, because a problem we've owned out loud is one we can fix together. In a growing org, this kind of autonomy & accountability is how we do big things with a small team.

CuriosityWe don’t take anything for granted. We stay curious about our users and ourselves. We stay humble enough to accept that there’s always room to improve. We stay ready to change course when the evidence points somewhere new. The plan we have today is a strong draft, but we’ll always need to adapt to a changing world. We'd rather ask the better question and adjust than defend a stale answer.

THE POSITION

Lemontree is looking for a Head of Product& Technology that will partner with the Executive Director to own and evolve our platform strategy to scale our impact. Since 2020, we’ve grown from a simple helpline into a platform that serves thousands of families, partners, and volunteers daily. What we need now is someone who can shepherd us to the next level, bringing rigor and direction to how we evolve: sharper prioritization, better use of our data, and clearer decision-making & process around where we invest our resources. Every decision we make should align with our strategic anchors:

  1. User-centered
  2. Hospitality in every interaction
  3. Built for scale

This is a hands-on leadership role with high trust and high agency, reporting to the Executive Director. You'll be the person setting product direction and leading the charge to move it forward, partnering with an engineering agency on execution and collaborating closely across our broader Lemontree team. While product ownership is the focus, this is a multi-disciplinary position that combines product management, data analysis, and technical leadership to build toward stability and scalability. If you like operating with real autonomy and are motivated to take things from 1 → 100, this role will suit you.

What You'll Do

Drive technical leadership that delivers a reliable, joyful, scalable user experience for neighbors looking for food assistance.

  • Serve as a credible technical voice in conversations about architecture, tradeoffs, and feasibility.
  • Direct our engineering agency, translating product priorities into well-scoped technical work and holding a high bar for what ships.
  • Oversee third party services that support our product, including setting up integrations, managing billing, negotiating nonprofit discounts, etc.

Own a product roadmap that increases the breadth & depth of our impact, aligned with our organizational strategy.

  • Partner with CEO & senior leadership to shape overall strategy & product direction. Rather than making every single product decision, you will own the process that helps those decisions happen with the right information, clear accountability, and strong follow-through.
  • Define and prioritize product roadmap, ensuring usability, reliability, and scalability. We don't expect you to arrive with all the answers. We do expect you to ask good questions.
  • Oversee end-to-end product lifecycle management — from planning, requirement gathering, and design to deployment and maintenance. Maintain a reliable source of truth for priorities, roadmap status, key decisions, risks, dependencies, and open questions.

Lead our data & evaluation strategy to inform how our product evolves and how we measure our impact.

  • Lead our data strategy. We collect meaningful signals from the families and partners we serve, and we want someone who can turn it into decisions, not just dashboards.
  • Define useful measures of success and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand whether our work is having the intended effect.
  • Support teammates who are seeking answers to questions that inform their work.

Support cross-team communication & organizational decision-making infrastructure.

  • Build the cross-functional trust that makes great product work possible. Collaborate with all levels of the organization, and help the team stay close to the families we serve.
  • Bring structure to how we work. Improve how product decisions get made, how teams communicate across functions, and how we plan, without adding process for its own sake.
  • Communicate product vision and strategy to internal & external stakeholders. Make priorities, assumptions, and decision rationale visible and understandable across the organization.

Who You Are

  • You have 5–10 years of product & tech experience, including time owning the product function at an early stage small/mid-sized organization AND responsibility for aligning multiple functions around those goals (engineering, customer success, comms, etc).
  • You're energized by taking something that already works and making it even better. You’re genuinely motivated by solving problems, big and small, for other people–not just the flashy wins.
  • You’re a player-coach comfortable working on small teams, getting your hands dirty as the only product/tech person, and surfacing clarity out of ambiguity.
  • You know how to create leverage through modern AI tooling, strong technical judgment, and processes that support organizational health. You’re familiar with AI-assisted product development and know how to use AI coding tools to vibecode & build prototypes. We retain an engineering agency, but we’re looking to increase our internal technical capacity to speed up the process between idea → deployment.
  • You understand how to work with data–analytics experience is a plus. You know the right questions to ask and how to get from a number to a decision.
  • You bring process maturity with a light touch. You know which structures a nine-person organization actually needs and which ones would just slow us down.
  • You’ve got good design sense & a foundation in human-centered design principles including user research and insight-gathering skills (customer interviews, competitive analysis, segmentation).
  • You have firsthand experience dealing with food insecurity and/or navigating social services, and/or experience working at a nonprofit or mission-driven organization. Nothing can replace the value of lived experience with the problem we’re solving.

Why Lemontree

  • Compensation: $140k–$180k
  • Flexible, Remote Work Environment
    • Flexible scheduling within core business hours (Mon-Fri, 10am-4pm ET) and a culture that supports work-life balance.
    • While positions are currently remote, you’ll be expected to travel 1-3 per year for conferences and other team gatherings.
    • $300 annual equipment stipend
  • Benefits & Time Off
    • Generous employer-sponsored benefits including health, vision, and dental coverage and access to HSA and FSA.
    • Access to a 401k for retirement savings, plus a 4% employer match.
    • Unlimited time off, on top of 25-30 company holidays.
  • Culture & Mission
    • You’ll join a warm, collaborative team that puts our clients above everything else. Our culture is deeply human and humble, and we believe work should be a good place to be.

Our Interview Process (all conducted via Zoom)

  1. Intro Call (30 minutes)
  2. Technical Assignment + Interview (60 minutes)
  3. Deep-Dive Interview (80 minutes)
  4. Reference Check
  5. Closing Call (30 minutes)

Lemontree is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will get fair consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, citizenship status, or veteran status.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve, and we strongly encourage applications from people with lived experience of food insecurity. Further, we know that women and people of color are often less likely to apply to a position if they don’t match 100% of the job qualifications. Don’t let that be the reason you miss out on this opportunity! We encourage you to apply if you can demonstrate many of these skills and competencies.

As a tech nonprofit, we love innovation, and AI can be a great assistant–but you are the main event in this interview process. While we recognize AI as a valuable tool and encourage thoughtful use, over-reliance on it will not reflect your unique strengths. We encourage candidates to ensure their work reflects their own experiences and approach. We’re excited to learn more about YOU!

title: Senior AI Engineer with RAG and Agentic architectures
description:
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design and deliver LLM-powered applications and agentic systems that solve real problems for our users and teams. You'll work across the full applied-AI stack — from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and prompt design to multi-step agents that reason, use tools, and automate end-to-end workflows.

This is a senior builder's role. You'll take challenging use cases from an ambiguous problem to production: choosing the right models, implementing agentic architectures, wiring up retrieval and tooling, defining how we evaluate quality, and shipping reliable applications at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver production LLM applications — chat, copilots, assistants, and autonomous workflows — from concept to scale
  • Build and implement RAG pipelines: chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking, and grounding to reduce hallucination and improve relevance
  • Develop agentic architectures: multi-step reasoning, tool/function calling, planning, memory, and multi-agent orchestration
  • Contribute to the automation of business and engineering workflows using agentic AI and workflow automation
  • Define prompt and context strategies; build evaluation harnesses and uphold quality, latency, and cost standards
  • Integrate LLMs with internal data, APIs, and tools via connectors, function calling, and structured outputs
  • Implement guardrails, safety, and observability for AI systems (tracing, evals, monitoring for quality and drift)
  • Collaborate with product, data, and platform teams to turn ambiguous problems into shipped AI features
  • Share knowledge with fellow engineers and participate in design reviews

Requirements

  • 3+ years in software or ML engineering, including recent, hands-on experience building and shipping applications with LLMs
  • Proven experience delivering applied-AI systems end to end
  • Proficiency in Python at an advanced level
  • Hands-on background in building RAG systems — embeddings, retrieval, and reranking with vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, or pgvector)
  • Expertise in LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, or LlamaIndex)
  • Skills in designing agentic architectures — tool use, function calling, planning loops, and agent orchestration in production
  • Competency in automating workflows with agentic AI or workflow-automation tooling
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering and structured/JSON output techniques
  • Capability to design evaluations and reason about LLM quality, cost, and latency trade-offs at scale
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English (B2+ level)

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen)
  • Experience with fine-tuning, adapters (LoRA), or model distillation
  • Understanding of MLOps/LLMOps — deployment, versioning, and monitoring of AI systems, including model serving and inference optimization
  • Knowledge of AI safety, guardrails, and evaluation frameworks (Ragas, LangSmith, or promptfoo)
  • Background in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

CONTINUOUS UPSKILLING, LEARNING & DEVELOPMENT

  • Mentoring programs and leadership development
  • Certification and professional development support

title: Graduate HPC Computational Engineer
description:
About us

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

What you'll join

Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you?

If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance groundbreaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come.

What you'll do

  • Develop software, algorithms and scientific workflows for High Performance Computing (HPC) and High Throughput Computing (HTC) environments, helping to advance cutting-edge fusion research and simulation capabilities.
  • Build computational tools and software solutions to tackle complex engineering and scientific challenges, supporting the development of future fusion technologies.
  • Gain hands-on experience in software development, data analysis and emerging technologies, including AI, machine learning and advanced computing, while collaborating with experts across UKAEA, academia and industry.

How you'll develop

On the graduate scheme here at the UK Atomic Energy Authority, you will have 20% of your time focused on professional and personal development. This will include a series of core development activities to fast track your business acumen, along with skills for technical, project management and people leadership.

The remaining 80% of time is role-based, working within a team growing your technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. Working with your line manager, you will get the opportunity to experience different roles and responsibilities within projects to broaden your understanding and help decide your future career route.

What you'll need

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or Engineering from 2025 to 2027.
  • Driven, with a strong appetite to learn and take on new challenges.
  • Able to collaborate effectively and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Well organised and adaptable with the ability to plan and prioritise workload.

Benefits

We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include:

  • £35,227 base salary.
  • Final salary defined benefit scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution.
  • 25 days annual leave, plus 3 days Christmas closure and 2.5 privilege days, in addition to UK bank holidays.
  • Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions.
  • Take part in our Skern Lodge residential to develop new skills and build your network.

Our commitment to ED&I

UKAEA’s mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce. We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, while ensuring all appointments are made on merit.

UK Atomic Energy Authority is committed to being accessible. Please email earlycareerstalent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require any help or adjustments.

AI may be used for preparation purposes only. All responses submitted during interviews and assessments must be your own work.

To maintain a fair recruitment process, candidates are limited to two applications across our Early Careers programmes. If you apply for multiple roles, we may contact you to discuss which opportunities best match your skills and interests.

Applications are due to close at 23:59 on 8th November 2026. As we're expecting strong interest, we encourage you to apply early, as the vacancy may close sooner if we receive a high volume of applications. More information can be found here.

title: Middle DevOps Engineer (OpenShift, On-Prem) – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:

Tietoevry - BICS team has been growing since 2010… and we are looking forward to growing with you!

  • Support daily operations including trend analysis, root cause analysis, monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolution of platform issues to ensure high availability and reliability.
  • Implement and enforce security best practices, including RBAC, vulnerability management, and compliance controls.
  • Improve alerting, monitoring, and observability capabilities across OpenShift and related systems.
  • When OpenShift-related workload is limited, perform general system administration activities, including Linux server administration, infrastructure maintenance, and support of data center services as part of the infrastructure team.
  • Produce and maintain up-to-date documentation, including architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and runbooks.
  • Provide knowledge transfer, mentoring, and training to colleagues on OpenShift, GitLab, and related infrastructure technologies.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience or equivalent certifications (including Red Hat OpenShift), with at least 4 years in IT infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, particularly using GitLab CI and/or Jenkins.
  • Solid background in Linux system administration, especially Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), including design and maintenance of enterprise Linux infrastructure.
  • Practical experience with infrastructure automation using Ansible or similar tools.
  • Scripting skills using Bash and/or Python for automation and operational tasks.
  • Experience with GitOps practices and tools such as ArgoCD or Flux.
  • Ability to document architectures, configurations, and standards, and to develop and maintain SOPs and technical documentation.
  • Upper-intermediate level of English (both spoken and written).

Will be an advantage

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform is a plus.
  • Experience working with virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware) is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of ITIL Service Operations principles.
  • Experience with ArgoCD, monitoring/observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.), or disaster recovery tooling (optional but valuable).

Personality & Soft Skills

  • Solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong analytical and technical problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work autonomously with minimal guidance, operate at multiple levels of abstraction, and handle ambiguity effectively.
  • Ability to understand business drivers, stakeholder expectations, and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ability to balance strategic considerations with operational practicality.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; capable of influencing, guiding, and leading distributed technical teams.
  • Ability to produce high-quality architectural documentation and visual design diagrams (e.g., Visio).
  • Passionate about technology and its impact on business outcomes.
  • Highly motivated team player with a “can-do” attitude, dedication, transparency, and integrity.
  • Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment.

title: Area Leader of Recruiting - Charlotte
description:

The Area Leader of Recruiting is responsible for leading the full cycle recruiting process for restaurant management positions and providing strategic support for crewmember hiring within a specific market. This role partners directly with the area leadership to assess manpower needs, executes the near and long-term strategy including rolling out new programs and processes.

The physical work environment includes working in a fast-paced kitchen environment (which requires extended periods of physical exertion, such as walking, standing, lifting and bending) and interacting with customers. It also includes both inside and outside work in varied temperatures, working with and around food products, common allergens, industrial equipment, commercial cleaning products that require the use of personal protective equipment and physical activities necessary to complete the responsibilities of the job.

Your Impact and Responsibilities:

  • Creates a talent pipeline to coincide with the organization’s growth strategy
  • Owns the full cycle recruiting process for both internal and external candidates
  • Leads the New Restaurant Opening (NRO) crewmember hiring strategy to ensure staffing needs are met
  • Develops market and regional partnerships to support recruiting efforts in the region
  • Leads the restaurant management recruiting process to ensure consistency across all markets
  • Owns the manpower planning and talent selection process for the assigned area(s)
  • Builds the company employment brand and increases the presence within the communities through partnerships with universities, networking organizations, community-based organizations, vendors, etc.
  • Develops annual manpower plans for the area field-based support leader’s review on a quarterly basis
  • Cultivates strong working relationships with regional leadership and supports teams ensuring recruiting efforts are aligned with goals and objectives
  • Provides recruiting reporting to all internal stakeholders
  • Completes other duties as assigned

  • Detail-oriented, organized and able to manage multiple priorities that may be constantly changing
  • Self-driven, flexible, and highly energetic with strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills

  • Able to recognize problems, set goals, create plans and convert plans into action to solve problems
  • Proficient in a variety of technology systems including Microsoft Office (Excel, Word and Outlook) and ability to learn and adapt to new systems quickly
  • Able to work a variety of shifts including days, evenings and weekends
  • 3+ years of recruitment experience; restaurant experience preferred

title: Salesforce Solution Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Solution Architect to shape and deliver enterprise-scale solutions across the Salesforce ecosystem. In this role, you will translate complex business and technology needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable architectures, guiding programs from discovery and presales through implementation and continuous improvement. You will work with clients, business stakeholders, engineering teams, and platform leaders to establish solution direction, architectural governance, and measurable business value.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end architecture and solution design for complex Salesforce transformation programs
  • Drive discovery workshops, assess business and technical requirements, and define target-state architecture and delivery roadmaps
  • Design scalable solutions across the core Salesforce portfolio, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, together with one or more advanced capabilities such as Agentforce and Salesforce AI, Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Health Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, or other industry solutions
  • Define application, integration, data, security, identity, and environment strategies aligned with enterprise architecture standards
  • Architect AI-powered agents and workflows, including grounding, prompt and action design, trust controls, human oversight, observability, and responsible AI considerations
  • Design customer data solutions covering ingestion, harmonization, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, analytics, and governance
  • Shape quote-to-cash and revenue lifecycle solutions, including product catalog, pricing, configuration, contracts, orders, billing, and integrations with ERP and finance platforms
  • Provide architectural leadership throughout delivery, review solution designs, manage technical risks, and ensure adherence to Salesforce and engineering best practices
  • Guide integration patterns using APIs, events, middleware, and enterprise integration platforms such as MuleSoft
  • Partner with delivery leaders and stakeholders on estimates, scope, trade-offs, non-functional requirements, and release planning
  • Support presales activities by shaping solutions, contributing to proposals, estimates, presentations, and technical client discussions
  • Mentor engineers and architects, promote reusable assets, and contribute to communities of practice and capability development

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience delivering CRM or enterprise application solutions, including strong hands-on Salesforce expertise
  • 3+ years in a Salesforce architecture or comparable technical leadership role on complex, multi-cloud programs
  • Demonstrated experience designing Salesforce data models, sharing and security models, integrations, and scalable platform solutions
  • Strong practical expertise across the core Salesforce portfolio, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, is required. In addition, hands-on experience with at least one of the following is required: Agentforce and Salesforce AI, Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Health Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, or another Salesforce industry cloud
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce development and configuration capabilities, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, APIs, and event-driven patterns
  • Experience with architecture governance, non-functional requirements, DevOps and CI/CD, environment strategy, data migration, and release management
  • Ability to communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to both executive and engineering audiences
  • Proven client-facing, facilitation, consulting, and stakeholder management skills
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Nice to have

  • Experience with Salesforce Life Sciences, Health, Financial Services, Communications, Manufacturing, Automotive, or Consumer Goods solutions
  • Knowledge of AI governance, prompt engineering, agent testing, model evaluation, and production monitoring
  • Experience with MuleSoft, Tableau, Slack, ERP, data platforms, or hyperscale cloud services

title: Product Cyber Security Specialist
description:
Would you like to help shape cyber security across products, processes, and engineering practices in a growing technology company?

At INVISIO, we are strengthening our cyber security capabilities as part of our continued focus on secure product development, vulnerability management, and compliance with the Cyber Resilience Act.

We are therefore looking for a Product Cyber Security Specialist who can turn technical and regulatory requirements into clear, practical solutions.

We offer a self-driving role with broad responsibility, room for professional development, and the opportunity to contribute directly to INVISIO’s cyber resilience and compliance journey.

About the role

As our Product Cyber Security Specialist, you will play a key role in developing, documenting, and improving cyber security processes across INVISIO. Your main focus will be secure software development, vulnerability monitoring, and practical security guidance for our product and engineering teams.

This is a broad role where you will combine specialist knowledge with internal consultancy. You will work closely with colleagues across the organisation, supporting them with analysis, documentation, and hands-on recommendations that strengthen cyber resilience throughout the product development lifecycle.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Monitoring, assessing, and documenting vulnerabilities relevant to INVISIO products and systems
  • Supporting the development and maintenance of vulnerability management procedures
  • Contributing to secure software development lifecycle processes and documentation
  • Supporting INVISIO’s work related to the Cyber Resilience Act
  • Acting as an internal cyber security consultant for product development, software, and engineering teams
  • Preparing and maintaining cyber security policies, procedures, guidelines, and technical documentation
  • Supporting risk assessments and security impact analyses
  • Helping ensure that cyber security requirements are considered throughout the product development lifecycle
  • Following relevant standards, regulations, and best practices, including secure software development and industrial cyber security frameworks
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders across engineering, quality, compliance, and management.

About you

You bring broad cyber security knowledge, strong analytical skills, and the ability to translate technical requirements into clear and practical procedures.

You are structured, proactive, and able to turn complex cyber security topics into clear, practical guidance. You work independently, take ownership, and communicate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Due to the nature of INVISIO’s business, you must be able to obtain and maintain the required security clearance throughout your employment.

Required qualifications:

  • A relevant educational background, such as, (but not limited to), a Master’s degree in Cyber Security, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.
  • Knowledge of cyber security principles, secure software development, and vulnerability management
  • Strong technical and analytical skills
  • Good documentation and written communication skills
  • The ability to work independently and drive tasks forward
  • Good communication skills and the ability to advise stakeholders across different functions

It is an advantage if you have experience with one or more of the following:

  • The Cyber Resilience Act
  • Secure Software Development Lifecycle processes
  • Vulnerability management and vulnerability disclosure processes
  • IEC 62443 or other industrial cyber security standards
  • Product security or embedded systems security
  • Risk assessment methods and cyber security compliance
  • Security documentation for regulated products or systems

What we offer

You will become part of an international, growing tech company developing advanced communication solutions trusted by defense and public safety professionals around the world.

You can expect:

  • A high degree of responsibility, autonomy, and influence in your role.
  • Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international, high-tech environment.
  • Opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.
  • A culture built on passion, innovation, working as one team and putting the customer first.
  • A flexible working environment, primarily based at our headquarters in Hvidovre, Copenhagen, with the possibility of working from home when appropriate.

Additional information

The position is based at our headquarters in Hvidovre, Copenhagen. Please note that we do not offer relocation assistance.

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the selected candidate.

How to apply

Please submit your application through the link before Oct. 30, 2026. A cover letter is not required. Instead, we encourage you to include a short introduction and tell us about your motivation for the role in your CV.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. All candidates will be notified by email, so please remember to check your spam folder.

We believe in equal opportunities for all and encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

title: Castor Assembly- 2nd Shift
description:
Position Summary & Objective

Assemble and disassemble large pieces of steel equipment. Assembles and fits components according to assembly blueprints, manuals, engineering memos, sketches, and knowledge of machine construction to construct, rebuild, and repair machines and equipment, using hand tools and power tools.

Essential Functions Performed by the Position

  • Able to read, understand, and interpret blueprints.
  • Able to read and understanding of ID/OD Micrometers, Calibers, radius gages, parallels, and Telescopic measures. Proficient in using a variety of in process inspection equipment and assembly tools. Verifies conformance of parts to stock list and blueprints, using measuring instruments, such as calipers, gauges, and micrometers.
  • Must be able to work with solvents and paints and how to apply them in a proper manner.
  • Shot blast and paint.
  • Capable of using a drill press to tap/drill holes per the layout.
  • Knowledge of piping and tubing for lube and hydraulic process required for disassembly.
  • Able to mechanically use overhead cranes and forklifts safely.
  • Ability to work with grease and grime under relatively adverse physical conditions.
  • Aligns components for assembly, manually or with hoist, and bolts, screws, dowels, using hand tools, or arranges for assembly by welder and electrician.
  • Removes high spots, and smoots surfaces, using chisels, scrapers, files, and powered hand grinder. Assembles, sets up, and operates machine to verify functioning, machine capabilities, and conformance to customer's specifications.
  • Form, bend and fasten piping, fixtures, and attachments required to service machine with air, water, and oil. May bend and install pipe for hydraulic systems.
  • Work as member of team in the part of fabrication process.
  • Verifies alignment and tolerances of moving parts, using measuring instruments, such as dial indicators and thickness gauges.
  • Installs moving parts, such as shafts, levers, or bearings, and works them to test free movement and operation of assembly by hand. Test or assist in testing operation of completed product.
  • Align and mesh gears in gearbox to assemble system of gears.
  • Mounts and connects auxiliary, mechanical, electrical, electronic, pneumatic, or hydraulic equipment, cuts and fits pipe and tubing.
  • Test or assist in testing operation of completed product.
  • Ability to verbally communicate with team members, supervisors, and Engineers.
  • Must have good safety awareness techniques.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Must have mechanical ability to proficiently use cranes and other heavy tools and equipment that are normally required in the daily assembly and disassembly operations.
  • Own tools of the trade, and the ability to use them effectively.
  • Ability to use judgment to plan, perform and make decisions as to the sequence of operations and processes within the limitations of established or standard methods and procedures.
  • Must be able to interpret customer prints well enough to determine sequence for variety of heavy equipment.
  • Basic computer skills and ability to use basic shop math.
  • Possess the physical strength and ability to safely handle heavy equipment and tools.
  • Knowledge of hydraulics and tubing
  • Able to wear a respirator during painting and shot blast process.

Required Education and Experience

A high school diploma or equivalent.

5 years mechanical assembly and disassembly experience.

The benefits of joining our team

Because we seek to hire the best people, we work hard to provide benefits that make their lives better, so we offer a comprehensive benefit program which features:

  • health coverage for you and your family through medical, dental and vision plans
  • a 401(k) plan in with a generous company match
  • financial protection through disability, life, and accidental death & dismemberment insurance plans
  • tax advantages through flexible spending accounts that allow you to pay for specific health-care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars
  • a generous paid time off program in which the benefits increase along with your tenure with the company

When you join our team, you do more than simply switch companies to progress your career. You become part of our family, a group of talented women and men who drive business success.

All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. title: Founding Operations Lead
description:
San Francisco · In-person

AgentMail is looking for an extremely high-agency generalist to work alongside our founders and early team.

There is no clean job description for this role - and that’s intentional.

We’re a small team building a rapidly growing company. Every week there are hundreds of things outside of writing code and talking to customers that need to happen for the company to move quickly. Your job is to own them.

That could mean planning a company offsite, coordinating a candidate’s visit to San Francisco, helping us move into a new office, researching something for a founder, negotiating with a vendor, organizing a developer event, or making sure the office is stocked before the team gets in.

As AgentMail grows, the problems will change. We want someone who gets excited by that.

You’ll own things like

Company operations. Make AgentMail an exceptionally well-run place to work. Own our office, vendors, equipment, supplies, food, onboarding logistics, and the hundred small things that make a company function.

Founder operations. Help the founders execute quickly on things that fall between functions - research, coordination, travel, reservations, scheduling, logistics, and one-off projects.

Hiring & candidate experience. Help us create an incredible experience for people interviewing at AgentMail, from coordinating visits to candidate dinners and work trials.

Events & community. Help organize team events, developer dinners, hackathons, offsites, celebrations, and other things we want to make happen.

Special projects. Take ambiguous problems and run with them. These might have nothing to do with one another. That’s part of the job.

The common thread is ownership.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone unusually resourceful.

You:

  • See a problem and immediately start figuring out how to solve it.

  • Don’t need a playbook before you can act.

  • Are extremely organized and reliable.

  • Move quickly without becoming sloppy.

  • Have excellent judgment.

  • Have excellent taste.

  • Notice details other people miss.

  • Are comfortable picking up the phone, negotiating, researching, and asking for what you need.

  • Can juggle ten completely different things without losing track of them.

  • Communicate clearly and concisely.

You don’t need to have worked in operations before.

Why AgentMail

You’ll work directly alongside the founders and early team of a fast-growing developer infrastructure company.

You’ll get exposure to almost every part of building a company: hiring, recruiting, finance, events, people, vendors, operations, launches, and whatever comes next.

You’ll have an unusual amount of responsibility early.

And there isn’t a predetermined box you have to stay inside.

As the company grows, we expect this role to grow with it. If you become exceptional at recruiting, you can own more recruiting. If you’re great at company operations, you can build that function. If you discover you’re exceptional at something we haven’t thought of yet, we’ll give you room to run with it.

This is a great role for someone who wants to learn how a company gets built from the inside - and would rather be thrown into the middle of it than watch from the sidelines.

Come build with us.

title: VP, Call and Clinical Operations - FuzeRx
description:
Job Summary

About Fuze Health
At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.

Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.

Job Description
The VP, Call & Clinical Operations is a critical executive leadership role at FuzeRx, reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer. This position leads one of two core operational verticals, directing a 24/7 unified workforce of 450+ Care Agents and Licensed Clinical Professionals (pharmacists, nurses, and social workers).

The successful candidate will build and scale the infrastructure required to support rapid organizational growth, adapt to shifting business priorities, and maintain standardized, high-quality performance. This leader balances cost, quality, and service level agreements (SLAs) while driving both inbound call resolution and revenue-generating outbound strategies. As the primary champion for operational maturity, this executive ensures compassionate, compliant patient engagement while harmonizing processes across legacy Truepill and Alto entities.



Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Operations Strategy & Vertical Leadership: Oversee and direct the Clinical Call and Clinical Operations vertical across legacy TruePill and Alto, representing a unified workforce of +450 agents with 24/7 coverage.

  • Operational Maturity & Scaling: Serve as the primary driver for operational maturity, compassionate and compliant patient engagement and the execution of high-priority clinical and business initiatives.

  • Staffing & Capacity Management: Direct complex staffing and capacity strategies for over 450 care agents and licensed clinical professionals (pharmacists, nurses, and social workers) to balance cost, service, quality, and growth.

  • Standardized Performance & Quality: Ensure high quality, standardized performance across a large work-from-home team, harmonizing and modernizing operational processes to standardize Rx contact center SOPs.

  • Regulatory Compliance & Safety: Maintain rigorous regulatory compliance and state board and DEA standards.

  • Continuous Improvement: Formalize and lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity and drive operational efficiency.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Compliance, Legal, HR, Finance, and other senior leaders to align launch timelines with execution readiness.

  • People Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing leadership team.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Executive Leadership: 10+ years of progressive executive experience leading complex, large-scale clinical call centers, clinical operations, or pharmacy operations in high-growth, matrixed organizations.

  • Scale & Scope Experience: Proven track record managing large, remote or hybrid multi-site teams (400+ FTEs) operating in a 24/7 high-volume environment.

  • Pharmacy Background (preferred): Graduate of an accredited school of pharmacy and a Licensed Pharmacist (RPh) in good standing with the State Board of Pharmacy in at least one state of operation with willingness to obtain additional Non-Resident Licenses as dictated by business strategy.

  • Operational Excellence: Deep success and expertise in process engineering, quality management systems, managing multi-site/high-volume pharmacy fulfillment, and operational scaling.

  • Compliance & Regulatory Expertise: Experience maintaining pharmacy compliance and interacting with regulatory authorities (State Boards of Pharmacy, DEA).

  • Change Management: Exceptional ability to navigate cultural alignment risks and lead through organizational transformations.

  • Strategic Communication: Strong ability to define clear decision rights, influence across all levels of a matrix organization, and partner with senior stakeholders.

  • Education: Advanced degree in Business, Operations, Pharmacy, or a related field.



Additional Information

Additional Physical Job Requirements

Physical requirements for this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, periodically move away from the computer terminal for in-person meetings, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move objects up to 50 pounds. The role also requires the ability to effectively communicate through verbal interactions, discern auditory information, and visually perceive details to perform essential job functions.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and similar applicable state laws, it is Fuze Health’s policy to provide reasonable accommodation to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship.

Salary and Benefits

Salary Range: $171,000 - $257,000

Commission Eligible: No

Travel: Yes - Required up to 25% of the time

Location Requirement:

  • Fuze Health (Truepill / Fuze Care Services) is limited to individuals residing in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Vermont, Virginia, Wisconsin

Employment Authorization Requirement: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. Alto Pharmacy, Fuze Health, LetsGetChecked, and Fuze Care Services can not take over, transfer, or sponsor any visa type at this time.

Benefits:

Full-time employee benefits include: dental, vision, and multiple group medical plans to choose from, a 401(k) retirement savings plan, group life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, flexible spending account (FSA) and health savings account (HSA), commuter benefits, employer-paid short-term (STD) and long-term disability (LTD) insurance, and additional supplemental insurance plans (spouse life insurance, legal insurance, an employee assistance program, home health testing kits, and a fertility medication discount program). Employees are also provided flexible vacation time, accrued paid sick time, 10 paid holidays, (2 floating holidays for full time non-exempt employees) , and eight weeks of paid parental leave for eligible employees, additional paid weeks for the birthing parent, 4 weeks paid caregiver leave, and a Lifestyle Spending Account allowance each month.

More Benefits Information Here: Fuze Health Benefits Site

The application deadline is 15 October 2026. This application deadline may be extended based on business needs.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Fuze Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation during any portion of the application or hiring process, please contact us at .

Fuze Health considers qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment and conducts background checks consistent with applicable law, including the California, Los Angeles County, San Francisco, Philadelphia, and New York City Fair Chance laws. We are an E-Verify participating company.

Use of Automated Decision Tools

Fuze Health recruiters and hiring managers may use automated decision tools to help identify candidates who match the stated job requirements, and to what extent. These tools are designed to help ensure fairness in all aspects of the hiring process by providing recruiters and hiring managers with data-backed insights based on information provided in your resume, including work experience, education, and other skills. Fuze Health does not use automated decision tools to make hiring decisions; hiring decisions always involve human review and input. title: Inflight Procedures Controller
description:
Exceptional service is designed, not improvised. As Inflight Procedures Controller, you will help shape how the Etihad guest experience is conceived, tested and brought to life onboard, translating service concepts into procedures that work seamlessly across the network. The successful candidate will be a hospitality professional who combines creative thinking with operational insight, and who is driven to design experiences that guests remember.

  • Translate service development projects into operationally feasible and efficient service procedures that deliver the intended guest experience, while continuously refining existing procedures.
  • Develop and maintain service manuals and supporting reference materials, ensuring accuracy and consistency across all channels.
  • Champion process improvement across the documentation lifecycle and the adoption of new digital and visual formats for service information, ensuring content remains engaging, accessible and relevant to its audience.
  • Conduct trend analysis and benchmarking to inform the development of hospitality standards and service propositions that keep Etihad ahead of the curve.
  • Support the prototyping and validation of new product and service concepts through testing and customer feedback, converting outcomes into clear and practical standards.

  • Conduct onboard audits, design surveys and analyze findings to validate standards compliance and identify opportunities to improve guest experience.
  • Degree in Hospitality Management, Communications, Business or a related field.
  • A minimum of four years' cabin crew experience in a supervisory capacity, must maintain their flying license.
  • Experience in document control, administration, and writing standards (desired).
  • PMI/PMP certification or project management experience is highly desirable.
  • Working knowledge of data analytics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insight.
  • Superior written and verbal English communication skills are required.
  • A customer-obsessed mindset and a genuine passion for hospitality excellence.
  • A detail-oriented, logical thinker with a structured approach to problem-solving.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.

title: Staff Backend Engineer, ML Inference Systems
description:
The opportunity

Every day, we connect billions of players with the games and experiences they love.

Our Vector Gamer AI team sits at the heart of that mission, governing ad ranking and bidding decisions across billions of daily impressions, where large-scale machine learning and real-world impact converge at scale.

We’re hiring a Staff Backend Engineer to build and operate the infrastructure those models depend on. You’ll design and operate the distributed systems that power billions of daily decisions, with a focus on the performance, reliability, and scalability of inference systems.

Join us and help influence how billions of gaming experiences are discovered, monetized, and how creators are rewarded.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, develop, and deploy production-grade backend services and distributed systems powering large-scale online model inference at billions of daily requests

  • Drive technical direction of our inference platform, with a focus on low-latency, high‑throughput serving infrastructure

  • Partner with ML engineers to ensure online serving infrastructure scales with growing model complexity and inference volumes, without compromising latency or throughput

  • Ensure the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our systems in production using monitoring and observability tools like Prometheus and Grafana

  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure on GCP, orchestrating workloads with Kubernetes across a high‑scale production environment

  • Promote and implement best practices for backend service development, testing, deployment, and monitoring (DevOps, SRE)

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years designing, deploying, and maintaining distributed systems at scale

  • Expertise in Golang for building high‑performance, low‑latency backend infrastructure

  • Hands‑on experience with cloud infrastructure on GCP and workload orchestration with Kubernetes

  • Strong grounding in monitoring and observability tooling, including Prometheus and Grafana

  • Experience in ad tech, recommender systems, real‑time personalization, or other performance‑critical domains

  • Familiarity with microservice architectures, containerization (Docker), and CI/CD best practices

  • Familiarity with machine learning platforms, workflows, and serving infrastructure

You might also have

  • Experience with ML inference servers like NVIDIA Triton Inference Server

  • Familiarity with auction mechanics or bidding systems in an ad tech context

Additional information

Relocation support is not available for this position
Gross pay annually: USD $244,500-$317,800

This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.

Benefits

At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well‑being and work‑life balance.

Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status.

title: Southeast Alaska Community Engagement Coordinator
description:
This is an exciting opportunity to work alongside a dynamic team to help conserve and restore Southeast Alaska’s salmon and steelhead rivers. The Southeast Alaska Community Engagement Coordinator is responsible for engaging the public in conservation and restoration opportunities.


This person will represent TU throughout the region, plan, attend and host events and activities that build community connections, share information and stories supporting habitat conservation and restoration, and develop sustaining community partnerships.


They will connect with Southeast Alaska community leaders, business owners, anglers and hunters, partners, and visitors to convey the importance of restoring and conserving fish habitat to southeast Alaska’s economy, communities, and fishing opportunities.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, and a reliable self-starter who enjoys interacting with a wide variety of people. They have experience and skills in a range of public outreach tactics, exceptional communication and “people” skills, strong writing skills and have a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision. They have a good sense of humor, knowledge of and passion for salmon and trout in Southeast Alaska and are excited to contribute to a fish-filled future for Alaska.


This is a part-time (less than 30 hrs/week), remote position, and candidates must be based in Southeast Alaska. Seasonal flexibility considered for the right candidate.


Duties and responsibilities

  • Plan and implement Trout Unlimited’s community engagement activities in Southeast Alaska.
  • Educate and engage anglers and community members in fish habitat conservation and restoration.
  • Host events and regularly attend relevant community events that build support for fish habitat conservation and restoration.
  • Grow a volunteer network of people who will help advance conservation and restoration objectives in Southeast Alaska.
  • Develop new and help maintain existing partnerships.
  • Support America’s Salmon Forest social media presence through robust digital content creation and storytelling.
  • Work on collaborative communications projects with the Alaska communications director to tell the story of America’s Salmon Forest.
  • Represent TU in an inclusive and conscientious manner that is consistent with the organization’s brand, approach, mission, and goals.

This is not an all-inclusive list of duties and responsibilities.

title: AI Solution/Principal Engineer
description:
We are seeking an AI Solution/Principal Engineer to join a team building a sovereign, multi-tenant agentic AI platform together with the applied products running on top of it. Every component ships under strict data residency constraints and operates in both Arabic and English. Our squads are small and senior, and we need someone who owns how the organization knows its AI systems perform — evaluation across assistants, retrieval pipelines, agent workflows, voice and document systems, and the infrastructure that transforms "it seems better" into evidence someone can act on.

This is not a QA role with AI added. Test automation and performance testing are in scope, but the center of gravity is evaluating non-deterministic systems, where the same input produces different outputs, "correct" is often fuzzy, and failure modes such as hallucination, grounding failure, drift, and prompt injection are ones no assertion library catches.

Responsibilities

  • Define evaluation strategy: what gets measured, at which layer, with what methodology, and how results feed product decisions
  • Build the shared platform, covering evaluation harnesses, golden-set management, dataset versioning, automated grading, regression detection, and reporting leadership can read
  • Ensure grading is trustworthy through judge model selection, rubric design, calibration against human labels, and knowing when automated grading cannot be trusted
  • Assess retrieval and agents for grounding and citation correctness, tool-use validation, multi-step reasoning and failure recovery
  • Create Arabic golden sets and judges calibrated for Arabic rather than assumed to transfer from English
  • Execute online evaluation and drift detection
  • Perform prompt injection, jailbreak and data-leakage red-teaming
  • Integrate evaluation and test automation together as quality gates in CI/CD

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience building evaluation or test infrastructure others depend on, including harnesses, shared libraries and frameworks
  • At least 1 year of relevant leadership experience
  • Expertise in AI evaluation spanning output quality, retrieval and grounding, and regression detection on non-deterministic behavior
  • Proficiency in LLM-as-judge methodology: rubric design, calibration against human labels, and understanding of its failure modes
  • Proficiency in Python at an advanced level, deep enough to build shared libraries, with intermediate competency in TypeScript or Java
  • Knowledge of statistics for non-deterministic systems, covering sampling, confidence intervals, inter-rater agreement and significance
  • Skills in CI/CD framework design across API, web and data surfaces, with test selection, parallelization and flake management
  • Background in golden sets and dataset versioning
  • Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with ragas, DeepEval, Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith or Langfuse tools
  • Expertise in Arabic evaluation, spanning golden sets, dialect coverage, right-to-left validation and judge calibration
  • Background in adversarial and security testing, including red-teaming practices
  • Capability to carry out voice and conversational evaluation, plus performance testing against AI services
  • Showcase of delivery in a regulated or government environment

Benefits

CONTINUOUS UPSKILLING, LEARNING & DEVELOPMENT

  • Diversity of tasks and projects
  • Assessment center for objective review of competency level
  • Personal development plan
  • Mentoring programs and leadership development
  • Certification and professional development support
  • Access to learning platforms including more than 2,500 internal courses
  • English courses taught by certified teachers

CORPORATE BENEFITS

  • Extra leave days
  • Referral bonuses

COMPENSATION PACKAGE

  • Competitive compensation paid in USD
  • Regular salary and performance reviews

MEDICAL & HEALTHCARE

  • Private health insurance
  • Well-being events

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

  • Tea, coffee and snacks
  • Sports equipment and game consoles

title: Education Coordinator - Cardiac Transplant ICU Full-time Rotating
description:

title: Genopslag - Ny præst søges til Veerst-Bække Pastorat pr. 1. februar 2027
description:
Tidspunkt: 08:00-

Søger du et præsteembede, hvor fællesskab, samarbejde og gode arbejdsvilkår vægtes højt? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til Veerst-Bække Pastorat.

Genopslag - Sognepræst i Veerst-Bække Pastorat, Malt Provsti, Ribe Stift

Stillingen som tjenestemandsansat sognepræst i Veerst-Bække Pastorat, Malt Provsti er ledig til besættelse den 1. februar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Til stillingen er knyttet en forpligtelse som kirkebogsfører og begravelsesmyndighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling.

Som ny sognepræst får du et introduktionsforløb, hvor du får en mentor, der guider dig igennem i den første tid i embedet og sætter dig nærmere ind i de forskellige arbejdsopgaver, der er for en præst.

Har du lyst til at læse mere om Veerst- og Bække, kan du også orientere dig på sognenes hjemmeside Veerst-bylaug FORSIDE og Bække – Verdens bedste flække eller på sogn.dk - Veerst Sogn og Bække Sogn.

Embedsbeskrivelsen kan du også læse på Ribe Stifts hjemmeside Ribe Stift: Ledige stillinger og via Stiftets Facebook-side.

Stillingen er omfattet af Bekendtgørelse af lov om ansættelse i stillinger i folkekirken m.v. (LBK nr. 864 af 25/6/2013)

Stillingen aflønnes efter løngruppe 1 i aftale om aflønning af tjenestemandsansatte præster i folkekirken.

Ud over selve lønnen ydes et rådighedstillæg med et afrundet grundbeløb pr. 31. marts 2012 for en fuldtidsstilling på kr. 43.000,00 årligt. Ved deltidsansættelse vil der ske beregning af tillægget i forhold til ansættelseskvoten.

Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om Ny Løn, hvorfor det er muligt at ønske en lønforhandling.

Der er knyttet tjenestebolig til stillingen. Tjenesteboligen ligger på adressen Søndergade 15, 6622 Bække.

Boligbidraget for tjenesteboligen excl. udgifter til el, vand og varme udgør på nuværende tidspunkt kr. 4.550,00.
Tjenesteboligen er nyvurderet.

Det forudsættes, at ansøgere har kørekort til almindelig bil (B) og er villig til at bruge egen bil i jobbet.

Er du endnu ikke ordineret, bedes du sende kopi af eksamenspapirer og attest fra Pastoralseminariet sammen med din ansøgning.

Hvis du indstilles til stillingen, vil der blive indhentet børneattest.

Alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset køn opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Er du interesseret i stillingen og ønsker at sende en ansøgning, bedes du kontakte både menighedsråd og provst for at aftale et tidspunkt for et besøg og en samtale, inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Er det første gang du søger embede, bedes du kontakte biskoppens sekretær for at aftale et tidspunkt for en samtale med biskop Elof Westergaard, ligeledes inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Ansøgningen skal stiles til Kirkeministeriet, men skal sendes til biskoppen over Ribe Stift pr. mail til: kmrib@km.dk. Ansøgningen skal være biskoppen i hænde senest opslagets udløbsdato kl. 15.00.

Embedsbeskrivelse:

Embedsbeskrivelse – Veerst og Bække Pastorat
Velkommen i vores to landsbysogne beliggende midt på den jyske højderyg. Her mærkes historiens vingesus med runesten, gravhøje og skibssætning. Området besøges af en del turister – særligt vandrere – da både Kyst til Kyst Stien og Hærvejen går lige igennem vores sogne. Bække Kirke er vejkirke og ligger på Klosterruten og Pilgrimsruten.

Præsteboligen
Præsteboligen ligger umiddelbart ved siden af kirken og Sognehuset i Bække.
Herfra er der 30 min. til Billund, 35 min. til Vejle, 25 min. til Kolding, 15 min. til Vejen og 40 min til Esbjerg.
Præsteboligen på 215 kvadratmeter er en charmerende rødstensvilla i to etager. Huset har sjæl med stor hall, tre stuer med afhøvlede gulve, nyt køkken, og et stort lyst kontor med egen indgang. På første sal findes blandt andet et stort soveværelse med udgang til balkon hvorfra der er udsigt over den store smukke præstegårdshave.

Vi søger dig, der…

  • Brænder for at videreudvikle kirkelivet i Veerst og Bække Sogne
  • Kan forestille dig at bo i en præstebolig centralt beliggende i Bække
  • Har lyst til at engagere dig og være synlig i vores lokalsamfund.
  • Er god til at kommunikere og samarbejde
  • Er selvstændig og systematisk og har et godt overblik.
  • Har sans for pædagogik og har stor lyst til det kirkelige børne- og ungdomsarbejde
  • Formidler evangeliet på en vedkommende måde i et nutidigt sprog
  • Er åben over for alternative gudstjenesteformer og gudstjenesterum
  • Kan se muligheder og perspektiver i, at både Veerst og Bække er ”Grønne kirker”

Fem gode grunde til at vælge at blive præst i Veerst og Bække

  • Der et godt og frugtbart udvidet samarbejde med præsten i nabosognet Gesten, hvilket bl.a. giver fleksibilitet i arbejdet. Desuden bliver du en del af et ferieteam.
  • Du får dygtige og engagerede kolleger, som dagligt arbejder for at gøre Veerst og Bække Kirker til gode arbejdspladser.
  • Der er ét konfirmandhold
  • Du bliver en del af to velfungerende menighedsråd, som er forskellige, men som har et godt og konstruktivt samarbejde blandt andet om kirkeblad, præsteboligen og præsteskoven.
  • Vores menighedsrådsmøder er et arbejdende fællesskab, hvor vi skal træffe beslutninger og have noget fra hånden, men vi lægger stor vægt på, at der er en god stemning med plads til sjov og humor.

Aktiviteter i de to sogne
Vi vil først og fremmest være åbne og lyttende over for de ideer, du kommer med, men af nuværende aktiviteter kan nævnes: Høstgudstjeneste i Præsteskoven, Halloweenarrangement for børn i Sognehuset, koncerter og foredrag, sogneeftermiddage i sommerferien for byens ældre, plejehjemsgudstjenester, Godnat i kirken for de yngste, babysalmesang, tapasgudstjeneste i Veerst skærtorsdag og juletræstænding 1. søndag i advent i begge sogne.

I Bække møder du

  • En landsby med 1540 indbyggere
  • En middelalderkirke med plads til 150 personer
  • Velfungerende dagplejetilbud
  • Hærvejens Skole- og dagtilbud med vuggestue, børnehave og skole fra 0. – 9. klasse
  • Fritidstilbud med hal og træningscenter, samt diverse foreninger
  • En stor, aktiv KFUM-Spejder Gruppe med fine faciliteter
  • En veldrevet og velassorteret Daglig Brugs

I Veerst møder du

  • En landsby med 536 indbyggere,
  • En kirke fra 1896 med plads til 175 personer
  • En meget smuk og anderledes kirkegård med plads til ”vild med vilje”.
  • Præsteskoven
  • Veerst Bylaug, Veerst Teater- og kulturforening samt Veerst Lokalråd
  • Forsamlingshus med jævnlige arrangementer

title: B2 Aircraft Engineer (with Base Maintenance Experience)
description:
We’re looking for experienced and certifying B2 Aircraft Engineers with Base Maintenance experience. This is your opportunity to work across one of the world’s most advanced and diverse fleets — contributing to the innovation and technical excellence powering Etihad’s next chapter.

As an Aircraft Engineer, you will be responsible for performing and certifying maintenance activities in line with Etihad’s authorization policy. You’ll also lead and guide Aircraft Technicians, ensuring all maintenance is carried out safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with regulatory and technical standards.

Accountabilities

  • Certify own work and the work of others after verifying that tasks have been performed in accordance with approved data and within the scope of authorization.
  • Complete all documentation accurately and on time, in accordance with company procedures.
  • Carry out maintenance in compliance with company, health and safety, and airport regulations.
  • Ensure all materials, parts, tools, equipment, and documentation are prepared at the start of each shift.
  • Maintain a clean and hazard-free environment to prevent Foreign Object Damage (FOD).
  • Provide guidance and assistance to Technicians to ensure safe and effective working practices.
  • Ensure equipment and work areas are maintained in a clean, serviceable, and safe condition.
  • Demonstrate a professional approach when interacting with colleagues, stakeholders, and customers.
  • Participate in training and development to enhance technical capability and professional contribution.
  • Adhere to company health, safety, and corporate image standards at all times.
  • Conduct inspections as required on Ground Support Equipment (GSE) and complete relevant checklists.
  • Perform daily inspections of company vehicles prior to use and complete the Vehicle Maintenance Inspection form.
  • Ensure all work performed under Etihad’s processes and procedures is completed safely and in line with quality standards.
  • Actively follow and promote the procedures outlined in the Safety & Quality Management Manual (SQMM).
  • Encourage a culture of safety and positive reporting across the team.
  • High School Leaving Certificate / Diploma / University or College Degree.
  • Valid Aircraft Maintenance License (GCAA / EASA Part-66 / ICAO Type convertible to GCAA).
  • Minimum of 7–10 years of aircraft maintenance experience, including at least 5 years of overall certifying experience in a Base/Light Maintenance environment.
  • Minimum of 2-3 years of certifying experience on at least 2 of Etihad aircraft type ratings (Level 3) — Airbus 320 / 330 NEO / 350 / 380, Boeing 777 / 787 — with valid company authorization.
  • Excellent communication skills and a strong teamwork mindset with a commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.

To learn more visit

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Product Analyst, Agentic AI
description:
IntegriChain's Product Management team is hiring a Product Analyst for Prism, our conversational analytics platform. Prism lets people who work in market access at life sciences companies ask questions about their data in plain English and get answers in seconds, instead of sending the request to an analyst and waiting. Behind the scenes, Prism runs on semantic layers we build from our raw SQL data. Those layers are what let it take a business question and map it to the right numbers. The Product Analyst makes sure the questions people ask actually line up with the answers Prism gives back. You'll work every day with Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering to keep those answers accurate and worth trusting.

This isn't a development role, and it isn't about building reports or dashboards. It's an analysis job for someone who's technical but isn't a software engineer. You'll use Snowflake Cortex, along with tools like Claude and Codex, to review and improve the prompts business users type into Prism and the answers it sends back. Much of the work is finding places where the way the data is set up leads Prism to misread a question or return the wrong answer. About half the job is digging into the data. The other half is talking with business owners, certifying that queries return the right results, and writing up what needs to change.

What you'll do

  • Prompt review: Go through the prompts business users type into Prism and improve them with Snowflake Cortex, Claude, Codex, and similar tools, so their questions get read correctly against the semantic layer.
  • Query certification: Check the queries users run and the answers Prism gives back against the source data, then sign off so the business can trust the results.
  • Quality: Keep an eye on what users ask and what they get back, and flag repeat errors, gaps, or misreads so they get fixed.
  • Semantic layer: Work with Data Science and Engineering to improve the semantic layers built on our raw SQL tables, including taxonomies, metadata, and labeling, so Prism understands the data better.
  • Data analysis: Dig into how pricing, rebates, chargebacks, and other data connect, and use what you learn to shape how Prism represents it.
  • Working with the business: Talk with business owners about the questions they need answered, and turn those conversations into better prompts, queries, and data structure.
  • Requirements: Write clear technical requirements for tuning the model, restructuring data, or improving the product, based on what your reviews turn up.
  • Documentation: Write down where the data comes from, the business logic behind it, and how it fits together, so people understand and trust Prism's answers.
  • Roadmap input: Speak up for data quality during Prism planning, so priorities reflect what the data actually shows.
  • QA and communication: Set up answer-accuracy test cases with QA each sprint, and help put together release notes, briefings, and presentations that explain how Prism works.
  • 3+ years in data analysis, data correlation, or similar work.
  • You're technical without being a software engineer. You write SQL comfortably, including joins, aggregations, and window functions, and you can read and debug a query someone else wrote. You know your way around semantic layers and data structures and can work through a problem on your own.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools like Snowflake Cortex, Claude, or Codex, and a feel for how they read structured data and prompts.
  • Working knowledge of semantic data modeling (ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, or similar) and how it supports AI querying.
  • You notice when an AI answer doesn't match the source data, and you have the patience to figure out why.
  • Experience turning messy data relationships into clear requirements alongside Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering.
  • Strong writing and speaking skills. You can explain complicated data and AI ideas to business owners in a way they can act on.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar Agile tools.
  • Pharma experience, or experience with contracts and pricing, is a plus.
  • A 4-year degree in a related field is preferred.

What does IntegriChain have to offer?

  • Shape how a market-leading platform's AI understands and responds to life sciences data.
  • Work at the intersection of data science, semantic modeling, and product innovation, with visibility to senior product and company leadership.
  • Join a collaborative, growing o
  • Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
  • Excellent and affordable medical benefits + non-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Robust Learning & Development opportunities including over 700+ development courses free to all employees
