title: Director, Digital Twin & Scalable Content
description:
Job Description Summary:

About the role:


The Director, Digital Twin and Scalable Content Capabilities leads a global operational area that connects Digital Twins with automated content creation at scale. The role translates established business priorities into an integrated roadmap, operating model, governance framework, resource plan, and measurable delivery outcomes.

Digital Twins provide accurate, reusable product representations. Scalable Content extends that foundation through modular content, templates, product data, automation, and repeatable workflows supporting product renders, Digital Shelf, ShopX, global-to-local adaptation, and other approved use cases.

The Director holds end-to-end accountability for the service portfolio, including global operations, platform and workflow priorities, partner performance, adoption, and continuous improvement. The role leads cross-functional implementation across Marketing, Customer and Commercial, Packaging Graphics, Product Data, Digital Shelf, Digital and Technology, Operating Units, bottling partners, and external providers.


1. Capability and Service Leadership

  • Lead Digital Twin and Scalable Content Services as an integrated global Service line, converting established priorities into operating plans, roadmaps, implementation programs, and measurable outcomes.
  • Own the operating model, governance, service catalogue, decision rights, standards, and ways of working across the capability portfolio.
  • Determine operational priorities and allocate approved resources across projects, platforms, workflows, and partners, balancing business value, market needs, risk, capacity, and cost.
  • Provide evidence-based recommendations on future capabilities, investment needs, emerging technologies, and operational risks.

2. Portfolio, Automation, and Platform Delivery

  • Hold end-to-end accountability for the design, delivery, performance, and continuous improvement of the Digital Twin and Scalable Content service portfolio.
  • Own the integrated roadmap for GRIP, Digital Twin Services, content-automation workflows, and connected platforms within agreed strategic and investment parameters
  • Connect Digital Twins, product data, approved brand assets, modular content, templates, and automation rules to enable accurate, repeatable, high-volume content creation and adaptation
  • Lead the evolution from managed services toward scalable self-service and hybrid models with appropriate quality, permissions, rights, brand controls, and human review
  • Lead integration with packaging and label systems, PIM, DAM, Digital Shelf, syndication, and approved activation environments; establish readiness and acceptance criteria before global deployment.

3. Global Operations and Partner Performance

  • Define and monitor performance measures covering quality, accuracy, throughput, turnaround time, automation, reuse, adoption, user experience, cost effectiveness, and resilience.
  • Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for service levels, capacity, deliverables, commercial value, and improvement commitments; determine corrective actions when outcomes fall short.
  • Make operational decisions affecting priorities, project sequencing, provider capacity, workflow design, implementation timing, and deployment of approved resources.
  • Lead partner and commercial planning with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and relevant leadership, including scope, contracts, service levels, risk, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage operational risks and continuity during platform releases, market onboarding, workflow changes, provider transitions, and service-model changes.

4. Cross-Functional Adoption and Value

  • Lead cross-functional implementation, resolving ownership gaps, delivery dependencies, and operational priorities across functions, Operating Units, markets, bottling partners, and providers.
  • Lead global adoption through stakeholder engagement, onboarding, communications, capability building, service transition, and structured user feedback.
  • Define and communicate outcomes for quality, speed, automation, reuse, scalability, adoption, user experience, and cost avoidance.
  • Evaluate new use cases, build recommendations, and lead approved implementation while ensuring clear ownership, controls, and success measures.
  • Develop talent and capability through direct, matrixed, project, and extended-partner leadership, fostering accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

Experience and Education

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Significant experience leading a global or multi-market digital service, content-production capability, operational area, or technology-enabled platform
  • Demonstrated experience translating strategy into operating plans, roadmaps, governance, resource priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • End-to-end accountability for a service or capability spanning multiple functions, markets, business units, or external partners.
  • Experience with automated content production at scale, modular content, templates, data-driven adaptation, workflow automation, or high-volume digital asset creation.
  • Proven ability to prioritize competing demands, allocate approved resources, lead complex cross-functional implementation, and resolve delivery constraints.
  • Strong vendor, commercial, and financial acumen, including service levels, capacity, contracts, external spend, and investment recommendations.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead change and adoption, and develop teams across a complex matrixed organization.

Preferred

  • Experience in consumer products, Digital Shelf, Digital commerce, packaging, creative production, CGI, VFX, 3D visualization, or scalable marketing-content operations.
  • Knowledge of Digital Twins, 3D asset pipelines, PIM, DAM, syndication, content automation, generative AI, and global-to-local activation.
  • Experience introducing self-service or hybrid services while maintaining governance, rights, quality, security, and brand controls.
  • Experience working across company-owned operations, franchise or bottling systems, agencies, and production or technology partners.

Power BI

title: Pricing Analyst
description:
Member of the pricing team that controls entire cargo network pricing and offer management; in order to achieve Etihad Cargo revenue plan

Accountabilities:

  • Developing and implementing a seasonal pricing strategy for the region in co-ordination with the regional commercial team; considering the forecasted market conditions and Etihad Cargo business plan. Set the prices by flow, rate type, customer and product. Identifying the need for tactical pricing promotions.
  • Responsible for creating the portfolio of offers for assigned routes, evaluating their effectiveness and taking corrective actions when required.
  • Governance and performance tracking of the prices and capacity allocations.
  • Support and challenge the regional commercial teams to achieve their target.
  • Conduct research and analysis to highlight opportunities and risk for the region using different sources of data, both internal and external, including regional commercial feedback.
  • Spot rate evaluation and approval, considering the latest trends and shipment requirements. Ensuring the basis of the evaluation is optimizing the contribution for Etihad Cargo.
  • Route Analysis – monitoring routes and analyze the performance. Identifying and taking appropriate action to ensure load factors are kept at an optimum with the best mix of business.
  • Construct pricing proposals for participation in Customer global tenders. Guide the commercial management team on the negotiation stance for the meeting.
  • Working in cross-functional groups to support new product launches, strategic business initiatives and system enhancements.
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Two years of revenue management, or related analytical experience
  • Sound knowledge in the application of revenue management principles, Pricing methodologies and modelling, Cargo Revenue Management Systems, Flight Planning
  • Strong communicator and decision maker
  • Highly numerate
  • Comfortable working with complex systems.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.

To learn more visit

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Chief Engineer -- Union Position - Operating Engineers Local 39
description:
We’re People People. Are you?


We’re Sonesta International Hotels—the 8th largest hotel company in the U.S. (and growing fast 🚀).


With a dynamic mix of full-service and focused hotels across major cities, our diverse portfolio of owned, managed, and franchised properties means we’re everywhere our guests need us to be.

But here’s the thing—we’re not just in the business of hotels, we’re in the business of people. We bring service with passion, loyalty with purpose, and create experiences that genuinely connect—delivering quality, value, and memorable stays across 1,000+ properties in eight countries (and counting).



What this role is all about


The Chief Engineer is responsible for the safe, efficient, and economical operation of the hotel’s physical plant and Engineering Department. This position provides day-to-day leadership to the hotel’s engineers and apprentice engineer while remaining actively involved in bargaining-unit engineering work.

This position is covered by the Collective Bargaining Agreement between The Clift Hotel and the International Union of Operating Engineers, Stationary Engineers Local 39. Wages, benefits, working conditions, and other terms of employment are governed by the CBA.

What you’ll be doing

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct the operation, care, preventive maintenance, and repair of the hotel’s steam, electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, refrigeration, life-safety, and building-control systems.
  • Maintain responsibility for the safe and economical operation of the hotel’s physical plant.
  • Supervise, assign, and coordinate the work of employees under the Chief Engineer’s direction.
  • Provide orientation, technical guidance, and training to engineers, apprentice engineers, and trainees.
  • Carry out hotel management’s operational directives while maintaining compliance with the Local 39 CBA.
  • Perform bargaining-unit engineering work in addition to leadership responsibilities.
  • Perform the engineering duties assigned under the CBA, including the operation, maintenance, and repair of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, refrigeration, water-distribution, energy-management, and life-safety systems.
  • Inspect equipment and mechanical areas regularly and identify maintenance, repair, safety, and capital-improvement needs.
  • Develop and maintain preventive-maintenance programs, operating records, equipment logs, inspection reports, and regulatory documentation.
  • Respond to emergency conditions involving building systems, utilities, guest rooms, public areas, and life-safety equipment.
  • Coordinate appropriate work with outside vendors and contractors while observing CBA jurisdiction and bargaining-unit work requirements.
  • Monitor energy usage and recommend measures that improve efficiency without compromising guest comfort, safety, or hotel operations.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local safety codes, environmental requirements, permits, and hotel policies.
  • Co-chair the hotel Safety Committee, represent the Engineering Department, and support hotel-wide safety and injury-prevention programs.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory levels for tools, equipment, parts, and operating supplies.
  • Work collaboratively with hotel leadership and operating departments to support guest service and uninterrupted hotel operations.
  • Perform all other work customarily performed by stationary engineers and assigned to the Chief Engineer classification under the CBA.

Qualifications

  • Significant hands-on experience operating, maintaining, and repairing mechanical, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, refrigeration, and building-control systems in a hotel, commercial building, hospital, or comparable facility.
  • Previous supervisory or lead-engineer experience, preferably in a union environment.
  • Strong knowledge of preventive maintenance, life-safety systems, workplace safety, energy management, and applicable building regulations.
  • Ability to lead, train, schedule, and provide clear direction to a team of skilled engineers and apprentices.
  • Ability to diagnose equipment failures and respond effectively to urgent building-system conditions.
  • Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with hotel management, employees, union representatives, vendors, and regulatory agencies.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule and respond to emergencies outside regularly scheduled hours when required.
  • Current job-related licenses, permits, and certifications required by applicable law or regulatory authorities.
  • EPA Universal Refrigerant Certification, OSHA training, and relevant stationary-engineering or building-operations certifications are preferred.

Physical Requirements

The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. These functions may include walking throughout the property; entering mechanical spaces; climbing stairs and ladders; bending, kneeling, reaching, and working in confined or elevated areas; using tools and testing equipment; and lifting or moving equipment and materials consistent with the requirements of the position.

Compensation and Benefits

The contractual Chief Engineer wage effective August 1, 2026, is $91.19 per hour. Applicable shift differentials, overtime, health and welfare benefits, pension, annuity, paid time off, holidays, and other employment terms are provided in accordance with the Local 39 Collective Bargaining Agreement.

Equal Employment Opportunity

The Clift Royal Sonesta Hotel is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified individuals with disabilities.


Anticipated Pay Range & Additional Job Information

Hourly rate is from $90.19 to $91.19 follows contract requirements.


How we reward you


At Sonesta, we know showing up for our guests starts with showing up for our people. That means supporting your health, your financial future, and everything in between.


Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:


  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with Company Match
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Paid Vacation & Sick Time
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance
  • Company-Paid Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness & Accident Insurance
  • Educational Assistance
  • Sonesta Hotel Discounts (yes, you’ll want to use these ✈️)
  • Additional Perks & Employee Discounts


Our Commitment to You


Sonesta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Before You Apply


To be considered, please complete the full application in addition to submitting your resume. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

title: Ambitious Founding iOS Engineer — Start Up NYC

  • Help define and evolve the company's iOS architecture
  • Build interfaces and interactions that feel fast, polished, and native
  • Debug production issues and improve app reliability and performance

You're not just here for a paycheck — you're looking for \"the thing.\" Maybe you've interned at a few startups, built side projects late at night, shipped your own apps, or thrown yourself into hackathons because you couldn't help it. You want a flat team where people just get on with it — no layers, no waiting for permission.   • Solid professional iOS development experience using MVVM or similar architectural patterns
  • You've built and scaled iOS apps from 0 to 1
  • Strong proficiency in Swift or Objective-C
  • Experience working with REST APIs and asynchronous data
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving start-up environment

  • High ownership — you don't need someone telling you exactly what to build every day

Nice to Have

This is a red-hot platform in a niche that's exploding — connecting people with commercial opportunities through authentic content. Already handling massive volume across millions of creators and thousands of brands,. Freshly and heavily backed and scaling at a pace that's hard to find anywhere else.

You're not employee #3,000 buried in Slack. You're one of the founding engineers, with the influence that comes with it. Your code ships, your ideas matter, and the line from your work to the company's growth is direct. That's rare this early in a career.

The team is small, sharp, and moves with intent — everyone in the office, every day, shipping.


The Money Talk

$160-225,00 base, plus bonus + equity. Total comp $300-350,000


The Vibe

Financial District, Manhattan. In-person, 5 days a week — the whole team's there, shipping together.


So — You In?

If you're an ambitious iOS engineer who wants real ownership and to stop waiting for permission — this is your moment. One of NYC's fastest-growing start-ups is hiring right now, and this timing won't repeat.

title: Career Advisor
description:
The Pathway Home Career Advisor provides pre-release and post-release workforce and reentry services to justice-involved individuals preparing to transition back into the community. This position supports participants through career planning, employment preparation, case management, and supportive services coordination to help individuals successfully obtain employment, training, and long-term stability. Work is performed in correctional facilities, detention centers, NCWorks Career Centers, and community settings, with flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and multiple office locations as needed.

  • Recruit, enroll, and guide eligible participants through program services within correctional facilities and community settings.
  • Assess participant work history, education, skills, abilities, and barriers to employment while helping participants identify solutions and career pathways.
  • Develop individualized employment and service plans focused on short and long term employment, education, training, retention, and self-sufficiency goals.
  • Provide career advising, employment readiness coaching, resume assistance, interview preparation, job search support, workshops, and referrals to community resources and supportive services.
  • Maintain regular contact with participants to support job readiness, employment retention, advancement, and ongoing program participation.
  • Coordinate with employers, correctional facilities, NCWorks partners, educational institutions, and community organizations to connect participants with employment, training, and supportive services opportunities.
  • Maintain information on local employers, workforce resources, training opportunities, and community services available to participants.
  • Participate in and/or host job fairs, hiring events, and workforce outreach activities.
  • Maintain accurate participant files, case notes, data entry, attendance records, retention tracking, and required program reporting in compliance with program requirements.
  • Any additional duties as assigned.

  • Associate degree from an accredited college or university in workforce development, social work, criminal justice, public administration, human services, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education, work experience, and lived experience.
  • One to three years of experience in workforce development, reentry services, case management, counseling, or related programs is preferred.
  • Knowledge of or experience working with justice-involved individuals and understanding the challenges associated with incarceration and community reentry.
  • Some local travel may be required.
  • Familiarity with the communities being served and available local resources.
  • Excellent communication, computer skills, customer service, organizational, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with participants, correctional staff, employers, and community partners.

title: Director, Technical Product Management
description:
As a Director of Technical Product Management, you’ll have a specialized focus on trust and safety. In this role, you will lead all aspects of our core technology product teams, ensuring that our platform remains a secure and trustworthy place for families to find household caregivers and, for caregivers to find screened families as employers. As a leader on our Platform Product team you will drive the development and implementation of solutions that enhance background checks, continuous monitoring, payment fraud detection, and identity verification processes. The ideal candidate is data-driven, acts with a sense of curiosity and urgency, and has a background in engineering..

What You’ll be Working on:

  • Mapping the customer journeys on both sides of the marketplace to identify the experiences that drive customers to seek support from our customer-facing teams
  • Identifying and realizing opportunities for automating manual processes related to trust and safety operations, including background checks, continuous monitoring, payments fraud detection, and identity verification
  • Partnering across operations, policy, engineering, business intelligence, marketing, legal, and other product teams to develop solutions that reflect user needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility
  • Conducting market research and competitive analysis to stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in content moderation, background checks, and identity verification tools
  • Defining product benchmarks and leading the development of dashboards that will provide telemetry into our impact on customer safety, experience, and retention
  • Continuously prioritizing your roadmap and project deliverables in an environment that changes significantly in short periods of time
  • Taking initiative to drive quality improvements across different teams, even when you are not directly responsible for their features
  • Setting up processes that will ensure your ability to deliver end-to-end products on-time in an extremely fast-paced environment
  • 10+ years of product management or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, solve complex problems, and produce high-quality results.
  • Experience with techniques to develop the right minimum viable products, as well as optimizing existing products.
  • Strong experience defining product vision & roadmaps, driving execution activities, measuring results.
  • A data-driven approach, with the ability to make decisions based on internal and external data.
  • Experience with vendor API integrations.
  • Understanding of the challenges in delivering a safe and trustworthy product with minimal friction for good actors; preference for experience with content moderation, background checks, payments fraud detection, and identity verification.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams to solve complex problems and produce high-quality results across multi-platforms (Desktop, Mobile Web, iOS/Android Mobile Applications).
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, start-up environment.
  • A strong communicator and team collaborator, with great written and verbal skills.
  • Experience working for a tech company, preferably a consumer-oriented or marketplace service.
  • Local to Dallas Texas or open to relocating is highlighy preferred

Job brief

We are looking for a talented and experienced Smart Contract Developer to work on the development of the Cross Chain Bridge project. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, upgrading, and deploying smart contracts on the Energi blockchain, ensuring their functionality, security, and efficiency to meet project requirements.

To be an ideal candidate, you will play a key role in building and maintaining the bridge connecting Wanchain and Polygon with Energi, enabling seamless communication between different blockchain networks and Energi. This project leverages cutting-edge technologies such as Multi-Party Computation (MPC) and cryptography-based secure threshold signature technology to enhance the security and reliability of cross-chain transactions.

ABOUT ENERGI

We are a fully remote company with no fixed headquarters. The team is spread throughout the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania. With over 30 contributors, the team forms a well-linked network across a variety of locations, lifestyles, and backgrounds.

Energi is by far the safest blockchain in the world. Energi provides an environment where users of any skill level can safely use blockchain technology, and developers can build EVM-compatible blockchain technology, free from the ever present worry about vulnerabilities that exist on other blockchains. Learn more about Energi here .

Responsibilities

  • Protocol Implementation: Develop and maintain smart contracts that implement the Wanchain Message Bridge Protocol on the Energi chain. This includes creating contracts for cross-chain message sending, receiving, and processing within the Energi ecosystem.
  • Solidity Programming: Write high-quality Solidity code to integrate with the Wanchain Message Bridge Protocol specifically tailored for the Energi chain. Ensure the code's security, efficiency, and compatibility with Energi's blockchain infrastructure.
  • Interface Implementation: Implement and interact with the various interfaces provided by the Wanchain Message Bridge Protocol, ensuring seamless integration within the Energi chain. This includes message dispatch, fee estimation, and robust error handling tailored for Energi's environment.
  • Cross-Chain Communication: Leverage the Wanchain Message Bridge Protocol to establish and maintain efficient communication channels between the Energi chain and other blockchain networks. Enable secure and reliable cross-chain message transmission specific to Energi's requirements.
  • Security Considerations: Prioritize the security of smart contracts developed for the Energi chain. Implement robust measures to prevent reentrancy attacks and replay attacks while effectively managing permissions using Energi's AccessControl library or equivalent security tools.
  • Documentation: Create comprehensive documentation specifically tailored for smart contracts, protocols, and interfaces within the Energi ecosystem. Ensure that code comments and external developer documentation are aligned with Energi's practices and guidelines.
  • Testing: Conduct thorough testing of smart contracts to identify and address vulnerabilities or issues within the Energi chain environment. Perform unit tests and integration tests, focusing on error handling that suits Energi's blockchain infrastructure.
  • Optimization: Optimize smart contract code to maximize gas efficiency and minimize costs within the Energi chain. Ensure that the code is fine-tuned for Energi's specific gas fee structure and blockchain conditions

Requirements

  • Blockchain Development Experience: Demonstrated experience in blockchain development, with a focus on Ethereum and Solidity programming.
  • Cross-Chain Technology: Familiarity with cross-chain technology concepts, including message transmission, secure threshold signatures, and MPC.
  • Solidity Proficiency: Proficiency in Solidity programming language and smart contract development best practices.
  • Smart Contract Security: Understanding of smart contract security principles, including reentrancy protection and replay attack prevention.
  • Documentation Skills: Ability to create clear and comprehensive documentation for developers and end-users.
  • Team Player: Strong teamwork and communication skills, as you will be collaborating with other developers and stakeholders.
  • Self-Motivated: Ability to work independently, set priorities, and meet deadlines.
  • Ethereum EIPs: Knowledge of Ethereum Improvement Proposals (EIPs) and previous experience with EIP implementations is a plus.
  • Self-driven with the ability to deliver results with minimal supervision.
  • Fluent English communicator.
  • Passionate and up-to-date on the rapidly changing world of blockchain technology.
  • Values aligned with the Energi culture and values.
  • Optimize SEO.

title: Deep Specialist HPC Computational Engineer
description:
About us

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

About the job

The Computational Materials and Engineering (CME) Unit within UKAEA’s Computing Division delivers research, development and technical support across high-performance computing, engineering and scientific computing, AI, machine learning and advanced simulation technologies for the fusion programme. In this role, you will lead the development and maintenance of software capabilities supporting computational nuclear and multiphysics applications, while driving research, collaboration, funding and adoption of emerging technologies. You will provide technical and strategic leadership, manage projects and resources, represent UKAEA nationally and internationally, and help shape future research directions while developing expertise and collaborations across the Authority.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Plan and lead technical contributions to workstreams in modelling, simulation and uncertainty quantification activities for UKAEA programmes

  • Review and provide approvals for the technical output of teams of 4-10 people

  • Oversee development of state-of-the-art software suites, ensuring adherence to established quality standards

  • Design technical strategy for development for, deployment on, and evaluation of new and emerging computing architectures

  • Produce consistently high levels of high-impact output. Present research at conferences including regular oral or invited conference presentations, high quantity and quality of publications, generally two to three first author journal papers per year

  • Collaborate with national and international partners on developing and evolving codes to exploit peta- and exa-scale systems

  • Actively seek new research and funding opportunities, leading proposals. When successful implement new programmes supported by funds outside UKAEA, leading consortia

  • Lead international projects, develop new collaborations, and maintain and grow our research at the international cutting edge

  • Perform your own research into novel numerical methods and algorithms with applicability within fusion and beyond

  • Act as a source of advice to other divisions and programmes. Support wider skills development, providing training across the organisation relating to specialism

What You’ll Bring

  • At least a doctorate degree (or equivalent qualification) in a computational, mathematical or physical science discipline with a strong publication track record or contribution to relevant software library (or equivalent experience in either a commercial or research environment)

  • Significant demonstrable experience using high-performance computing systems and of at least one compiled level language (e.g. C++, Fortran, C, Rust) or advanced scripting language (Julia, R, Swift Parallel Scripting), as evidenced through contributions to software packages

  • Experience in working in and leading a distributed team in both mentoring and managing roles, either as a project or technical manager

  • Significant demonstrable experience and international reputation in one or more relevant computational engineering fields. Solid foundation in mathematics, especially numerical analysis, demonstrated by extensive publication records or contributions to relevant software libraries

  • Experience of the development and implementation of testing strategies (verification and validation) and an ability to assess new algorithms which could be applicable to fusion based codes

  • Demonstrable significant experience in performing technical review and approval of contributions to large-scale software projects or journals

UKAEA is an onsite organisation, and this role requires regular onsite presence (usually between 3-5 days in any given week) in line with business needs. We actively support flexible working arrangements where this is compatible with the role.

The role is currently advertised at Rotherham, but other UKAEA locations may also be considered.

Benefits

We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include:

  • A salary of £71,815 (inclusive of a £7,700 specialist allowance)
  • Up to 7% corporate performance bonus
  • Final salary defined benefits pension scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution
  • 25 days annual leave plus 2.5 'privilege' days; 8 Bank Holidays
  • Additional 3 days of site closure over Christmas break
  • Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions

Our commitment to ED&I

UKAEA's mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, inclusion and accessibility, and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce.

Please email talent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require adjustments to help you participate fairly in our recruitment process, for example changes to the way we interview or share information. As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience for all candidates.

We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and people from diverse ethnic backgrounds. All appointments are made on merit and further information can be found here.

### Description

**Build your engineering career while helping create safer, more connected streets.**

**_About the Opportunity_**

The City of Palo Alto’s Office of Transportation is seeking an **Assistant Engineer** to support street design, signage and striping, and parking and curb management. This entry-level role combines technical analysis, creative problem-solving, and public service through projects that shape how people move through the city.

With guidance from experienced colleagues, you’ll gain hands-on experience in both office and field settings. Your work could include developing a street design concept, studying neighborhood traffic conditions, evaluating parking needs, or preparing maps that help residents understand a proposed improvement. You’ll learn how engineering decisions move from data and ideas to practical solutions.

**_About the Office of Transportation_**

The Office of Transportation brings together transportation planning, traffic engineering, Safe Routes to School education, parking programs, and transit planning. For an engineer beginning their career, this means opportunities to explore different aspects of transportation and discover where your interests can grow.

You’ll join a team whose work spans neighborhood traffic calming, bicycle and pedestrian connections, street safety improvements, and downtown parking technology. Working across disciplines in a small-city setting, you’ll see how individual assignments connect to larger projects and community goals.

With a strong slate of upcoming projects and affiliate membership in the **National Association of City Transportation Officials (NACTO)**, the office offers a setting where you can contribute ideas, broaden your experience, and see the impact of your work.

**_What You’ll Work On_**

- **Street improvements:** Assist with street design concepts, signage, and striping.

- **Parking and curb management:** Help evaluate parking conditions and support program improvements.

- **Data and analysis:** Conduct traffic counts, speed and parking studies, and interpret findings.

- **Visual communication:** Prepare concept drawings, maps, and presentation materials.

- **Community response:** Help address transportation questions and concerns from residents.

- **Project support:** Assist with studies, consultant coordination, and project implementation.


**_The Ideal Candidate_**

You’re curious about how streets work and interested in making transportation safer and more sustainable. You enjoy examining a problem, exploring design options, and explaining your ideas clearly. You’re also ready to listen, ask questions, and build your skills with guidance.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

- **An analytical mindset** and an interest in using data to inform decisions.

- **Design and visual communication skills** that help turn ideas into understandable concepts.

- **A collaborative approach** and comfort working on a variety of assignments.

- **A service-oriented attitude** when communicating with residents, consultants, and colleagues.

- **Initiative and a willingness to learn,** including openness to feedback and new perspectives.


**Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification, knowledge of signal operations or Complete Streets design, and experience with AutoCAD or GIS are preferred, but not required.**

**_Apply Today_**

Ready to put your engineering skills into practice? Join us in shaping safer, more connected streets in Palo Alto. If you’re curious, collaborative, and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply!

**Applications close Sunday, October 18, 2026. Apply early to give yourself time to complete your application.**

- Works with the public to provide utility customer service for water, gas, and wastewater utilities.

We are seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to develop low-level software that directly interfaces with hardware across spacecraft subsystems and supporting electronics.

This role is well-suited for an engineer with solid foundational experience who can operate independently on day-to-day tasks, while continuing to grow in system design and large-scale integration efforts with guidance from senior engineers.

Candidate will be expected to deliver working software quickly, contribute to hardware bring-up and debugging, and build a deeper understanding of how individual components interact within larger systems. This role is primarily on-site at our Littleton, Colorado headquarters or at our facility in San Jose, California, with limited remote work flexibility.


Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain embedded software for spacecraft subsystems, including sensors, actuators, power systems, and communication interfaces
  • Write and debug low-level drivers and board support code
  • Interface directly with hardware (SPI, I2C, UART, GPIO, DMA)
  • Support hardware bring-up and debugging using lab equipment and standard tools
  • Deliver working implementations quickly and iterate to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability
  • Debug embedded systems using tools such as GDB, JTAG, and SWD
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and refine system interfaces
  • Participate in integration, HIL testing, and system validation
  • Contribute to Python-based test, automation, and data analysis workflows


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in EE, CE, CS, or related field
  • 5 years of embedded software experience
  • Proficiency in C and modern C++
  • Experience developing firmware in bare-metal or minimally abstracted environments
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Interrupt-driven design
  • Memory-mapped I/O and peripheral configuration
  • Timing and resource constraints
  • Experience writing low-level drivers and interfacing with hardware peripherals (SPI, I2C, UART, GPIO, DMA)
  • Ability to work from datasheets/reference manuals to configure and debug hardware
  • Experience debugging embedded systems using:
  • Software tools (e.G., GDB, JTAG/SWD)
  • Lab equipment (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, multimeter)
  • Familiarity with RTOS concepts (threads, scheduling, synchronization)
  • Exposure to embedded Linux development environments
  • Experience with Git-based workflows
  • Ability to execute well-scoped tasks independently and deliver reliable results


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing firmware for resource-constrained microcontrollers in bare-metal environments
  • Comfort working at low levels of abstraction, including direct register manipulation and hardware bring-up
  • Experience with RTOS frameworks (e.G., Zephyr, FreeRTOS) and associated design trade-offs
  • Experience working across abstraction layers (bare-metal, RTOS, embedded Linux)
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux tools and workflows (e.G., cross-compilation, build systems)
  • Experience bringing up new hardware, including initialization and early-stage debugging
  • Experience optimizing firmware for memory, timing, or power constraints
  • Familiarity with ARM-based platforms (Cortex-M, Cortex-A) or similar
  • Experience with integration, HIL testing, or cross-subsystem debugging
  • Exposure to CI/CD or automated testing workflows


What We Value

  • Ownership of day-to-day work: Candidate reliably executes assigned tasks and follows issues through to resolution
  • Growth mindset: Candidate actively develops technical depth and takes on increasing responsibility over time
  • System-oriented thinking: Candidate seeks to understand how components interact within a larger system, including trade-offs and dependencies
  • Curiosity and critical thinking: Candidate asks "why" when appropriate—challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements, and improving designs
  • Bias toward action: Candidate delivers working solutions quickly and iterates based on testing and feedback
  • Collaboration: Candidate works effectively across disciplines and incorporates feedback from more experienced engineers


Pay Transparency

Astro Digital employees are provided with a comprehensive benefits package that includes company stock options, healthcare, 401k retirement plan, and PTO. The range of possible compensation for this role is $130k–$175k annually, depending on experience and alignment.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform
description:
Firmable is the market-leading B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia Pacific — and we're scaling that success globally at pace. Backed by leading investors and 2,000+ customers strong, we exist to give sales teams an unfair advantage: the deepest company and people data of any platform, enriched with real-time signals, served at the right moment by intelligent agents.

Our data is the product. Building it now means building with LLMs in the pipeline, and setting the standard for when to trust them.

The Role

As Senior Data Engineer — Data Platform, you'll architect the transformation and warehouse layer that turns billions of raw records into the world's most accurate B2B dataset, and design how LLM-based extraction, enrichment, and validation run inside it as production infrastructure.

You make the architecture calls: model design and materialisation, warehouse cost and performance, orchestration patterns the team builds on, and the rule-vs-LLM standard for every quality and enrichment step. You know when a dbt test does the job, when an LLM check is needed, and when both belong together.

This is hands-on senior engineering with sharp architecture judgement. You write the reference implementation, then the team builds on it.

What You'll Own

  • LLM-in-the-pipeline architecture — the patterns for extraction, enrichment, entity resolution, and semantic validation over millions of records a day: structured outputs, retries, human-review fallbacks, and the abstractions others reuse

  • Eval harnesses — design the labelled sets, scorers, judge calibration, and regression suites that gate every prompt or model change; own precision/recall targets per check

  • The rule-vs-LLM standard — deterministic checks (dbt tests, data contracts, SQL) wherever structure allows; LLMs only where semantic judgement is needed; codified so the team can apply it without you

  • Cost and drift — token budgets per pipeline, model routing (cheap models for classification, stronger ones for hard cases), drift detection on vendor updates, and the token math behind the ceilings

  • Observability — every LLM call logged with prompt version, model, cost, latency, and decision, alongside pipeline alerting that surfaces problems before they cascade

  • Warehouse and transformation architecture — dbt layers that encode real business logic; Snowflake performance, clustering, materialisation, and cost over billions of rows

  • Orchestration and infrastructure — Airflow patterns for recovery and cost-aware scheduling; AWS infrastructure as code

  • Matching and deduplication — embeddings and retrieval patterns for company and people entity resolution across 13 markets

  • Cross-functional voice — technical voice for the platform in architecture decisions with sourcing, data quality, product, and analytics

What We're Looking For

Must Haves

  • 5+ years building production data platforms in business-critical environments, with architecture you've owned end to end and 2+ years experience with Snowflake

  • Worked with billions of rows — you know what breaks at that scale and how to design pipelines and checks that don't

  • Shipped LLMs inside data pipelines as production systems — extraction, enrichment, or validation with structured outputs, versioned prompts, and labelled eval sets. You can show the repo

  • Designed eval harnesses others depend on — scorers, labelled sets, judge calibration, regression suites; you can talk through what they caught and what they missed

  • Sharp judgement on rules vs. LLMs — you reach for a dbt test or SQL first, defend the call either way, and have codified the standard for a team

  • Expert Python and SQL — production-grade, performance-aware, comfortable at very large scale

  • Expert dbt and Snowflake — modular transformation layers with real business logic; warehouse design, query optimisation, clustering, RBAC, cost at scale

  • Extensive Airflow — orchestration, dependency management, recovery patterns, cost optimisation in production

  • Solid AWS — S3, Lambda, Glue, ECS, RDS

  • AI coding tools are how you work — Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent, daily, with real shipped work to show for it

  • Architecture judgement and a product mindset — when to refactor, optimise, ship, or redesign; you care how data quality lands with customers, not just uptime

Highly Valued

  • Eval frameworks (Braintrust, Promptfoo, Inspect) and LLM tracing (Logfire, OpenTelemetry)

  • Embeddings, vector search, or fuzzy matching for entity resolution at scale

  • Fine-tuning or distilling small models to replace expensive LLM calls

  • dbt Cloud and CI/CD for data pipelines

  • Spark or PySpark; streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Snowpipe Streaming)

  • B2B data: firmographics, people data, company registries

  • Data privacy and compliance (GDPR, SOC2, CCPA)

How We Build

Firmable is an AI-native organisation. AI coding tools, automated testing, and AI-assisted review are how we work by default. Every LLM check ships with a labelled eval set, measured precision/recall, and a prompt version you can roll back. Every LLM call in production is logged from day one; retrofitting later is not the plan.

We run lean and ship fast — small senior teams, no layers, minimal process, weekly releases moving toward daily. Teams own their stack end to end. There are no fixed hours and no handholding. If you're not already working this way, this role isn't right for you.

Why This Role

  • LLMs as production infrastructure — not a demo, not a notebook; models making millions of decisions a day on data customers pay for, and you set how they ship

  • Greenfield architecture — eval harnesses, drift detection, cost controls, and the rule-vs-LLM standard for the warehouse are largely unbuilt; you'll architect them

  • Scale that matters — billions of rows, 13 markets, and a dataset nobody else has

  • Small team, massive leverage — your architecture reaches every Firmable customer, every day

  • Competitive base + meaningful equity — a share in the upside we're building toward

Firmable is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products.

Ready to architect the AI-native data platform behind the world's smartest B2B sales intelligence platform? Apply now — let's talk!

title: Salesforce Solution Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Solution Architect to shape and deliver enterprise-scale solutions across the Salesforce ecosystem. In this role, you will translate complex business and technology needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable architectures, guiding programs from discovery and presales through implementation and continuous improvement. You will work with clients, business stakeholders, engineering teams, and platform leaders to establish solution direction, architectural governance, and measurable business value.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end architecture and solution design for complex Salesforce transformation programs
  • Drive discovery workshops, assess business and technical requirements, and define target-state architecture and delivery roadmaps
  • Design scalable solutions across the core Salesforce portfolio, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, together with one or more advanced capabilities such as Agentforce and Salesforce AI, Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Health Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, or other industry solutions
  • Define application, integration, data, security, identity, and environment strategies aligned with enterprise architecture standards
  • Architect AI-powered agents and workflows, including grounding, prompt and action design, trust controls, human oversight, observability, and responsible AI considerations
  • Design customer data solutions covering ingestion, harmonization, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, analytics, and governance
  • Shape quote-to-cash and revenue lifecycle solutions, including product catalog, pricing, configuration, contracts, orders, billing, and integrations with ERP and finance platforms
  • Provide architectural leadership throughout delivery, review solution designs, manage technical risks, and ensure adherence to Salesforce and engineering best practices
  • Guide integration patterns using APIs, events, middleware, and enterprise integration platforms such as MuleSoft
  • Partner with delivery leaders and stakeholders on estimates, scope, trade-offs, non-functional requirements, and release planning
  • Support presales activities by shaping solutions, contributing to proposals, estimates, presentations, and technical client discussions
  • Mentor engineers and architects, promote reusable assets, and contribute to communities of practice and capability development

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience delivering CRM or enterprise application solutions, including strong hands-on Salesforce expertise
  • 3+ years in a Salesforce architecture or comparable technical leadership role on complex, multi-cloud programs
  • Demonstrated experience designing Salesforce data models, sharing and security models, integrations, and scalable platform solutions
  • Strong practical expertise across the core Salesforce portfolio, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, is required. In addition, hands-on experience with at least one of the following is required: Agentforce and Salesforce AI, Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Health Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, or another Salesforce industry cloud
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce development and configuration capabilities, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, APIs, and event-driven patterns
  • Experience with architecture governance, non-functional requirements, DevOps and CI/CD, environment strategy, data migration, and release management
  • Ability to communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to both executive and engineering audiences
  • Proven client-facing, facilitation, consulting, and stakeholder management skills
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Nice to have

  • Experience with Salesforce Life Sciences, Health, Financial Services, Communications, Manufacturing, Automotive, or Consumer Goods solutions
  • Knowledge of AI governance, prompt engineering, agent testing, model evaluation, and production monitoring
  • Experience with MuleSoft, Tableau, Slack, ERP, data platforms, or hyperscale cloud services
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud Advanced, contract lifecycle management, or billing platforms
  • Salesforce certifications such as Application Architect, System Architect, Data Cloud Consultant, Revenue Cloud Consultant, or relevant Agentforce credentials
  • Experience leading architecture boards, centers of excellence, or enterprise platform governance

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills
  • Variety of projects within one company
  • Being a part of a project following engineering excellence standards
  • Individual career path and professional growth opportunities
  • Internal events and communities
  • Flexible work hours

title: General Services Officer
description:
Join our dedicated Hotel Services team as a Casual General Services Officer at Dudley Private Hospital. This is an exciting opportunity for an all-rounder to become part of a supportive team and contribute to the delivery of high-quality healthcare services in a rewarding and fast-paced environment.

Working across a variety of Hotel Services functions, you will have the opportunity to be cross trained in areas including domestic housekeeping, environmental and infectious cleaning, food services, laundry and kitchen support.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintaining high standards of cleanliness across all areas of the hospital, including wards and operating theatres.
  • Undertaking domestic, environmental and infectious cleaning in accordance with hospital procedures and infection control standards.
  • Supporting food services, including meal delivery and service to patients.
  • Assisting with end-of-day cleaning and maintaining clean and safe work areas.
  • Supporting kitchen operations and assisting chefs as required.
  • Undertaking laundry duties including washing, folding and storing linen and other items.

About You

You are a reliable, hardworking and adaptable individual who takes pride in providing high-quality service. You enjoy variety in your work and are comfortable learning new skills across different areas of Hotel Services.

You have a strong attention to detail, understand the importance of cleanliness and infection control in a healthcare environment, and enjoy working as part of a large and supportive team.

This role would suit someone looking for flexible casual work, including those seeking a second job or availability that works around school hours.

You Will Also Bring

  • Previous experience in cleaning, housekeeping, hospitality or hotel services is highly regarded.
  • Previous experience working in a hospital or healthcare environment is desirable.
  • Experience using auto scrubbers and polishing machines is advantageous.
  • A strong commitment to cleanliness, safety and infection prevention and control.
  • Excellent attention to detail and pride in your work.
  • A positive, friendly and customer-focused approach.
  • The ability to work effectively as part of a large team.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • The ability to adapt to different duties and work across multiple areas of Hotel Services.
  • A willingness to learn and be cross trained in housekeeping, cleaning, food services, laundry and kitchen support.
  • Flexibility to work across a 7-day rotating roster.

What’s in it for You:

At Ramsay, we care for our people by offering benefits that truly support your career, wellbeing and lifestyle, including:

  • Grow your career with recognition programs, employee referral bonuses, scholarships, free access to LinkedIn Learning and the Ramsay Leadership Academy
  • Save more every day with Ramsay Rewards, giving you exclusive deals at 100+ retailers, restaurants, travel providers and more

  • Find balance through flexible rostering options, flexible leave and access to free, confidential counselling and wellbeing support 24/7
  • Increase your take-home pay through salary packaging and novated leasing, plus discounts on leisure travel, gyms and lifestyle services.

Why Join Ramsay:

At Ramsay Health Care, “people caring for people” is at the heart of everything we do. We are:

title: Lead Medical Lab Scientist, Blood Bank, Full-Time, Days
description:
The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • In addition to the responsibilities of a medical laboratory scientist, this position provides technical/administrative oversight to and directs the workflow of personnel who perform laboratory tests.

  • Assists in performing assay validations, instrument correlations, calibrations.

  • Collecting and interpreting data for acceptance of new testing protocols or quality control materials

  • Performing IT validations on new or updated testing systems or test codes according to validation protocol.

  • Assisting the department Coordinator(s) or Manager with regulatory compliance and inspection readiness.

  • Reviewing and updating department documentation and procedures.

  • Reviewing proficiency testing documentation and performing investigations as required for the follow up and corrective action process.

  • Performs all aspects of pre-analytic workflow appropriate for the laboratory to ensure orders are entered correctly, specimens collected are appropriate for the test ordered and are correctly processed/transported.

  • Verifies specimens for add on tests are available and acceptable and generates add on test orders.

  • Recognizes when fraud and abuse compliance issues require adjustments to the test order.

  • Collecting, receiving and processing of specimens.

  • Verifies specimens are correctly and completely labeled upon receipt.

  • Evaluates specimens for appropriateness and takes necessary corrective action. Appropriately documents unacceptable specimens and proper notifications as needed.

  • Performs any necessary pretest specimen preparation according to protocols.

  • Transfers or ships specimens to approved testing locations according to SOPs

  • Responsible for all aspects of analytical testing appropriate for the laboratory.

  • Maintains test system integrity.

  • Examines preventative maintenance logs on instruments/equipment in a timely fashion and follows up as needed.

  • Verifies reagents and supplies meet defined acceptability criteria upon receipt and prior to use; takes action to ensure unacceptable items are removed from use.

  • Responsible for inventory maintenance and supply ordering in designated section.

  • Performs and records all necessary quality control (QC) required for test system performance.

  • Review and evaluates QC results in designated sections and takes necessary corrective actions according to established protocol.

  • Performs evaluations of new lot numbers of QC and calibration material, establishes criteria for acceptance such as normal ranges and SD’s, and Westgard or Sigma rules.

  • Performs tests.

  • Performs waived, moderate, and high complexity testing

  • Prioritizes testing based on assignment or established priorities, completes testing within defined turn-around-times.

  • Responds effectively to changes in the workflow by coordinating a simultaneous series of tests when needed or adjusting work to incorporate STAT tests or fluctuations in work volume.

  • Exercises independent judgment in the performance of technical responsibilities.

  • Performs technical review and interpretation.

  • Develops and maintains a higher level of expertise in the specific areas of responsibility.

  • Reviews results for completeness, correctness, and consistency within defined test system.

  • Evaluates test results/reactions and provides accurate interpretations as appropriate to include correlation with, and integration of, other patient data as necessary.

  • Performs visual interpretation/identifications as appropriate.

  • Recognizes unusual test results/interpretations and complete indicated reflex testing or other follow-up actions.

  • Follows established notification protocols for critical values, a phone/fax result requests, abnormalities.

  • Evaluates instruments and test systems and makes recommendations for acquisition to senior management.

  • Evaluates and proposes updates to SOPs if necessary.

  • Troubleshoots and solves problems.

  • Recognizes when unresolved problems need to be escalated and takes necessary follow-up action.

  • Reviews pending logs and follows-up to ensure pending tests are completed or cancelled when appropriate.

  • Performs advanced troubleshooting and repair.

  • Calls for field service when necessary and is familiar with contractual terms of maintenance agreements.

  • Peer coaches/ trains staff on troubleshooting tasks.

  • Post-test specimen storage.

  • Ensures that specimens and related materials (blood, body fluids, slides, etc) are stored according to protocols for location and duration with necessary documentation.

  • Performs all aspects of the post-analytic workflow appropriate for the specific section to ensure accurate results are reported within established time frames, specimens are retained appropriately, test results and/or current status are available upon inquiry, and billed charges are correct.

  • Universal Responsibilities.

  • Ensures quality of operations.

  • Assumes delegated responsibilities in the absence of a coordinator.

  • Responsible for regulatory compliance in designated section.

  • Performs required Quality systems responsibilities including initiating Quality Investigation Reports.

  • Participates in the training of new employees.

  • Meets proficiency and competency standards of the department and assists in the competency assessment of technical and support staff.

  • Participates in new test development, validations and implementation.

  • Presents continuing education programs.

  • Assists the coordinator and manager in monitoring the operations of designated areas to ensure the service standards and financial goals are met.

  • Presents continuing education programs.

  • Contributes in developing and is responsible for implementation of technical goals and standards.

  • Information Systems.

  • Ensures integrity of Laboratory Information System by following established protocols and participating in the maintenance and enhancements of the LIS.

  • May oversee instrument computer software updates.

  • Demonstrates expertise in Information Technology; uses applications to streamline operations and facilitate service monitoring and data collection.

  • Ensures safety of operations.

  • Follows all required safety procedures, uses personal protective equipment appropriate for tasks performed.

  • Maintains clean and organized work area.

  • Provides service excellence.

  • Answers telephones when needed, using AIDET telephone etiquette.

  • Maintains patient confidentiality, including protected health information (PHI).

  • Assists patients, visitors and other contacts whenever need occurs.

  • Verifies and reports results:

  • Verifies results according to procedure.

  • Performs computer functions necessary for releasing results.

  • Generates written reports according to established protocol

  • Reviews electronic or printed reports when applicable, recognizes problems and escalates according to protocol.

  • Amends reports:

  • Corrects erroneous reports and amends reports according to procedure

  • Responds to inquiries:

  • Responds to requests for information according to established protocol for confidentiality and release of information

  • Recognizes when unresolved inquiries need to be escalated and takes action

  • Stores documents and records:

  • Stores documents and records according to established protocol.

  • Charge capture/billing:

  • Performs billing and/or enter credits for tests and services when applicable.

  • Recognizes billing problems and escalates accordingly

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Medical Laboratory Science, Clinical Laboratory Science, Chemistry, Biology, or Allied Health qualifying the applicant to take the national ASCP certifying exam.

  • If hired after 1/19/2025, must obtain Medical Laboratory Technician (MLS) (ASCP), or categorical BB, C, H, or M (ASCP) certifications or equivalent certification within 1 year of hire date.

  • 2 years of clinical lab experience in a TJC or CAP accredited laboratory.

title: Medical Laboratory Scientist Lab Chemistry-Part-time Days
description:
This is a part-time, 20 hours per week, 1st shift position located at Central DuPage Hospital in Winfield.

The Medical Laboratory Scientist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A Medical Laboratory Scientist performs test procedures in a clinical laboratory and conveys the results to the physician or designee in an accurate and timely manner for the purpose of patient diagnosis and treatment

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Technical responsibilities:
  • Performs all aspects of pre-analytic workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure orders are entered correctly, specimens collected are appropriate for the test ordered and are correctly processed/transported.
  • Verifies order where necessary
  • Verifies non-patient information (e.g., collection time) according to established protocol.
  • Handles unresolved orders, troubleshoots where needed.
  • Verifies with physicians and/or nurses prior to laboratory information system (LIS) order entry to resolve unclear, duplicate or otherwise ambiguous orders.
  • Verifies specimens for add-on tests are available and acceptable and generates add-on test orders.
  • Recognizes when fraud and abuse compliance issues require adjustments to the test order
  • Collecting, receiving and processing of specimens:
  • Verifies specimens are correctly and completely labeled upon receipt. Evaluates specimens for appropriateness and takes necessary corrective action. Appropriately documents unacceptable specimens and proper notifications as needed.
  • Prioritizes specimen processing based on established priorities.
  • Aliquots specimens according to established protocols.
  • Performs all aspects of analytical testing appropriate for the specific laboratory section,following established written protocols and standard operating procedures (SOP)
  • Maintains test system integrity:
  • Performs preventive maintenance on instruments/equipment in a timely fashion according to defined schedule.
  • Verifies reagents and supplies meet defined acceptability criteria upon receipt and prior to use; takes action to ensure unacceptable items are removed from use.
  • Ensures that sufficient reagents and supplies necessary for test performance are available. Notifies senior staff when minimum inventory level is encountered.
  • Performs and records all necessary quality control (QC) required for test system performance.
  • Evaluates QC results and takes necessary corrective actions according to established protocol.
  • Performs specimen preparation:
  • Performs any necessary pretest specimen preparation according to protocols (e.g., microbiology plating, cell cultures, filtering, extraction, separation, elution, absorption, etc.)
  • Transfers or ships specimens to approved testing locations according to SOPs
  • Performs tests:
  • Prioritizes testing based on assignment or established priorities, completes testing within defined turn-around-times (TAT).
  • Recognizes the need for and follows any age-specific protocols
  • Responds effectively to changes in the workflow by coordinating a simultaneous series of tests when needed or adjusting work to incorporate STAT tests or fluctuations in work volume.
  • Monitors daily workflow and priorities to assure meeting service levels.
  • Performs technical review and interpretation:
  • Reviews results for completeness, correctness, and consistency within defined test system
  • Evaluates test results/reactions and provides accurate interpretations as appropriate to include correlation with, and integration of, other patient data as necessary.
  • Performs visual interpretation/identifications as appropriate.
  • Recognizes unusual test results/interpretations and completes indicated reflex testing or other follow-up actions.
  • Follows established notification protocols for critical values, phone/fax/e-mail results requests, abnormalities.
  • Troubleshoots and solves problems:
  • Recognizes test system performance problems and takes necessary corrective actions
  • Recognizes when unresolved problems need to be escalated and takes necessary follow-up action.
  • Prints pending logs and follows-up to ensure pending tests are completed or cancelled when appropriate.
  • Post-test specimen storage:
  • Stores specimens and related materials (blood, slides, tissues, etc.) according to protocols for location and duration.
  • Retrieves specimen and related materials when needed
  • Post-analytical responsibilities:
  • Performs all aspects of the post-analytical workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure accurate results are reported within established time frames, specimens are retained appropriately, test results and/or current status are available upon inquiry, and billed charges are correct for testing performed.
  • Verifies and reports results:
  • Verifies results according to procedure.
  • Performs computer functions necessary for releasing results.
  • Generates written reports according to established protocol.
  • Reviews electronic or printed reports when applicable, recognizes problems and escalates according to protocol.
  • Amends reports:
  • Corrects erroneous reports and amends reports according to procedure
  • Responds to inquiries:
  • Responds to requests for information according to established protocol for confidentiality and release of information
  • Recognizes when unresolved inquiries need to be escalated and takes action
  • Stores documents and records:
  • Stores documents and records according to established protocol.
  • Charge capture/billing:
  • Performs billing and/or enter credits for tests and services when applicable.
  • Recognizes billing problems and escalates accordingly
  • Universal responsibilities:
  • Ensures quality of operations:
  • Follows written standard operating procedures (SOP).
  • Operates instruments/equipment according to protocol.
  • Uses computers according to established protocol; follows downtime procedures as required.
  • Performs required quality system responsibilities
  • Meets proficiency and competency standards of the department.
  • Participates in the training of new employees and students
  • Performs operational review of new SOPs.
  • Participates in new test development, validations and implementation.
  • Attends at least one personal development session per year
  • Performs other duties as assigned, or as needed, to ensure continued quality operations
  • Ensures safety of operations:
  • Follows all required safety procedures, uses personal protective equipment (PPE) appropriate for tasks performed.
  • Maintains cleans and organized work area
  • Provides service excellence:
  • Answers telephone when needed, using NM telephone etiquette
  • Maintains patient confidentiality including protected health information (PHI)
  • Assists patients, visitors and other contacts whenever need occurs

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Technology, Medical Laboratory Science, Clinical Laboratory Science, Chemistry, Biology, or Allied Health qualifying the applicant to take the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or equivalent certification examination.
  • License/Certification and Regulatory Agency
  • General MLS or MT (ASCP) Certification or eligible or
  • Categorical BB, C, H or M (ASCP) Certification or eligible
  • If hired after 1/19/2025 must be ASCP certified (or equivalent certification) within one year of employment

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.
