title: Colour Material Finish Design Manager
description:
Material Design Manager will cover see the colour, material and finish (CMF) defining the material aesthetic and tactile direction for Etihad guest experience from Ground to Aircraft Cabin. Working closely with external consultants and internal stakeholders the CMF design manager articulates and captures the Etihad brand look & feel through colour, material, pattern and texture. The role collaborates closely with multiple stakeholders from Brand, Cabin Interiors, Product & Hospitality and Cabin Crew & Service to translate Brand Strategy into tangible Colour and Material Design opportunities in every touch point of the Guest Journey.

The role requires an ability and proven track-record of translating Brand into compelling CMF design strategies and tangible outcomes developed with external suppliers and manufacturers.
Strategic Mindset: The candidate needs to see the big picture to form a holistic design approach across multiple touchpoints.
Solution Oriented: The strategies need to be grounded in manufacturing realities and lead to implementable solutions both in the short and long term.
Technical Ability: The role requires understanding of material properties and requirements of soft goods, seats, aircraft cabin and architectural environments.
Aesthetic Sensitivity: Affinity to design trends in product and hospitality design and keen sense of brand language.
Collaboration: The role requires a highly collaborative and proactive mentality to align with multiple stakeholders and drive concepts forward.
Visualization and storytelling skills: Ability to visualize CMF concepts of products and environments in quick 2D sketch and fully developed 3D renderings. Impeccable presentation skills to craft a compelling narrative and visual storytelling.

1. Definition of material aesthetic and tactile direction for Etihad guest experience

  • Big picture strategy and holistic vision across multiple touchpoints
  • Lead material innovation initiatives through identification of opportunities and strategic development

2. Lead conceptual direction of material led soft products and hard products

  • CMF design of onboard soft products and amenities
  • CMF design support of new aircraft seat and cabin projects
  • CMF design support of architectural environments

3. Manage product and material development

  • Lead material and product development with internal partners and external suppliers for production, this can include new soft products or upgrades and replacements of existing materials within the aircraft cabins or ground spaces.

4. Stakeholder partnership

  • Partner with project leads across multiple development teams

5. Governing documentation

  • Creation of CMF guidelines for ground, aircraft, product and service.

6. Material asset library

  • Create and manage onsite material library that houses all Etihad in-production CMF samples and specifications
  • Create a digital and physical data base of industry relevant materials.
  • Establish and maintain supplier relationships and manage their representation in the physical material library.
  • Organize supplier visits for new product demonstrations
  • Bachelor's degree in the field of Design (Industrial, Interior, Transportation, Textile, Graphic) with specialized experience in Colour, Material, Finish design.
  • 7 years of experience in CMF design in a consultancy or in-house capacity, ideally in aviation, automotive, hospitality or guest-experience-driven industries.
  • Aviation material development knowledge
  • Expert in storytelling and articulation of concepts.
  • Strong interest in Design and Cultural trends
  • Strong visual, written and verbal presentation skills.
  • Strong design visualization skills.
  • Ability to lead and command respect as the subject matter expert.

title: Graduate Magnet Technologist
description:
About us

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

What you'll join

Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you?

If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance ground breaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come.

What you'll do

  • Contribute to the development of advanced superconducting magnet technologies for fusion energy, gaining hands-on experience in the design, modelling, testing and evaluation of magnets, materials and cryogenic systems.

  • Support specialist test facilities and a range of research and engineering activities, using data analysis to help translate scientific research into practical solutions while driving innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate with colleagues, industry and academic partners to deliver impactful projects, communicate findings, and develop technical, project management and stakeholder engagement skills in a supportive and inclusive environment.

How you'll develop

On the graduate scheme here at the UK Atomic Energy Authority, you will have 20% of your time focused on professional and personal development. This will include a series of core development activities to fast track your business acumen, along with skills for technical, project management and people leadership.

The remaining 80% of time is role-based, working within a team growing your technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. Working with your line manager, you will get the opportunity to experience different roles and responsibilities within projects to broaden your understanding and help decide your future career route.

What you'll need

  • Degree in Science or Engineering from 2025 to 2027
  • Driven, with a strong appetite to learn and take on new challenges
  • Able to collaborate effectively and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Well organised and adaptable with the ability to plan and prioritise workload

Benefits

We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include:

  • £35,227 base salary.
  • Final salary defined benefit scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution.
  • 25 days annual leave, plus 3 days Christmas closure and 2.5 privilege days, in addition to UK bank holidays.
  • Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions.
  • Take part in our Skern Lodge residential to develop new skills and build your network.

Our commitment to ED&I

UKAEA’s mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce. We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, while ensuring all appointments are made on merit.

UK Atomic Energy Authority is committed to being accessible. Please email earlycareerstalent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require any help or adjustments.

AI may be used for preparation purposes only. All responses submitted during interviews and assessments must be your own work.

To maintain a fair recruitment process, candidates are limited to two applications across our Early Careers programmes. If you apply for multiple roles, we may contact you to discuss which opportunities best match your skills and interests.

Applications are due to close at 23:59 on 8th November 2026. As we're expecting strong interest, we encourage you to apply early, as the vacancy may close sooner if we receive a high volume of applications. More information can be found here.

title: Senior Analyst - Database Integration & Data Automation
description:
Universal Technical Resource Services, Inc. (UTRS) is currently seeking a Database Integration & Data Automation Senior Analyst to join our team! At UTRS, we enjoy the benefits of working in a collaborative environment of close-knit team members. As a company, we provide a wide range of leading-edge engineering, management, and digital services to the public and private sectors. We are looking for someone that will support our mission to consistently deliver creative, high-quality, technology-based services to our customers on time and within budget.

This position will support a Federal Transit Administration (FTA) program. The Senior Analyst will provide technical and analytical support for database integration, data migration, data quality, workflow automation, reporting, and modernization activities.

The position will work closely with the project’s Senior Consultant/SME and Program Manager to maintain and enhance existing data-management processes while supporting migration and integration of program information across current and future platforms.

The ideal candidate has significant experience working with enterprise data, relational databases, system integrations, data migration, requirements analysis, data governance, workflow automation, and business intelligence/reporting solutions.

This position is Remote.

What will you be doing?

This position will be a key member of the FTA team. Duties include:

  • Support the Senior Consultant/SME with database integration, data migration, system modernization, and technical implementation
  • Analyze existing databases, datasets, business processes, and workflows to identify integration requirements, dependencies, data gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support the migration, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and validation of data between legacy and modernized systems.
  • Develop and maintain data mappings, data dictionaries, field definitions, database documentation, process documentation, and system requirements.
  • Perform data-quality reviews and reconciliation activities to identify duplicate, incomplete, inconsistent, or inaccurate information.
  • Support relational database development and maintenance, including Microsoft Access and other enterprise data platforms.
  • Develop and support automated workflows and business processes using tools such as Power Automate or comparable automation technologies.
  • Support development of dashboards, reports, queries, metrics, and analytical products using Power BI, SQL, Excel, and related tools.
  • Gather business and program requirements from stakeholders and translate them into technical, database, integration, and reporting requirements.
  • Conduct testing and validation of database changes, data migrations, integrations, automated workflows, and reporting solutions.
  • Troubleshoot data, database, integration, and workflow issues and coordinate resolution with technical and program stakeholders.
  • Support data governance, access controls, data integrity, auditability, and documentation requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes and improve the efficiency and reliability of program operations.
  • Prepare technical documentation, status information, briefings, recommendations, and implementation materials for project and Government stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with FTA personnel, project leadership, analysts, and technical resources to support program objectives.
  • Provide additional technical and analytical support for FTA transportation-safety programs as required.

What skills will the ideal candidate have to be successful?

This position will require the following skillsets and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree plus7 years of relevant professional experience, or Master’s degree plus 5 years of relevant professional experience or Education/experience equivalency
  • Significant professional experience with database integration, data migration, data management, data governance, or enterprise systems.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing business requirements and translating them into technical or data requirements.
  • Experience with relational databases, data mapping, data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality management.
  • Experience documenting databases, systems, workflows, technical requirements, and business processes.
  • Experience supporting enterprise system implementations, integrations, migrations, or modernization efforts.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Must successfully complete required FTA/DOT suitability requirements before beginning work on the FTA project.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Access, SQL, Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, Dataverse, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience developing automated workflows, dashboards, reporting solutions, or business-intelligence products.
  • Experience with cloud migrations, enterprise platform integrations, or legacy-system modernization.
  • Experience working with Federal Government programs or regulated environments.
  • Experience with data governance, auditability, regulatory reporting, or compliance-related data.
  • Experience supporting transportation, transit, aviation, or safety-management programs.
  • PMP, Six Sigma, Agile/Scrum, data analytics, or related professional certifications are desirable.

title: Senior Data Engineer- Data Platform
description:
ABOUT US

At Vida, we help people get better- and we're helping the healthcare system get better, too.
Vida is a virtual, personalized obesity care provider that uses evidence-based treatment to help patients manage obesity and related conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure, anxiety and depression. Vida's team of Obesity Medicine-Certified Physicians, Registered Dietitians, Expert Coaches and Licensed Therapists takes a whole-person approach to care, helping people lose weight, reduce stress and improve their overall health.
By combining advanced technology with top-notch healthcare providers, Vida is breaking down the barriers that have historically kept people from getting the best care. It's trusted by Fortune 100 companies, major national payers and large providers to enable their employees to live their healthiest lives.

Vida is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help shape the data platform that supports much of Vida's business. Our team builds and operates the systems that ingest, validate, transform, and serve data across Vida. We work with data from health plans, employers, clinical programs, and internal systems across member identity, eligibility, claims, billing, reporting, and analytics. You will own data systems and domains end to end, from ingestion and validation through storage, transformation, and delivery. You will make architecture decisions, change production systems safely, and help other engineers make good decisions about data infrastructure.

Responsibilities:

    • Own production data systems and domains from ingestion through delivery.
    • Design ingestion patterns that handle incomplete, duplicated, delayed, malformed, and changing partner data.
    • Define the contracts between source systems, ingestion, transformation, and downstream consumers.
    • Design data models with clear grain, keys, history, and definitions so the same question doesn't get two different answers.
    • Evolve schemas, pipelines, and datasets safely, with retries, backfills, and replay that don't corrupt or duplicate data.
    • Improve pipeline performance, observability, and failure handling so you can tell when something is wrong and why.
    • Work with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Analytics to figure out what the data needs to represent when requirements are incomplete or messy.
    • Additional responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree at a minimum.
  • 5+ years building production data systems.
  • Strong SQL and data modeling fundamentals, including grain, keys, history, dimensional modeling, and the tradeoffs between different representations of the same data.
  • Experience designing and operating batch and asynchronous data pipelines, including the failure modes that appear in distributed systems.
  • Experience with a cloud data platform and an understanding of storage, query performance, and cost.
  • Strong instincts around data correctness, including validation, idempotency, late and duplicated records, schema changes, backfills, and reprocessing.
  • Working proficiency in Python for pipelines, services, tooling, and tests.
  • The ability to change production systems in ordered, reversible steps without breaking their consumers.
  • Clear written communication, including documenting technical decisions and explaining changes to people outside of engineering.
  • You do not need previous healthcare experience or experience with every technology we use.

title: Trainee Auditor - Environment and Sustainability
description:
This opportunity is open to graduate students and junior professionals based in Mexico who are interested in developing an international career in social compliance, sustainability, and auditing.

As a Trainee Auditor, you will receive training and support to develop as a SMETA auditor and progress toward obtaining Certified Social Compliance Auditor (CSCA) status through APSCA.

Key Responsibilities

You will be expected to:

  • Conduct social compliance and environmental audits at the manufacturing sites of our clients’ suppliers, including announced and, where applicable, unannounced audits.
  • Assess compliance with applicable international standards, SMETA requirements, client-specific procedures, and relevant local regulations.
  • Evaluate areas including labor and human rights, occupational health and safety, environmental management, business ethics, and responsible business practices.
  • Identify potential violations and objectively document audit findings, evidence, and observations.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and detailed audit reports for clients.

APSCA Certification Pathway

  • Completing the APSCA registration process.
  • Participating in the required training and development activities.
  • Preparing for, taking, and successfully passing all required APSCA examinations.

  • Successful completion of the APSCA certification pathway and achievement of CSCA status are essential components of the position.

  • Maintain a professional, independent, impartial, and ethical approach throughout the audit process.
  • Interact professionally with factory management and employees while maintaining confidentiality and protecting the integrity of the audit.
  • Travel internationally and work at different manufacturing sites, as required.

  • Participate in internal training, calibration sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Currently completing the final semesters of a master’s degree, preferably in Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, Corporate Social Responsibility, Human Resources, Occupational Health and Safety, or a related field.

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong analytical, communication, interviewing, and report-writing skills.

title: Mes Software Engineer
description:
MES Software Engineer


Eagle Wireless is looking for an MES Software Engineer as part of the Software Team in the Solon, OH office.


Join us. Help build the networks the next generation of connected technology runs on.

Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.


Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that's where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.

Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.

If you want your work to matter in a world that's rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.


Job Summary:

Join our internal software team to develop and extend our in-house Manufacturing Execution System (MES). You'll work directly with our electronics manufacturing line to integrate production equipment, build end-to-end product traceability, and connect manufacturing data with operations and fulfillment systems.


Key Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain MES services that integrate with production line equipment, inspection systems, and line management software.
  • Design and implement traceability across work orders, serial numbers, parts, lots, and material consumption.
  • Integrate MES data with operations, fulfillment, and ERP systems.
  • Maintain production databases, including schema changes, data retention, and backups.
  • Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot MES services.
  • Build operator-facing tools for job setup and production preparation.
  • Work on the production floor with operators and manufacturing staff to understand processes and resolve issues.


Qualifications/Skills/Knowledge:

  • 0–5 years of software development experience, including production systems.
  • Strong programming skills (we use Python).
  • Experience designing and working with relational databases.
  • Experience building and maintaining integrations between systems.
  • Data modeling experience, ideally for traceability, inventory, or transactional systems.
  • Experience supporting live systems where downtime has a business impact.
  • Ability to work from limited documentation and make design decisions independently.
  • Solid programming fundamentals.
  • Ability to learn new tools and systems quickly.
  • Interest in manufacturing and working hands-on with production equipment.
  • MES, manufacturing, industrial, or embedded software experience.
  • Electronics manufacturing environments.
  • ERP integration.
  • Production metrics and reporting.
  • Internship, co-op, or project experience in manufacturing.


Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO, and paid parental leave programs.


Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.

title: Head of Material Operations
description:
This role is a valuable part of our Genentech Oceanside team, which is committed to maintaining seamless supply chain execution, high-quality warehousing operations, and cGMP compliance to ensure the delivery of vital therapies to patients. As a key member of this team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders across Manufacturing, Quality, Procurement, and Strategic Supply Planning. In this position, you will drive operational excellence, champion lean leadership, and shape strategic materials management across both site and network operations.

**The Opportunity**

**Leadership & People Management:**

- **Strategic Leadership & Financial Accountability:** Establish strategic goals and maintain full operational and financial responsibility (budget) for the Warehouse organization.
- **Team Leadership & Culture:** Build an inclusive, highly motivated, and agile workforce across onsite and remote teams—fostering high team spirit, effective communication, urgency, and long-term goal achievement.
- **Site & Network Collaboration:** Serve as an active change agent on the extended site leadership team, driving cross-functional planning, decision-making, and collaboration across local site and broader network activities.
- **Operational Excellence & Compliance:** Embody PT lean leadership and continuous improvement while proactively promoting a positive Safety Culture and strict cGMP operating principles.

**Technical & Functional:**

- **End-to-End Warehousing & Site Operations:** Oversee all core material handling for manufacturing (receipt, sampling, storage, internal transport, shipping, and MRO spare parts), including the management of the site working cell bank and backup master cell bank supporting SSF Cell Banking.
- **External Partnerships & Network Governance:** Serve as the primary interface for 3PLs, landlords, Procurement (SRM feedback), and outsourced manufacturing partners—managing execution (goods receipt, outbound deliveries, inventory transactions) and coordinating direct material QC testing to ensure GMP compliance.
- **Planning, Analytics & Quality Compliance:** Monitor and report warehouse capacity, capability, inventory accuracy, and health metrics (KPIs, PHIs, OTIF delivery) in partnership with Strategic/Supply Planning, while ensuring strict adherence to cGMPs, regulatory standards, and warehousing policies.
- **Network Integration, Leadership & Escalation:** Act as a Business Process Manager (MLD BPM) and Business Process Expert (BPE) on the network Warehouse Council, leading local/global projects and serving as the key PT escalation point for purchased or transferred material issues.

**Site Specific:**

- **Inventory & Multi-Site Material Governance:** Direct inventory management, stocking strategies, and substore operations for MRO spare parts, cell banking, and site materials across global and regional networks (OCN, HTO, RSTO, SSF, PZ).
- **Quality Release & Technical Support:** Oversee direct material release inputs (CoA documentation, sampling instructions, Raman testing) to ensure strictly compliant delivery to Quality within established SLAs, while supporting CMO execution (RSTO) and MES Master Data accuracy (MH).
- **Cross-Site & Regional Hub Leadership:** Serve as the strategic Network Hub for North American sites (OCN, SSF) and the local PT Hub interface (Basel-SM) to streamline communication, alignment, and network-wide standard practices.
- **External Partner & Facility Management:** Direct key management interfaces with service providers and landlords (Basel-Bio, PZ) to ensure full operational support for warehousing and facility infrastructure.

**Who you are**

**Education and Experience:**

- Bachelors and/or Master’s degree (materials management, business, or science is preferred) plus
- 15 years of total experience, including 5 years experience in supervisory role.
- 9-12 years’ experience in materials handling/management, warehousing, receiving, distribution, traffic, transportation, logistics, operations, and/or supply chain.
- DHS TSA clearance and CCSP experience
- DOT AITA experience
- APICS certification preferred or willing to work toward certification.

- **Industry & Technical Expertise:** Hands-on experience in biotech, pharmaceutical, or chemical manufacturing environments, backed by comprehensive knowledge of industry standards for materials handling, receiving, shipping, and storage.
- **Leadership & Collaboration:** Strong leadership and team-development abilities, paired with exceptional cross-functional communication and interpersonal skills.
- **Regulatory Compliance & Hazmat Safety:** In-depth working knowledge of cGMP concepts, Hazmat regulations, safe chemical handling/dispensing, Right-to-Know guidelines, and DOT compliance (including hazardous manifesting, placarding, and proper shipping names).
- **Systems & Software Proficiency:** Experienced with enterprise computer systems (MRP/SAP) in a validated environment, alongside proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Visio, Project).

Work Environment/Physical Demands/Safety Considerations

- Schedule may include some non-routine (outside of M-F 8-5 work hours) to support manufacturing schedules, audits, and other non-routine work.
- You may be on your feet for 2 to 3 hours a day.
- Climb upwards of 6 flights of stairs a day to maneuver within the manufacturing facility.
- Lift up to 25lbs may be required.
- Environment requires that gowning in the form of hospital scrubs, bunny suits, gloves and steel toe boots be worn.
- Work in clean room environment with large mechanical equipment, piping, and pumps connecting to tanks serviced by high-pressure steam, water and air.
- May work with hazardous materials.

title: Pathologists' Assistant-Casual Rotating
description:
This is a casual position with rotating shifts needed for an as-needed basis at Kishwaukee Hospital in DeKalb.

The Pathologists’ Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

In collaboration with the pathologist, the Pathologists’ Assistant is responsible for the gross pathology description and sampling of biopsy and/or other selected complex surgical tissue specimens. The dissection sampling and description is performed in accordance with established procedures to aid the pathologist in establishing the diagnosis. The Pathologists’ Assistant assists with resident training and provides a variety of activities in support of basic laboratory operations.

This position is responsible for communication with pathologists, residents, and coordinators regarding specimen problems. The position is also required to participate in the laboratory occurrence management program.

Responsibilities:

  • Performs all duties as scheduled by pathologist.
  • Performs gross examination and dissection of surgical biopsies and large complicated specimens. Maintains specimen integrity and accurate legible specimen identification throughout all technical and clerical processes. Produces high quality, high volume work in a timely fashion, always finding better/more efficient ways to do things.
  • Provides assistance with intra-operative consultations. Cuts, stains, and coverslips cryostat sections for timely review. Documents appropriate turn-around-time tracking information.
  • Prepares specimens for imaging and photographs specimens. Maintains imaging equipment and files. Organizes radiology files.
  • Participates in Perinatal and adult autopsies as assigned. Reviews autopsy permit and patient charts. Performs related autopsy procedures, reviews gross and microscopic findings with attending, and prepares draft PAD as appropriate.
  • Assists with orientation and instruction of pathology residents and medical students in Surgical Pathology and Autopsy procedures to include specimen description, dissections, dictation techniques, basic specimen handling, and use of Anatomic Pathology equipment. Provides clinical performance feedback on pathology residents.
  • Prepares materials and participates in conferences with residents, pathologists, and clinical staff.
  • Assists in distributing tissues and organs to approved researchers. Performs technical and clerical tasks related to research projects.
  • Exercises independent judgment in the performance of technical responsibilities. Prioritizes technical workload based on assignment or established priorities, responds effectively to changes in workflow adjusting work to incorporate STAT requests or fluctuations in work volume.
  • Practices the proficient and safe use of all equipment necessary for the completion of all duties and responsibilities within defined turn-around times. Cleans, disinfects, performs, and documents routine equipment and workspace maintenance per SOP. Reports equipment or instrument malfunctions appropriately.
  • Assists manager and/or pathologist in development and implementing new and special procedures or techniques. May assist in maintaining procedure manuals in accordance with practice guidelines and requirements of regulatory agencies.
  • Participates in quality and process improvement efforts. Identifies ways to improve work processes and improve customer satisfaction. Makes recommendations to manager, implements and monitors changes as requested.
  • Maintains a clean and safe work area. Follows established laboratory safety procedures in accordance with those regulatory bodies such as OSHA, FDA, EPA, etc. Observes and practices Universal Precautions when handling biohazardous material. Assumes a proactive role in laboratory safety and participates in development of safety protocols in surgical pathology. Performs minor spill cleanup per SOP when necessary.
  • Participates in cost containment initiatives. Responsible for efficient use of supplies and reagents and proper operation of instrumentation.
  • Provides backup assistance in a variety of activities in support of basic laboratory operations.
  • Records all documentation consistently and legibly. May create Standard Operating Procedures. Maintains manuals and electronic records for easy retrieval of data as necessary. Investigates, escalates, and documents any discrepancies or unresolved issues appropriately.
  • Fosters department and laboratory teamwork through effective communication. Adapts to change and handles stressful situations effectively
  • Takes initiative for personal development by attending teleconferences, educational sessions, and required meetings, etc.

Additional Functions:

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Assists in specific process improvement projects.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college/university
  • Successful completion of NAACLA accredited Pathologists’ Assistant program within the last five years.

title: Cloud Architect
description:
We're looking for an experienced Cloud Architect to join our organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture, governance, and cost-effective operation of Ergomed's Cloud (Microsoft Azure) environment. This hands-on role leads the design of new and improvements to existing Azure projects, builds reusable deployment templates and standards, and provides architectural review across the tenant — collaborating with project teams on solution design and standards, with IT stakeholders on demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), and with IT Operations on day-to-day support

  • Lead the architecture of new and existing Azure projects, recommending solutions and reviewing designs to ensure strong, repeatable foundations tailored to meet organizational requirements and business objectives
  • Analyze current infrastructure and applications to identify optimization opportunities, cost reduction strategies, and migration pathways to cloud environments
  • Drive improvements in Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, Advisor reviews, and reservation/commitment strategies.
  • Build and maintain reusable project templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules so new workloads are provisioned consistently and correctly.
  • • Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them.
  • Develop, implement and maintain cloud governance frameworks, security policies, and compliance standards to ensure adherence to industry regulations and organizational standards
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps engineers, security specialists, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into solution architectures that meets Ergomed's cloud standards and updating those standards where required
  • Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them.
  • Define and maintain tagging, naming, and subscription-structure standards, driving their consistent adoption across the tenant.
  • Work with IT Security and workload teams to achieve and maintain demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), putting the right controls in place so compliance status can be evidenced at any time.
  • Evaluate and recommend cloud technologies, tools, and services that align with organizational needs, including containerization platforms, orchestration systems, and infrastructure-as-code solutions
  • Oversee cloud infrastructure deployments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery capabilities are properly implemented and tested
  • Establish best practices for cloud resource management, including monitoring, performance optimization, and automated provisioning
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development and operations teams on cloud architecture patterns and cloud-native application design

**Required Qualifications:**

  • Extensive experience in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, or cloud architecture, with significant hands-on experience designing and running Azure environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in a cloud architecture or senior technical role
  • Deep, hands-on Azure architecture expertise: landing zones, management groups, networking, identity, storage, compute, and security.
  • Proven ability to design and build reusable deployment templates using Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Bicep, Terraform, ARM).
  • Strong understanding of Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, reservations/savings plans, and Azure Advisor
  • Experience defining and enforcing cloud governance frameworks: Azure Policy, management groups, RBAC, and tagging/naming standards.
  • Experience maintaining compliance against frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA, including control implementation and audit evidence.
  • Ability to translate architectural designs into operational requirements, working with IT Operations on support models.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of resolving complex cloud infrastructure issues.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with GxP and GAMP5 frameworks, and experience supporting regulated (validated) cloud systems.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  • Experience with multi-cloud strategies and hybrid cloud architectures
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps principles
  • Experience with serverless architectures and microservices design patterns
  • Background in enterprise application migration and modernization projects

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

title: Development Program Manager
description:
_Salary is determined based on experience and the Foundation’s structured pay bands, which include steps for growth and performance. Please see the “Pay” section for more details._

**Priority Application Deadline:** October 22, 2026

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Starting Salary:** $68,616 - $80,052 (Step I - Step II)

**Work Location:** Hybrid

* * *

### About the Position

As the Development Program Manager, you will play a key role in advancing our mission by overseeing key programs and projects that support the philanthropic goals of the Schools and Programs (S&P) fundraising team. You will be collaborating closely with development officers, the Development Support Supervisor, the Assistant Vice President (AVP), and the Advancement Data Strategy team.

### What You'll Be Doing

Program and Project Management

- You will partner with development officers in their fundraising units to plan and execute donor strategy, including engagement, cultivation, and stewardship plans for major and principal gift prospects.
- You will lead program support for emerging fundraising opportunities, including mapping faculty and donor relationships, identifying prospects, and supporting the development of fundraising cases.
- You will oversee councils and volunteer groups within assigned units, including meeting planning, communications, and member engagement.
- You will plan and coordinate unit-specific donor events in collaboration with special events and fundraising leads.

Team-Wide Support

- You will produce regular team-wide reports on pipeline, portfolio activity, proposals, and gift progress for the Assistant Vice President (AVP) and development officers, in partnership with Advancement Data Strategy.
- You will prepare data and analysis for portfolio reviews, prospect strategy sessions, and annual planning in partnership with Advancement Data Strategy.
- You will provide data for team-wide projects, including endowment reporting, in coordination with the Development Support Supervisor.

Department Support and Special Projects

- You will partner closely with other support team members to proactively plan and address support needs for the fundraising team and enhance processes and procedures to work collaboratively and efficiently.
- You will serve as liaison and relationship builder to OHSU departments within the fundraising units of the team.

### Who You Are

- You're able to take initiative and work independently, with a high level of accountability.
- Your strong project/program management and organizational skills give you the ability to independently manage and prioritize multiple projects and tasks.
- Your demonstrated interpersonal skills give you the ability to collaborate professionally, diplomatically and productively with contacts at all levels, including faculty, council members, donors, and other OHSU and Foundation colleagues.
- You're compassionate and culturally responsive, with the ability to work well with internal and external individuals and groups from diverse backgrounds and lived experiences.
- Your analytical skills give you the ability to analyze and present data.
- Your excellent verbal and written communication skills give you the ability to communicate with contacts at all levels.

### You should have

- At least 3 years of relevant experience, including project or program management
- Experience working with a CRM, such as Salesforce
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, with an emphasis on Excel
- Experience working in a nonprofit, higher education, or fundraising environment preferred

We want to emphasize that there is no such thing as the perfect candidate; candidates who do not have all of the required experience are encouraged to apply.

### Working Conditions

- Occasional hours outside of normal business hours may be required at times
- Some local travel may be necessary

Salary

$68,616—$80,052 USD

### Pay

Salary is dependent on experience. Each salary band is broken into three "steps," which correspond with an employee’s experience/tenure, proficiency and performance in that specific role. New employees will typically start at step I of our pay band to allow for later growth, although more experienced candidates may be eligible to start at step II or III. The OHSU Foundation has a structured process for determining starting compensation, taking into account years of related experience, applicable skills, knowledge and abilities, market parity, and internal equity.

### Benefits

The OHSU Foundation also offers an exceptional benefits package including:

- Comprehensive medical and dental insurance.
- Pension program (The Foundation contributes 12% of your annual salary to a pension);
- 22 days of paid vacation, 11 paid holidays, 1 float holiday and 2 days of volunteer time off;
- Professional development dollars for each employee;
- Hybrid work allowance and much more!

Plus, we have a flexible work environment for those who prefer a hybrid work schedule, and we close early on Fridays during the summer. Want to learn more about our other amazing benefits? Check out our benefits page to [learn more](https://ohsufoundation.org/careers/benefits/) about our benefits.

Please note that benefits may vary for employees residing outside of Oregon, Washington, Arkansas, Alaska, Arizona, and Nevada due to state-specific regulations and coverage differences. Employees located outside of these states may be required to work through a Professional Employer Organization (PEO).

title: Team Leader
description:
Description

At Hansen Corporation, an ElectroCraft Company, we value craftsmanship, teamwork, safety, and continuous improvement. The Team Leader is responsible for supporting the daily execution of manufacturing operations through hands-on involvement on the production floor, while providing leadership for a team of employees. The Team Leader coordinates daily work activities, supports employee development and engagement, drives continuous improvement efforts, and helps ensure departmental goals for safety, quality and productivity are achieved.
The Team Leader is expected to perform production-related duties while leading, coaching, and supporting team members throughout the shift, completing standardized work audit sheets, tracking operational metrics, and problem solving.


About Our Company

Hansen Corporation, an ElectroCraft company, specializes in synchronous motors and DC motor production as part of the ElectroCraft family of motion control products that provide dependable, application-engineered fractional-horsepower motors and motion control products.

Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, work direction, coaching, and support for a team of approximately 5–20 employees.
  • Promote a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Coach employees on safety procedures, quality standards, standardized work, and productivity expectations.
  • Provide employee training and update training per procedures, including Safety, and ISO guidelines
  • Work with Group Leaders on development and cross training of team members
  • Provide feedback to Group Leader regarding employee performance
  • Coordinate daily work assignments, hold regular team meetings
  • Lead team communication and investigate production, quality, and safety concerns, escalating issues when appropriate.
  • Support the achievement of departmental goals related to safety, quality, productivity, and cost.
  • Record and use process metrics (Safety, Quality, Productivity, etc.)
  • Utilize operational metrics to identify opportunities for improvement and support action plans.
  • Monitor and report quality related data and reports, implement countermeasures to eliminate/reduce waste
  • Monitor quality performance and support corrective actions to address defects and nonconformances.
  • Support Lean Manufacturing initiatives including 5S, continuous improvement, standardized work, and problem-solving activities.
  • Sustain 5S and housekeeping expectations
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong leadership, coaching, and interpersonal skills, acting as a role model on attendance, dependability, and reliability
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to motivate team members, a passion for improvement, and willingness to make things better
  • Must possess solid interpersonal, communication, influencing, self-motivation, self-direction, and other soft leadership skills
  • Attention to detail with strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Basic Math, Reading, and Comprehension skills. Excellent time management skills
  • Effectively use Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, et al packages)
  • Prior experience with ERP systems (such as Microsoft AX) preferred.
  • Familiarity with Lean tools a plus (VSM, 5S, Kanban, TPM, SMED)

Position Qualifications

  • High School Diploma/GED
  • 2 years in Manufacturing environment. Experience training, coaching, mentoring, or directing the work of others preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials as required.
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to machinery, noise, and varying temperatures.
  • Ability to perform production duties while leading and supporting team members.

Benefits

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

title: ServiceNow Consultant
description:
Why are you looking for a job?

If your answer ticks all the boxes, then maybe we can work together.

  • You have a curious mind - You won't understand what we're talking about if you don't.
  • You want to learn and try new things, even outside your comfort zone - You won't survive if you don't.
  • You like being precise - Even other people might hate you for that.
  • You want to make the world a bit better - We dont like you if you don't.

If you tick the above, then keep reading.

﻿

Squaredev?

We build great software! We use state-of-the-art technology to build solutions for our own customers and for the customers of our partners. We make sure we stay the best in class by contributing in research projects, where we collaborate with high-end partners across Europe.

Furthermore, we want to become a great company with the best team!

﻿

What you need to bring to the table

  • Learning attitude. We all have strong minds, as long as we work out the right muscles.
  • An impact in the company. You need to speak up. Loud. You are part of this.
  • Your failures. Yeah, you read it right. Everyone fails. Get used to it. Learn from it. Wear it as a badge.
  • A smile during our morning stand up.
    ﻿

Let's discuss the job

At Squaredev, we help organizations design, build and scale modern digital workflows using ServiceNow. We work closely with our clients to understand their business challenges and translate them into secure, scalable and efficient platform solutions.

We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Consultant who combines hands-on development skills with a strong consulting mindset. This role involves active participation in projects, close collaboration with clients and ownership of end-to-end ServiceNow solutions.

You will act as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation, contributing both to solution design and to high-quality development.

﻿

What's your responsibilities:

  • Design, configure and develop ServiceNow solutions aligned with client business processes.
  • Work closely with clients to understand their requirements, challenges and objectives through meetings and regular communication.
  • Translate business requirements into technical designs, leveraging ServiceNow out-of-the-box capabilities where possible.
  • Develop and customize ServiceNow applications, workflows and integrations using JavaScript and platform best practices.
  • Collaborate with distributed, cross-functional and international teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support solution architecture activities in cooperation with Technical Architects, ensuring alignment with enterprise systems.
  • Produce clear and structured documentation, including technical designs, configuration documentation and release notes.
  • Identify risks, constraints and technical issues early, communicating them proactively to the team.
  • Ensure solution quality, security, compliance with standards and data privacy requirements.
  • Contribute to workshops, demos and presentations, communicating technical concepts in a clear and business-oriented way.
  • Take ownership of your deliverables and working independently.
    ﻿

What you'll need:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in designing and implementing SaaS or enterprise platform solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow implementation and configuration.
  • Solid understanding of the software lifecycle and ServiceNow practices.
  • Experience working on complex IT projects or large-scale ServiceNow implementations.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to map business processes to platform capabilities.
  • Client-oriented mindset with the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Willingness to travel when project needs require it.
    ﻿

Nice to have (not required):

  • ServiceNow certifications (one or more of CSA, CAD, ITSM, HRSD, CSM, PPM, CAD etc.).
  • Experience with integrations and related technologies (REST, SOAP, APIs, JSON, XML).
  • Knowledge of authentication and security concepts (SSO, SAML, SSL).
  • Familiarity with relational databases (e.g. SQL, Oracle).
  • Front-end or scripting experience (JavaScript, HTML, CSS).
  • Awareness of cybersecurity and data protection considerations.
    ﻿﻿

How to apply?

Apply directly via this platform, and we will reach out to you!

﻿

Conclusion

Well that's it. Apply if you like our spirit! Also, feedback and questions are welcome. We want to become better and learn from you, whether you want to join or you're in the mood to help. Thanks for your time reading this. Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Anti-Data Scientist
description:
Location: Remote (Waterlily HQ is based on San Francisco, CA)

About Us

Waterlily uses AI to help families prepare for the largest financial and medical event in their lives, long-term care (LTC). Through comprehensive care planning and optimization, Waterlily is bending Americas multi-trillion dollar LTC cost curve.

Our Team & Culture

We've built a high-performance team culture based on three core principles:

Mission-Driven Excellence

  • We're deeply committed to transforming how families prepare for long-term care
  • Every team member genuinely believes in our mission and understands its importance
  • We prioritize work that drives meaningful impact for our customers and company

Be a Potato: Growth & Resilience

  • We embrace challenges and adapt quickly - like potatoes that grow under any circumstances
  • We make decisions swiftly while remaining thoughtful and open to iteration
  • We focus on execution and results rather than just effort, recognizing that input doesn't necessarily equal output
  • We value team members who show unlimited potential for growth and understanding

Radical Transparency & Support

  • We practice direct, honest communication while maintaining empathy and respect
  • Feedback flows freely in all directions - from intern to leadership and back
  • We begin meetings with brief check-ins to understand each other's context
  • We create safe spaces for vulnerability and authentic collaboration
  • We maintain high standards while supporting each other's growth and wellbeing

Our team comprises some of the brightest, most ambitious, playful, and friendly people youll meet. Youll be working closely with our founding Waterlily team, including Lily, Evan, and Tim, and have direct access to a support team in the Philippines.

Lily Vittayarukskul, our CEO, is a patented inventor who started college at 14, attending UC Berkeley, was working at NASA when she was 16, and lead product and engineering at IoT medical device startups for years before founding Waterlily.

Evan Ehrenberg, our COO, is a member of Forbes 30 Under 30, started college at 11, also attending UC Berkeley, and then continued on to his Ph.D. in computational neuroscience at MIT at 16 before dropping out at 21 to found Clara Health, a clinical trials SaaS platform and B2B2C marketplace, which he sold 7 years later before joining Waterlily.

Our founding engineer and data scientist, Tim Chung, holds a Masters of Computer Science from UPenn and is midway through a Data Science Masters at Georgia Tech. Tim excels in a trio of roles: data scientist, machine learning engineer, and full-stack software engineer. At his previous companies, he led teams to launch pioneering machine learning models.

How We Work

  • We optimize for remote-first collaboration while maintaining high productivity
  • We emphasize contextual decision-making and practical solutions
  • We prioritize deep work and focused execution over unnecessary meetings
  • We consistently validate that we're working on the highest-impact initiatives
  • We maintain a healthy, growth-oriented mindset while pushing for exceptional results

We're looking for teammates who share our values of integrity, empathy, and intelligent hard work - people who can see beyond their immediate role to understand both company needs and customer impact.

About You ⭐

We're seeking a talented full-stack data scientist who embodies our values of resilience, execution focus, and mission-driven innovation. The ideal candidate isn't just a skilled data scientist they're a builder who sees beyond code to understand the larger business and human impact of their work.

What Makes You Stand Out

Growth Mindset & Adaptability

  • You're a "potato" - able to grow and thrive under any circumstances
  • You have a track record of rapidly learning new technologies and business domains
  • You see challenges as opportunities and adapt quickly to changing priorities
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make swift, informed decisions

Innovation & Execution

  • You have a history of building solutions that challenge traditional approaches
  • You can point to specific examples where you've used automation or AI to multiply your impact
  • You focus on getting things done rather than achieving perfection on the first try
  • You have experience or strong interest in leveraging LLMs and offshore teams as force multipliers

Leadership & Communication

  • You give and receive direct feedback with grace and professionalism
  • You can clearly explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • You're comfortable leading discussions and driving decisions
  • You naturally build trust through transparency and reliable execution

Mission Alignment

  • You're drawn to meaningful work that impacts families' lives
  • You understand that sustained high performance requires maintaining personal wellbeing
  • You're excited about joining a team that values both ambitious goals and sustainable pace
  • You're genuinely interested in transforming how families prepare for long-term care

The Ideal Background

While we value potential over experience, you likely have:

  • Demonstrated ability to own and deliver full-stack projects end-to-end
  • Experience with modern web development frameworks and cloud architecture
  • Track record of improving team efficiency through automation and process innovation
  • History of taking initiative and driving results without extensive oversight

We're not looking for someone who's done it all before we're looking for someone who has the raw talent and drive to help us pioneer new approaches to software development and team collaboration. If you're excited about pushing boundaries, learning rapidly, and making a real difference in people's lives, we want to talk to you.

About The Role

You will be tasked with owning and scaling mission-critical features across the entire software stack. The goal will be to push beyond industry best-practices in software development by innovating new strategies that leverage LLMs and offshore teams to achieve company-defining results for a fraction of the time and cost of what other companies have previously achieved.

You will be working with our founding US-based team and report directly to our co-founder and COO, Evan Ehrenberg, and you will grow to work with and support the management of a team of 40+ in the Philippines. You will collaborate on new ideas and implement quickly to test and iterate. Many ideas will not work and will be thrown away. Many ideas will need to be imperfect so that we can implement them faster. Everything will be iterative, no challenge will be too ambitious.

You will be challenged to produce meaningful results every week. It will likely take you more than 40 hours per week to drive industry-leading results. We do not think that 80 hour weeks are sustainable or effective in the long run, and so while there may be incredibly important times where we mutually decide to be opportunistic to push ourselves to that amount of work to accomplish something very time sensitive, we expect you to generally limit yourself to 50-60 hour work-weeks. If you want to push harder we will urge you to reflect on ways to be more effective with your time so that you can dedicate your remaining time to benefit your mental and physical health.

We will be in the trenches with you, and together we will create one of the most impactful companies that will help families prepare for what has historically been one of the most devastating times in their lives so that they can face long-term care with confidence and calm.

Key Responsibilities ️

  • Product Driven Customer Success: Your mission is to surprise and delight our customers through product initiatives that go above and beyond to make Waterlily their favorite company to work with.
  • Full-Stack Development Leadership: Own and architect mission-critical features across the entire software stack, from frontend React/TypeScript applications to backend Node.js services, ensuring scalable and maintainable solutions that meet enterprise customer needs.
  • AI/ML Integration: Design and implement innovative solutions leveraging LLMs and AI technologies to automate workflows, enhance product capabilities, and create novel approaches to software development that surpass traditional industry practices.
  • Technical Architecture & Scalability: Develop and maintain AWS serverless architecture while ensuring system reliability, performance, and security at scale as we service Fortune 100 customers and major insurance carriers.
  • Product Engineering: Collaborate closely with founders to rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on new features, balancing speed of implementation with code quality to achieve fast market validation.
  • Offshore Team Leadership: Work with and support the management of a 40+ person Philippines-based team for QA testing, establishing best practices for collaboration and implementing systems to maximize team efficiency.
  • Process Innovation: Pioneer new approaches to software development by combining LLMs, automation tools, and offshore resources to achieve significant improvements in development speed and cost-effectiveness.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with various departments to identify technical solutions for business challenges, particularly in areas of customer success, sales operations, and marketing automation.
  • Technical Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for systems, processes, and novel development approaches to enable knowledge sharing and team scaling.

Key Skills & Qualifications

  • Technical Expertise:
    • We know that the best data scientists will pick up whatever tools they need on the job, but we also need you to hit the ground running, so be ready to learn very fast if you are not already familiar with certain tools in our stack.
    • Preferred Experience:
      • Strong foundation in full-stack development using React, TypeScript, and Node.js
      • Experience with AWS serverless architecture and cloud infrastructure
      • Proficiency in Python for ML/algorithmic implementations
      • Familiarity with modern development tools and practices including version control, CI/CD, and testing frameworks
  • AI/LLM Proficiency:
    • Demonstrated experience with LLM integration and prompt engineering
    • Ability to identify opportunities for AI automation and implementation
    • Understanding of AI/ML best practices and limitations
  • Leadership & Management:
    • Experience working with distributed teams
    • Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on multiple initiatives
    • History of driving technical initiatives from conception to completion
  • Problem-Solving & Innovation:
    • Proven ability to tackle complex technical challenges with innovative solutions
    • Experience optimizing development processes and improving team efficiency
    • Track record of implementing creative solutions that challenge traditional approaches
    • Comfort with ambiguity and ability to make decisions with incomplete information
  • Communication & Collaboration:
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
    • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
    • Experience working directly with customers and external stakeholders
    • Strong documentation skills for both technical and process-related content
  • Growth Mindset & Learning Agility:
    • Demonstrated history of rapid skill acquisition and adaptation
    • Eagerness to learn new technologies and methodologies
    • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently
    • Track record of staying current with industry trends and emerging technologies
  • Business Acumen:
    • Understanding of startup environments and business priorities
    • Ability to balance technical excellence with business requirements
    • Experience with customer-facing roles or products
    • Knowledge of or interest in healthcare/finance/insurance technology
  • Recommended Experience:
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
    • 3+ years of full-stack development experience
    • Demonstrable portfolio of projects or contributions showing technical expertise
    • Experience with modern development workflows and tools

Why Join Us?

  • Backed by top VCs: Our largest investor, Insight Partners, is a leading multi-billion dollar global firm renowned for backing innovative companies like Wiz, Calm, and Monday, and helping them grow to become industry leaders. Our Seed round was massively oversubscribed and saw many of our enterprise customers and prospects investing directly.
  • Customers Love Us: Check out some of our latest success case studies and customer testimonials and see why our customers love us so much.
  • Industry Giants Onboard: After launching in March this year weve already closed 3 Fortune 100 customers, 4 insurance carriers, one of the largest LTC providers in the Midwest, and one of the largest insurance distributors in the US.
  • Direct Mentorship and Development from our Co-Founders: Receive guidance and resources to develop your skills and become an operator unlike anything this industry has seen before.
  • Growth Opportunities: Learn to run your own product, directly interface with the enterprise executives who are our customers, work across multiple departments, and gain diverse experience that will propel your career forward.
  • Impact: Play a key role in shaping the future of our company and making a tangible difference for families across America and the world.
  • Dynamic Environment: Work in a fast-paced, innovative startup culture that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

How to Apply:

If youre ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role, we want to hear from you! Please send your resume and a brief cover letter explaining why youre the perfect fit for this position to

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The Immediate Care Technician supports physicians (MD) and advance practice providers (APP) by facilitating patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. title: On-Call Chaplain-Delnor
description:
On-Call Chaplain

Location: Delnor Hospital, 300 S Randall Rd, Geneva, IL 60134, USA

On-Call Hours:

  • Monday thru Friday 4:00 PM – 8:00 AM
  • Saturday/Sunday: 24-hour shifts: 8:00 AM – 8:00 AM

*Chaplain, On-Call will carry the On-Call pager and need to be within a 30-minute radius of the Hospital.

*Chaplain, On-Call will have opportunities for additional daytime shifts based upon the scheduling needs of the Spiritual Care Department.

Required to be considered:

  • One unit of Clinical Pastoral Education or equivalent.
  • Bachelor’s degree in theology, related field, or advanced studies equivalent.

Job Description

Chaplains support spiritual well-being by assisting patients, families, and staff members to cope with the uncertainty, stress, and critical demands of the hospital setting. Chaplains are patient-centered in their approach, supporting others to identify sources of meaning and hope by drawing upon the values, beliefs, religious resources, and spiritual practices that are most nourishing for them. Chaplains’ scope of practice includes: conducting spiritual assessments and tailoring interventions to the individualized needs of patients; providing emotional and spiritual support; guiding advance care planning conversations to advocate for patient needs and wishes; facilitating religious rituals, providing sacraments, and leading prayer, blessings, and guided meditations; serving as a liaison to community clergy; and collaborating on clinical cases, ethics discussions, and hospital initiatives as an active member of the inter-professional team.

The Chaplain reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines, and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Provides spiritual care to patients, families, and staff:

  • Provides compassionate spiritual care to patients and families of all backgrounds through direct visitation, and by telephone, as needed.
  • Conducts a spiritual assessment, provides appropriate interventions, and develops a care plan.
  • Consults with the interdisciplinary team when making an assessment and coordinating the plan of care.

Required:

  • Master’s degree in divinity or related field.
  • Two years of hospital related experience.
  • Bi-lingual in English and Spanish preferred.
  • Board Certification.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Overview

If you are passionate about water and technology, Trinnex is the place for you! Trinnex is a visionary company that is transforming the way water resources are managed and protected. By combining cutting-edge digital technologies, such as sensor/IoT data, models, geospatial data, and AI/machine learning, we create innovative, smart, and scalable solutions that make a difference. Whether it's optimizing water supply and demand, detecting leaks and anomalies, or enhancing water quality and resilience, Trinnex delivers value and impact to public sector clients across the country.

Job Description

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who reside and work in British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, or Ontario, where the company is registered to operate.

Trinnex, a wholly owned subsidiary of CDM Smith, is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join our growing Digital Solutions team. You’ll work on modern, high- impact applications that bring together sensor and IoT data, geospatial technologies, machine learning, and AI-powered agent systems to solve real-world engineering and environmental challenges. In this role, you’ll help shape next-generation intelligent applications, including systems that use autonomous and semi-autonomous agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agent orchestration frameworks. You’ll work across the full technology stack, collaborate with a talented, cross-functional team, and have the opportunity to influence technical direction while building scalable, production-ready solutions.

Full Stack & API Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable frontend and back-end applications using modern frameworks and architectures.
  • Build, integrate, and optimize REST, GraphQL, and other APIs to support secure, high performing systems.
  • Apply best practices in code quality, security, performance optimization, and testing throughout the development lifecycle.

AI Enabled & Agent Based Systems

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of AI driven features, including agent-based workflows and intelligent application components.
  • Support systems that use retrieval augmented generation (RAG), vectorized data access, and contextual retrieval strategies.
  • Collaborate on architectures that enable agent orchestration and agent to agent (A2A) communication.

Testing, Deployment, and DevOps Collaboration

  • Develop and execute automated testing strategies to ensure reliability and performance.
  • Deploy applications through CI/CD pipelines and partner with DevOps teams to support scalability, monitoring, and production readiness.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across the application stack.

Collaboration, Mentorship, and Delivery

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, DevOps, and domain experts on solution design and feature delivery.
  • Conduct code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices.
  • Mentor and support junior developers across frontend, backend, and integration work.

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong experience designing and developing full stack web applications.
  • Proficiency with modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React with Context API and Hooks).
  • Experience with back-end development using C#/.NET and JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js, Next.js, Express).
  • Solid understanding of API design, data integration, and system architecture.
  • Experience with geospatial technologies such as ESRI, PostGIS, and Mapbox.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and solve complex technical problems.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • Experience designing or contributing to agentic systems, including multi step or multi agent workflows.
  • Understanding of RAG patterns, agent orchestration concepts, and A2A communication models.
  • Familiarity with AI development tools and assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor).
  • Proactive mindset toward learning and applying emerging technologies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 5 years of related experience.

Equivalent additional directly related experience will be considered in lieu of a college degree. Domestic and/or international travel may be required. The frequency of travel is contingent on specific duties, responsibilities, and the essential functions of the position, which may vary depending on workload and project demands.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms and Kubernetes-based environments.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience building AI-driven or agent-based applications in production.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and standardized agent access to local and remote data.
  • Practical experience implementing RAG solutions, including document ingestion, vector storage, and contextual retrieval.

title: TEAP Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Trainee Employee Assistance Program (TEAP) Drug and Alcohol Coordinator is responsible for conducting substance‑use assessments for students, developing individualized intervention plans, and making appropriate referrals. The coordinator leads prevention efforts by designing and implementing educational activities, facilitating group sessions, and providing counseling and relapse‑prevention support.

This role collaborates closely with center staff and community agencies to ensure the delivery of integrated, comprehensive, and high‑quality services to all students.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Conducts TEAP assessments and develops individualized intervention and support plans.
  • Facilitates group sessions, workshops, and prevention‑focused educational programs.
  • Provides counseling, prevention education, and relapse‑prevention support to students.
  • Collaborates with center departments and community agencies to coordinate comprehensive student support services.
  • Participates in department processes that address student concerns, feedback, and program needs.
  • Assists in creating, maintaining, and updating operating procedures related to TEAP program components.
  • Works collaboratively with the Center Mental Health Consultant, Center Physician, Health Services staff, and other designated personnel to ensure proper integration of intervention strategies.
  • Coordinates with the Recreation Department to develop activities and incentive programs that promote a healthy, substance‑free lifestyle consistent with TEAP goals.
  • Serves as a liaison between TEAP, the Center Mental Health Consultant, and the Center Standards Officer on matters related to substance‑use intervention and program compliance.
  • Performs quality‑assurance audits of program files and documentation.
  • Maintains TEAP‑related data and prepares quarterly reports required by the Department of Labor.
  • Ensures proper specimen collection, documentation, and handling in accordance with chain‑of‑custody standards.
  • Supports the Center’s Tobacco Use Prevention Program by providing training, education, and ongoing reinforcement of prevention strategies.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in:
    • Psychology
    • Social Work
