title: Graduate Computational Scientist
description:
About us

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

What you'll join

Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you?

If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance ground breaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come.

The Computing division at UKAEA runs a comprehensive computing programme exploring the use of new technologies to allow faster and more detailed studies of the physics and engineering problems associated with creating sustained and controlled fusion reactions. You will join the Materials Simulation group, which develops predictions based on physical-mathematical models informed by cutting-edge supercomputing simulations for what happens to structural reactor materials when subjected to the extreme conditions inside a fusion reactor. See here for an example.

What you'll do

  • As part of an established, supportive team of computational scientists and engineers, you will learn to: apply advanced computational methods to study materials evolving under fusion-relevant conditions, contribute to the creation of new modelling approaches, and evaluate new computational tools.
  • Contribute to the development of physical-mathematical multiscale models (using methods ranging from atomistic simulations, to finite-element modelling, to data-driven approaches) of how irradiation by high-energy neutrons, generating defects on the nanoscale, leads to changes in materials properties on the reactor component scale.
  • Deliver project work and build technical expertise, managing assigned tasks, communicating progress effectively, and engaging with technical and scientific communities to share knowledge and support innovation.
  • Take an active role in the UKAEA Graduate Scheme, participating in training and development activities, collaborating across different teams through placements and projects, supporting outreach and early careers initiatives, and acting as a positive ambassador for UKAEA’s inclusive and collaborative culture.

How you'll develop

On the graduate scheme here at the UK Atomic Energy Authority, you will have 20% of your time focused on professional and personal development. This will include a series of core development activities to fast track your business acumen, along with skills for technical, project management and people leadership.

The remaining 80% of time is role-based, working within a team growing your technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. Working with your line manager, you will get the opportunity to experience different roles and responsibilities within projects to broaden your understanding and help decide your future career route.

What you'll need

  • Degree educated in physics, engineering, materials science, computing, mathematics, or related discipline, from 2025 to 2027

title: Directed Energy Sr. Manufacturing Systems Business Analyst
description:
**Worker Type**

Regular

**Job Description**

### Summary

The Directed Energy Sr Manufacturing Systems Business Analyst serves as the bridge between manufacturing operations, engineering, supply chain, quality, finance, and information technology. This role gathers, analyzes, documents, and prioritizes business and technical requirements for manufacturing systems, including Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).

The analyst supports system implementations, process improvements, integrations, data governance, testing, training, and ongoing operational support. The position ensures that manufacturing applications effectively support product development, production planning, material control, shop-floor execution, quality processes, traceability, and business reporting.

### Position Responsibilities

#### Requirements and Process Analysis

- Partner with business stakeholders to understand current and future-state manufacturing processes.
- Elicit, document, validate, and prioritize functional and non-functional requirements.
- Translate business needs into clear user stories, use cases, process flows, specifications, and acceptance criteria.
- Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for automation.
- Facilitate workshops with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, finance, and IT teams.
- Ensure requirements are aligned across PLM, ERP, MRP, MES, and related systems.

#### Manufacturing Systems Support

- Analyze and support business processes involving:

o   Product data and bills of material

o   Engineering change management

o   Production planning and scheduling

o   Material requirements planning

o   Work orders and routings

o   Inventory and warehouse transactions

o   Shop-floor execution

o   Quality inspections and nonconformance management

o   Serial number and lot traceability

o   Labor reporting and production performance

- Support system configuration decisions and ensure solutions meet operational requirements.
- Coordinate with system administrators, developers, vendors, and implementation partners.
- Assist with troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, issue resolution, and production support.

#### Implementations and Integrations

- Participate in system upgrades, implementations, migrations, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
- Define data, workflow, reporting, and integration requirements.
- Support integration analysis between PLM, ERP, MRP, MES, and other enterprise applications.
- Review proposed solutions for process alignment, usability, scalability, security, and data integrity.
- Maintain requirements traceability from business need through design, testing, and deployment.
- ### Testing and Deployment

- Develop test scenarios, test scripts, and acceptance criteria.
- Coordinate system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
- Document defects and work with technical teams to verify corrective actions.
- Support cutover planning, deployment, release management, and post-launch stabilization.
- Develop user procedures, job aids, training materials, and release communications.

#### Governance and Continuous Improvement

- Maintain process documentation, requirements repositories, data definitions, and system documentation.
- Support master-data governance and data-quality initiatives.
- Monitor system performance and user adoption.
- Identify opportunities to improve standardization, automation, reporting, and operational efficiency.
- Ensure changes comply with applicable company policies, quality requirements, security standards, and regulatory obligations.

### Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Competencies)

- Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
- 3–7 years of experience in business analysis, manufacturing systems, ERP, MES, PLM, MRP, or related manufacturing technology.
- Experience gathering and documenting requirements for complex business processes.
- Understanding of manufacturing, production planning, supply chain, engineering, or quality processes.
- Experience supporting system implementations, enhancements, integrations, or upgrades.
- Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
- Experience with process-mapping and requirements tools.
- Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

### Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies

- Experience with one or more enterprise systems such as:

o   Oracle Fusion

o   ERP

o   Arena

o   Unanet

- Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, electronics, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
- Familiarity with bills of material, routings, work instructions, configuration management, and engineering change processes.
- Knowledge of SQL, data analysis, reporting tools, APIs, or system-integration concepts.
- Experience with Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project methodologies.
- Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous-improvement practices.
- Experience with product traceability, auditability, export controls, or quality-management systems.

### Core Competencies

- Business and systems analysis
- Manufacturing process knowledge
- Requirements elicitation and documentation
- Cross-functional collaboration
- Process mapping and optimization
- Data and integration analysis
- Testing and quality assurance
- Change management
- Stakeholder communication
- Structured problem-solving
- Prioritization and decision-making
- Technical writing and documentation

### Success Measures

- Requirements are complete, accurate, prioritized, and traceable.
- Manufacturing-system changes are delivered on schedule and meet user needs.
- PLM, ERP, MRP, and MES processes are aligned and integrated.
- System defects, manual workarounds, and process disruptions are reduced.
- Data quality, traceability, and reporting accuracy improve.
- User adoption and satisfaction increase.
- Manufacturing efficiency, planning accuracy, and operational visibility improve.

### Physical Demands & Work Environment

- This role typically operates in a cross-functional environment and may require regular interaction with engineering offices, manufacturing facilities, warehouse operations, quality organizations, IT teams, and external system vendors.

- Periodic travel or on-site support may be required during implementations, testing, training, and production deployments.

- Required to sit and stand for long periods; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard.

**Clearance Level**

No Clearance

The salary range for this role is:

$91,000 - $138,750

title: Fire Safety Auditor (Freelance)
description:
THE JOB

Conduct on-site fire safety audits at factories and industrial facilities across Vietnam, assessing compliance with applicable fire safety standards, client requirements, and QIMA procedures. The role involves on-site inspections, risk identification, functional testing, and audit reporting, with occasional travel to support projects in Southeast Asia.

Fire Safety Audits

  • Conduct on-site fire safety audits, including document review, facility walkthroughs, system inspections, and closing meetings.
  • Inspect fire protection systems, including fire alarms, sprinklers, hydrants, extinguishers, emergency lighting, and evacuation routes.
  • Perform functional checks and verify fire safety documents, maintenance records, and actual site conditions.
  • Identify non-conformities, assess risk levels, and provide practical corrective recommendations.
  • Prepare clear, evidence-based audit reports with photos and relevant standard references.

CAP & Follow-up

  • Review corrective action evidence and conduct follow-up verification for critical or high-risk findings.

Standards & Team Support

  • Keep up to date with relevant fire safety standards and regulations.
  • Support fellow auditors on fire safety matters and participate in internal calibration and quality activities.

THE CANDIDATE
It could be you, if you have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Fire Safety, Fire Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in fire safety, protection systems, or auditing within industrial/factory environments.
  • Hands-on knowledge of fire alarm, sprinkler, hydrant, extinguisher, emergency lighting, and evacuation systems.

We are looking for experienced Enrolled Nurses to join us on a permanent part-time basis. Our Medical Wards at Peninsula Private care for medical, medical - oncology, medical -cardiac, and surgical overflow patients

As a Enrolled Nurse, you will deliver safe, high-quality care while working closely with a skilled multidisciplinary team to help patients achieve their recovery goals.

About You:

You demonstrate exceptional customer service, confident communication and have strong interpersonal skills. You will require:

  • Current registration with AHPRA (Enrolled Nurses IV Qualified)
  • Have a minimum of 2 years current acute hospital ward experience
  • Flexibility to work a 7-day rotating roster

On offer for this position is a base hourly rate of $36.60 - $38.91+ superannuation, exclusive of penalties and allowances (VIC EN Year 4 – Year 8).

What’s in it for You:

At Ramsay, we care for our people by offering benefits that truly support your career, wellbeing and lifestyle, including:

  • Grow your career with recognition programs, employee referral bonuses, scholarships, free access to LinkedIn Learning and the Ramsay Leadership Academy
  • Save more every day with Ramsay Rewards, giving you exclusive deals at 100+ retailers, restaurants, travel providers and more
  • Enjoy peace of mind with lower hospital cover costs and higher extras limits on services like General and Major Dental, plus pharmacy and allied health discounts
  • Find balance through flexible rostering options, flexible leave and access to free, confidential counselling and wellbeing support 24/7
  • Increase your take-home pay through limited salary packaging and novated leasing, plus discounts on leisure travel, gyms and lifestyle services.

Why Join Ramsay:

At Ramsay Health Care, “people caring for people” is at the heart of everything we do. We are:

  • Australia’s largest private hospital operator, with over 74 sites and 35,000 staff
  • A values-led workplace where you’ll be supported personally and professionally
  • A place with flexible, permanent and career-growth opportunities nationwide.

Additional Information

  • Must provide or complete a National Police Check conducted within the previous 12 months.
  • According to the role, Ramsay may require a Working-With-Children Check and proof of immunisation against infectious diseases.

Apply today and join us at Peninsula Private Hospital

All applications must be lodged online.

title: Program Manager
description:
Role Summary:

The Program Manager reports to the Project Director for a given region and provides leadership through planning, implementing, coordinating, and evaluating Agilec sites/projects to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and employee experience are achieved while meeting or exceeding contractual obligations.

Work Location: This position is based at our Bath (Loyalist Township) location and supports operations at both our Bath and Barry’s Bay offices. Occasional travel to the Barry’s Bay office is required.

Responsibilities:

  • Coordinates one or more Agilec sites/projects
  • Execute Site budget, business plan, quality management plan, service initiatives and meet performance-based outcome targets
  • Communicate business strategy and facilitate team development
  • Prioritizes assignments and adjusts or adapts service delivery as needed
  • Build a positive, supportive team culture
  • Responsible for ensuring staff are accountable to QA, Privacy, and other Agilec priorities
  • Timely management and reporting of internal and external responsibilities to appropriate departments/funders
  • Identifies and approves training and development for frontline staff to ensure that staff meet performance expectations
  • Delegate and direct frontline staff to ensure uniform delivery of service across all teams within; establishes expectations and supports the Frontline roles
  • Monitor staff performance and provide feedback and corrective action as necessary to ensure staff meets objectives.
  • Build, develop, and grow any business relationships vital to the success of the project; planning and growth for site (new programs, increased contracts)
  • Understanding local labour market, community demographics to support their planning and growth

What You Bring

Education:

  • Completed post-secondary diploma or degree from a recognized Canadian institute in Human Services Field or other related field
  • Relevant certifications, such as MCVP, CVP, RRP, or CDP an asset

Experience:

  • Minimum three years' experience required in employment services or related field
  • Three years of financial management experience working with project funders/customers
  • Three years demonstrated effective Leadership experience in outcome-based projects
  • Experience organizing, planning and developing program operations at a supervisory level
  • Demonstrated experience building partnerships with employers, community agencies, and other stakeholders
  • Demonstrated competence achieving financial and operational goals
  • Experience working with people with disabilities and barriers to employment

Required Skills:

  • Successful problem-solving, proactive planning, decision-making, and time-management skills
  • Ability to support and direct staff to effectively support people with disabilities and barriers to employment
  • Excellent written communication skills demonstrated through proposal writing, electronic communication, and/or writing and summarizing monthly reports
  • Excellent verbal communication demonstrated through everyday dealings with team, clients, and customers
  • Proficient contract, budget, and operational management skills
  • Skilled at leading, supervising, and holding accountable direct reports to meet contracted performance expectations
  • Coaching methodologies to lead teams and implement change
  • Intermediate user of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)
  • French language is an asset and a requirement in programs designated as offering a bilingual service

Knowledge:

  • Understanding of stages of team development
  • Knowledge of the local and provincial labour markets
  • Knowledge of community and government resources
  • General knowledge of Employment, Health and Safety, and Human Resources Legislation and practices
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable federal, provincial, and municipal laws, regulations, and policies related to social assistance and workforce programs
  • Solid understanding of confidentiality and other professional codes of conduct; must submit for a criminal record check with Vulnerable Sector
  • Strong understanding of computer networks, applications, hardware, and office equipment

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to travel as required; access to a reliable vehicle is required.
  • Must provide a clear Enhanced Police Check (Criminal Record and Judicial Matters Check).
  • Legal authorization to work in Canada.

Compensation & Benefits

  • We offer our team members attractive compensation, employee and group benefits, training and career development opportunities, and value-added perks
  • *Eligibility to receive some benefits may vary according to employment status

Important Application Information

  • The purpose of this job posting is to fill a vacancy.
  • Applicant information submitted through Smart Recruiters may be processed using AI-assisted features that support candidate screening and selection activities.

We offer our team members attractive compensation, employee and group benefits, training and career development opportunities, and value-added perks*. *Eligibility to receive some benefits may vary according to employment status. Agilec welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. We are committed to providing an accessible, barrier-free recruitment and selection process. When contacted about an employment opportunity, please advise us if you require any accommodation at any stage of the selection process.

title: Lumber & Building Materials Specialist
description:
Benefits:
  • 401(k) matching
  • Company parties
  • Competitive salary
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee discounts
  • Health insurance
  • Opportunity for advancement
  • Paid time off
  • Profit sharing
  • Savings bank
  • Training & development
  • Vision insurance
Position Summary

KBS is seeking a dependable, hardworking, and experienced Lumber & Building Materials Specialist to join our Rochester, MN team in our brand-new, modern lumberyard facility.

This position requires a minimum of two (2) years of direct experience working in a lumberyard and/or building materials environment. This is not an entry-level position. Candidates must have hands-on experience handling lumber and building materials along with operating hand and power tools, maintaining an organized yard, preparing materials for customers and job sites and understanding the day-to-day operations of a professional lumberyard.

Employees in this position are expected to work independently, take initiative, demonstrate a strong work ethic and integrity, and provide professional service to customers and coworkers.

Required Experience & Qualifications

The following requirements are mandatory:

  • Minimum of two (2) years of direct lumberyard and/or building materials experience.
  • Experience must include hands-on work with lumber and building materials.
  • Must have experience loading, unloading, moving, organizing, and staging lumber and building materials.
  • Must understand basic lumberyard operations and material-handling procedures.
  • Must have experience using hand and power tools commonly used in a lumberyard or construction environment.
  • Previous forklift experience is strongly preferred; company forklift training and certification will be provided as required.
  • Must be able to safely read and understand warning signs, labels, instructions, and safety requirements.
  • Must be dependable, punctual, and capable of working both independently and as part of a team.
  • Must be physically capable of regularly lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds.
  • Must demonstrate a strong commitment to safety, quality, and customer service.
Candidates without at least two years of direct lumberyard and building-material experience will not meet the minimum qualifications for this position.

Essential Responsibilities

Lumberyard & Material Handling

  • Load, unload, move, stage, and organize lumber and building materials.
  • Prepare lumber and building materials for customer orders and deliveries.
  • Pull and stage materials accurately according to customer and job requirements.
  • Maintain an organized, clean, and safe lumberyard.
  • Assist with loading customer and company trucks.
  • Properly secure and handle materials to prevent damage or injury.
  • Assist with deliveries and material handling at customer job sites when required.
  • Operate forklifts and other material-handling equipment after completing required company training and certification.
  • Maintain proper organization and inventory of yard materials.
  • Pick up, organize, and properly store tools, equipment, and materials.
Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and applicable job-site safety requirements.
  • Attend regularly scheduled safety meetings and required training.
  • Use required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Maintain a clean and hazard-free work environment.
Teamwork & Performance

  • Work effectively with yard personnel, drivers, managers, and customers.
  • Follow verbal and written instructions accurately.
  • Take initiative and identify tasks that need to be completed.
  • Demonstrate strong leadership qualities and a willingness to take on additional responsibility.
  • Conduct all work with honesty, integrity, professionalism, and respect.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.
Physical Requirements

This is a physically demanding, hands-on position. Employees must be able to:

  • Lift and carry 50 pounds regularly.
  • Stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Bend, stoop, kneel, climb, reach, push, and pull.
  • Repeatedly use hands, arms, and legs to handle materials and operate tools.
  • Safely work around lumber, building materials, forklifts, trucks, and other equipment.
  • Work outdoors and in varied weather conditions.


Work Attire

Employees are expected to maintain proper work attire and wear all required PPE.

Shorts are not permitted while working.

Appropriate work clothing and footwear must be worn at all times in accordance with company safety requirements.

Work Schedule

Monday–Friday
7:00 AM–3:30 PM

Important Note

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, qualifications, or working conditions.

Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and responsibilities based on business and operational needs.

title: Senior Program Manager, RF Mission Systems
description:
**Worker Type**

Regular

**Job Description**

**Summary**

AV is seeking an RF Mission Systems (RFMS) **Senior Program Manager** with strong leadership abilities, excellent engineering skills, and extensive experience in product innovation and technical execution. This position requires experience in developing strong customer relationships and fulfilling deliverables therefore positioning the RFMS team for future growth. The candidate should have a strong technical and project management background and knowledge in the design and development of complex phased array systems is a plus.

The **Senior Program Manager** is intended to support AV's BADGER product (RFMS portfolio). The ideal candidate will be a competent, self-starting individual, who has strong interpersonal, communication and time management skills. Success in this position requires a strategic thinker with strong organizational skills and attention to detail. The Senior Program Manager will be responsible for overseeing the planning, coordination, and execution of production processes to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Operations/Manufacturing, and Quality Assurance to drive efficiency and optimize production schedules.

**Position Responsibilities**

**Project Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

- Develop project plans, schedules, and budgets
- Manage and lead production programs from inception to completion
- Monitor project progress, milestones, and deliverables, identifying potential risks and implementing mitigation strategies
- Establish and maintain effective communication channels with customers, subcontractors and internal stakeholders such as PM Team, IPT Leads, Group Leads, Contracts, Subcontracts, Finance, Purchasing, and People & Culture
- Coordinate regular meetings and progress updates with the PM Team, IPT Leads, Group Leads, and other staff to ensure alignment and address any concerns or open action items
- Coordinate with Engineering teams to ensure smooth transition of products from design to manufacturing
- Monitor production metrics and KPIs, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions as needed
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance production efficiency and reduce costs
- Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards throughout the production process
- Manage stakeholder expectations and address their needs throughout the project lifecycle
- Identify opportunities for process improvement, efficiency enhancements, and lessons learned
- Participate in post-project reviews and implement corrective actions as required to enhance project performance and outcomes
- Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in RF systems and project management

**Budget and Resource Management**

- Monitor project budgets, expenditures, and financial forecasts for RF Mission Systems' BADGER product and IRAD Budgets
- Coordinate resource allocation and optimization in collaboration with the PM Team, IPT Leads, Group Leads, and other staff members
- Collaborate with finance and procurement teams to ensure timely procurement of project materials and services related to RF systems

**Contract Management**

- Perform contract administration specific to RF Mission Systems, including reviewing contract terms, monitoring deliverables, and managing contract modifications
- Collaborate with the legal and procurement teams to address contractual issues, ensure program compliance and avoid scope creep
- Other duties as assigned

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience)**

- Bachelor's degree in relevant STEM discipline or Program Management discipline
- Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience managing technical programs with a budget of $20M or greater
- Experience with developing and presenting schedule, financial and/or technical briefings
- Knowledge of production planning and scheduling techniques
- Experience with/understanding of DoD contracting and acquisition process
- Must be proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
- Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Defense Top-Secret SCI Clearance

**Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies**

- MS or advanced degree in an engineering/program management field or equivalent industry experience
- Minimum 10+ years of relevant experience managing technical programs with a budget $100M or greater
- Experience with business intelligence reporting (e.g. PowerBI) and Microsoft Project preferred
- Exemplary evidence of effective communication; both verbally and in writing
- Ability to effectively handle variety of situations and problems that may arise - sometimes several at once - and solve them, work with those involved to come to cooperative solutions, while understanding time and budget constraints
- Proven ability to perform under the stress of frequent interruptions and/or distractions
- Skill in working independently and at the direction of a manager; following through on assignments in a timely manner
- Ability to prioritize, organize, and complete assignments efficiently and accurately, while adapting to shifting or competing work assignments and changes in workload volume
- Experience with Unanet ERP or similar
- Experience with satellite ground systems is preferred
- Ability to read and interpret technical specifications and requirements
- Experience in assigning and delegating tasks to engineering teams, setting both long and short-term project goals as well as working alongside other engineers and technicians, approving designs and budgets, calculating costs, material, labor, and time required for each project, negotiating contracts with vendors and clients, executing plans safely and efficiently, ensuring that projects stay within time and budgetary restraints, and compiling reports and presenting information
- Experience aiding with proposal development, contract negotiation, contract compliance and business development
- Experience in Aerospace or with U.S. Department of Defense
- Active U.S. Department of Defense Secret, Top Secret or TS/SCI Clearance preferred
- Effectively manages multiple efforts simultaneously and give direction to the program team
- Works independently with minimal supervision and completes assigned tasks within program schedule and budget
- Able to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, where small teams share a broad variety of duties
- Displays strong initiative and drive to accomplish goals and meet company objectives
- Takes ownership and responsibility for current and past work products
- Is committed to learning from mistakes and driven to improve and enhance performance of oneself, others and the company
- Demonstrates effective organizational, problem-solving, analytical and interpersonal skills. Exhibits teamwork, collaboration and puts the success of the team above one’s own interests

**Travel**

- Occasional overnight travel

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

- This job operates in a professional office and manufacturing environment with specialized laboratory areas
- This role routinely uses standard office equipment and special test equipment to meet program objectives
- Ability to sit, stand, stoop, reach, lift (up to 10 lbs.), bend, etc.
- Hand and wrist dexterity to utilize the computer
- May require travel to sites/program and special functions
- May have some exposure to outside environment while traveling.
- Required to talk, hear, and sit/stand for long periods

**Clearance Level**

No Clearance

The salary range for this role is:

$101,000 - $154,000

title: Ophthalmic Assistant-Ophthalmology Full time Days
description:
**This is a Full Time position at 40 hours per week located at the Glenview Outpatient clinic. Schedule is Monday through Friday with occasional Saturday’s. Required to obtain Certified Ophthalmic Assistant certification or Certified Ophthalmic Technician certification through JCAHPO within one year of hire date.**

The Ophthalmic Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Ophthalmic Assistant provides technical and clinical support and patient care for various physicians and sub-specialists by performing various tests to aid in the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment and follow up of patients with various ophthalmic health conditions. This role supports physicians as their needs arise and acts as a liaison between patients and physicians by answering questions and providing educational assistance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Interviews patients and documents histories.
  • Performs technical workups, patient histories and special testing (Refractions w/ retinoscopy, Lensometry, Keratometry, Tonometry, Visual Fields, Amslers, Muscle Testing, Pupil Exams, Topography, OCT, IOL Master / Ascans, Fundus Photos).
  • Assists the physician with patient care, minor surgery, scribes.
  • Communicates with patients (follow-up care, surgeries, procedures, changes in schedule, symptoms, surgery scheduling, etc.), returns phone calls (patients, pharmacies).
  • Maintains and cleans equipment, reports equipment deficiencies to management.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

Required:

  • High School diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Basic Life Support (American Heart Association) certification.
  • Certified Ophthalmic Assistant certification through JCAHPO (applicants who have obtained a Doctor of Medicine degree are exempt from the COA requirement).
  • Zero (0) to two (2) years’ experience in a relevant role.

Preferred:

  • Two years related experience (equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered).
  • Surgical assistance experience.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

title: Commercial Officer
description:
About us

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

About the job

As Commercial Officer, you’ll support procurement and contract activity from initial market engagement through to contract completion. You’ll work across professional services, construction, facilities management and the supply of goods and services. You’ll help deliver compliant, efficient procurements that provide value for money.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Support procurement and contract-management activity across the full commercial lifecycle.
  • Run below-threshold tender exercises, including supplier pre-qualification, tender evaluation and reporting.
  • Manage call-off agreements and mini-competitions under government frameworks.
  • Support large or complex procurement projects and help teams meet key milestones.
  • Work with internal teams, suppliers and stakeholders to support effective commercial outcomes.
  • Provide guidance and training on commercial processes and requirements.
  • Ensure procurement activity complies with relevant legislation, government standards and assurance processes.
  • Analyse commercial data, validate information and produce clear, accurate reports.
  • Help improve procurement systems, processes, policies and working practices.
  • Support the development of commercial apprentices by sharing guidance and good practice.

What You’ll Bring

  • A practical understanding of public sector procurement regulations, including the Procurement Act 2023.
  • A track record of supporting tender exercises from initial planning through to contract award.
  • GCSEs in Maths and English at Grade 4/C or above, or equivalent qualifications.
  • Previous responsibility for supporting internal and external stakeholders to achieve procurement objectives.
  • Strong numerical skills and the ability to analyse data and produce meaningful reports.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word, together with familiarity with ERP systems.

UKAEA is an onsite organisation, and this role requires regular onsite presence (usually between 3-5 days in any given week) in line with business needs. We actively support flexible working arrangements where this is compatible with the role.

Benefits

We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include:

  • A salary of £32903
  • Up to 7% corporate performance bonus
  • Final salary defined benefits pension scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution
  • 25 days annual leave plus 2.5 'privilege' days; 8 Bank Holidays
  • Additional 3 days of site closure over Christmas break
  • Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions

Our commitment to ED&I

UKAEA's mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, inclusion and accessibility, and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce.

Please email talent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require adjustments to help you participate fairly in our recruitment process, for example changes to the way we interview or share information. As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience for all candidates.

We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and people from diverse ethnic backgrounds. All appointments are made on merit and further information can be found here.

title: Senior Data Integration Engineer/ DWH, MS SQL, T-SQL
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Integration Engineer to join a team that develops and supports an enterprise data warehouse for a global insurance business. In this role, you will design and maintain the data warehouse and data marts, build ETL pipelines, and deliver data extracts and analytical reports that business users and downstream systems rely on every day.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and support the enterprise data warehouse and subject-oriented data marts
  • Build, schedule, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that load data from operational source systems
  • Develop data extracts for internal consumers and external systems according to business and technical specifications
  • Create and enhance analytical reports and the datasets behind them
  • Analyze and tune query and pipeline performance: indexing, execution plans, partitioning, load optimization
  • Gather and clarify requirements with business users and analysts; translate them into data models and technical solutions
  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues, perform data reconciliation between sources and the warehouse
  • Provide production support: monitor loads, troubleshoot incidents, perform root cause analysis
  • Maintain up-to-date technical documentation: data mappings, data flow descriptions, extract specifications
  • Participate in code reviews and follow version control and release procedures
  • Mentor colleagues and contribute to architectural decisions

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on data warehouse/ETL development experience
  • Proficiency in MS SQL Server, including database engine, database objects, and administration basics relevant for a developer

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – AI to design, lead, and deliver innovative artificial intelligence solutions for our clients. This role blends deep technical expertise with strong consulting skills, enabling you to translate business challenges into scalable, AI-driven architectures. You will work closely with client stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership to drive successful outcomes across a variety of industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Develop reusable assets, accelerators, and AI solution offerings

  • Contribute to thought leadership, whitepapers, and go-to-market strategies

  • Define architecture standards, design patterns, and governance frameworks

  • Stay current on emerging AI trends and technologies

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field

  • 10 + years of experience in technology consulting, software architecture, or solution architecture

  • Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments

  • Experience with API design, microservices architecture, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Experience working with Frontier AI models, local and open source models

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their AI/ML services

  • Proficiency in multiple programming languages

  • Experience designing data architectures and working with large-scale data platforms

Preferred Qualifications

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value

  • Adaptability in fast-paced, client-facing environments

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivering scalable, high-impact AI solutions that drive measurable business outcomes

  • Building strong client relationships and becoming a trusted advisor

  • Contributing to the growth of AI capabilities and offerings within the firm

  • Enabling teams through best practices, innovation, and technical leadership

title: Transporter Casual Mid shift
description:
This is a Casual position meaning that the hours per week are not guaranteed.

Must be able to start at 12noon or 1pm.

The Transporter reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

  • Is responsible for safe and efficient patient transport to and from inpatient areas and outpatient areas. Responsible for cleaning and distribution of equipment used by patient care areas.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Completes patient transports within set standards of the department.
  • Performs both patient transport and works in the Equipment Processing Distribution Department in picking up soiled equipment, cleaning equipment per standards and delivering equipment to user areas within department standard.
  • Ensures that all equipment is functional and in good working order including current Clinical Engineering (CE) tags.
  • Delivers any non-functional equipment to the CE department. Ensures that any equipment that requires battery charging is charged during storage.
  • Advises Patient Care Services when transporting patients from the unit and for all discharges. Performs accurate and timely documentation of patient movements when leaving and returning patients to units. Notifies nurse who is responsible for the patient prior to any transports.
  • Obtains Ticket to Ride and transports with patient.
  • Ensures all assigned equipment is kept clean and well maintained.
  • Transports patients or guests safely while using appropriate equipment, lift techniques and departmental safety measures to ensure patient safety.
  • Cleans and sanitizes all equipment used in a transport of a patient. Adheres to all PPE policies and knows the proper handling of chemicals used for cleaning and sanitizing. Follows established infection control and isolation guidelines.
  • If providing transport upon admission, gives overview of the patient room to the patient and / or family. This includes but is not limited to explanation of contents of the room, where to store their personal items, how to use bed controls, how to turn the coach into a bed, number for room service etc.
  • Assists patient care areas with lifts requiring 2 people or more. Has knowledge of how to utilize hospital lift devices, including maxi slides.
  • Monitors and delivers transport equipment such as wheelchairs to entrances and nursing units to ensure PAR levels are maintained.
  • Responds to code procedures as determined by hospital location.
  • Assists in Cadence Health Fall Prevention initiative when bringing a patient back to his/her room and completing the following: positioning patient correcting in bed or chair, bed rails up if needed, ensuring everything is in arm's reach (ie over the bed table, call light, trash can, etc), no cords on floor, and bed alarm hooked back up.
  • Effectively communicates with the call center dispatch with all transport delays or cancellations. Reports immediately to the call center upon completion of the transport.
  • May assist with removing trash and linen from patient rooms upon discharge.

Required:

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • CPR – Basic Life Support within 90 days of hire

title: Head Of Corporate OSH
description:
The role synopsis

As the Head of Corporate OSH, you will provide strategic leadership, governance and assurance for the Company's corporate Health and Safety (OSH) framework across offices, facilities, projects, maintenance/support activities, contractors and other company-controlled operations for Etihad Aviation Group. The role ensures regulatory compliance, effective risk management, strong safety culture, setting departmental & individual objectives, developing & motivating staff performance and continuous improvement.

What you'll do

  • Strategy and system: Set the corporate HSE strategy, policies and annual improvement plan, and run a management system aligned with OSHAD-SF, UAE Civil Defence requirements, ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
  • Critical risk: Own the corporate risk register, test whether controls work, and lead management of change.
  • Assurance: Run a risk-based audit and inspection programme across business units, facilities and contractors.
  • Incidents: Oversee investigation and root-cause analysis, and make sure lessons change how work is done.
  • Contractors: Set HSE requirements for selection, mobilisation, monitoring and performance.
  • Emergency readiness: Maintain emergency preparedness and its links to crisis management and business continuity.
  • Reporting: Build the dashboards, leading and lagging indicators, and trend analysis that go to executives and the Board.
  • Culture and team: Lead and develop an HSE team, and strengthen leadership engagement and proactive hazard reporting.

What you'll bring

  • 15+ years in HSE, including at least 7 leading teams, in a high-hazard, highly regulated industry such as aviation, oil and gas, infrastructure or transport.
  • Experience leading a multi-site, multicultural HSE organisation and managing a departmental budget.
  • A track record in corporate HSE governance: management systems, risk management, assurance and incident investigation.
  • Strong knowledge of OSH legislation, ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
  • A bachelor's degree in engineering, HSE, environmental science, occupational health or a related discipline.
  • A recognised professional HSE qualification; NEBOSH Diploma, CSP or CMIOSH preferred.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.

title: Histotechnician-Full-time Days
description:
This is a full-time, 40 hours per week, 1st shift position located at Delnor Hospital in Geneva.

Must be able to work Monday through Friday 4am - 12:30pm. No holidays and No weekends!

The Histotechnician reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Histotechnician performs routine histology procedures, in accordance with all department specific SOPs and guidelines, resulting in the stained slides for microscopic review and diagnosis by the Pathologist. This position is responsible for communication with pathologists, residents, and coordinators/supervisors regarding specimen problems. The position is also required to participate in the laboratory occurrence management program.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs cassette-log reconciliation. Initiates appropriate programs on conventional and microwave tissue processors. Recognizes, resolves, and documents standard processor alarms.

  • Embeds biopsy, routine surgical, and autopsy tissues, if applicable, per SOP. Recognizes adequacy of processing.

  • Identifies and orients tissues correctly. Documents tracking and quality issues on embedding log.

  • Performs and documents routine paraffin block reconciliation. Prioritizes blocks based on established guidelines.

  • Operates microtome per SOP, and determines appropriate block orientation and alignment, knife angles, and settings to obtain representative sections.

  • Recognizes acceptable vs. unacceptable sections; evaluates instances in which specific tissue might require a deviation from standard procedures to ensure diagnostic sections are produced.

  • Appropriate documentation including specimen identification throughout all technical and clerical processes including in the laboratory information system, as well as cassettes, slides and logs, as required by regulatory compliance.

  • Operates automated instrumentation to stain and coverslip microscopic slides.

  • Performs manual methods during instrument downtimes.

  • Recognizes, resolves, and documents unacceptable staining, coverslipping results and/or instrument failure.

  • Performs special staining techniques using automated instrumentation and manual methods.

  • Identifies appropriate positive and/or negative controls. Evaluates stains microscopically for acceptable results.

  • Executes sectioning and staining of frozen tissued. Identifies and corrects staining deficiencies.¿ Documents stains and quality issues.

  • Performs and/or assists with gross examination, dissection, and selection of representative tissue for microscopic examination for designated specimen, if applicable by site. Resolves discrepancies prior to gross examination and escalates to supervisor or Pathologist when necessary.

  • Utilizes dictation equipment to document description per procedure, if applicable.

  • Investigates, escalates, and documents any discrepancies or unresolved issues appropriately.

  • Prioritizes technical workload based on assignment or established priorities, responds effectively to changes in workflow adjusting work to incorporate STAT requests or fluctuations in work volume.

  • Exercises independent judgment in the performance of technical responsibilities.

  • Practices the proficient and safe use of all equipment necessary for the completion of all duties and responsibilities within defined turn-around times.

  • May perform required Quality System responsibilities including initiating “Quality Investigation Reports”, if needed

  • Reports equipment or instrument malfunctions appropriately.

  • Maintains a clean and safe work environment to ensure efficient workflow and compliance with all regulatory requirements. Cleans and disinfects laboratory areas per SOP. Performs minor spill cleanup per SOP when necessary.

  • Notifies coordinator promptly of any supply issues.

  • May participate in Safety and Infection Control activities. Follows all required safety procedures, assumes a proactive role in laboratory safety.

  • Takes initiative for personal development by attending teleconferences, educational sessions, and required meetings, etc.

  • May participate in the training or teaching of students and staff in the department.

Additional functions:

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • May be asked to assist in specific process improvement projects.

  • May be asked to assist with problem resolution regarding patient specimens including root cause analysis

Required:

  • Associates degree (if hired after 1/19/2025) with a combination of 12 semester hours (18 quarter hours) in biology and chemistry OR must have successfully completed 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) of academic credit from an accredited (regionally or nationally) college/university, with a combination of 12 semester hours (18 quarter hours) in biology or chemistry, qualifying the applicant to take the national ASCP certifying exam. Must provide proof of education as stated in CLIA guidelines.

  • Certification Requirement: Must obtain Histotechnician (HT) ASCP certification within 1 year of hire.

  • Must meet requirements for performing high complexity testing as defined by federal licensing guidelines (CLIA) and accreditation agencies (TJC,CAP)

Preferred:

  • Associated degree as Histotechnician.

title: Director of Entrepreneurship
description:

title: Staff Travel Officer
description:
Every successful journey starts with the right arrangements behind it.

As a Staff Travel Officer, you will play an important role in making sure employees receive accurate, timely and policy-compliant travel support. From preparing quotations and coordinating bookings to managing changes and resolving travel issues, your work will directly contribute to a smooth and reliable staff travel experience. You will work across multiple requests and stakeholders, balancing employee needs with policy requirements, business considerations and service standards.

Accountabilities:

  • Review and analyze staff travel requests, eligibility, and trip details to produce accurate quotations and travel options that align with policy, budget, and service requirements, while clarifying missing information and escalating exceptions where needed
  • Process bookings, amendments, and ticketing-related transactions for approved travel, ensuring itineraries, fare conditions, and traveler records are accurate, current, and traceable in the system, and checking that each request is completed within agreed service standards
  • Coordinate with airlines, hotels, and other travel partners to secure availability, confirm arrangements, and resolve booking issues or changes promptly, maintaining service continuity and protecting the organization's commercial and customer experience priorities
  • Monitor fares, travel rules, blackout periods, and supplier offers to recommend the most suitable option for each request, balancing cost, service quality, and policy compliance without compromising the traveler's needs
  • Respond to inquiries from staff and internal stakeholders on quotations, booking status, itinerary changes, and travel entitlements, explaining established facts, practices, and policies clearly and consistently to support effective decision-making
  • Maintain accurate travel data, trackers, and documentation, and prepare weekly or periodic reports on volumes, exceptions, and service trends to support operational visibility, issue resolution, and continuous improvement in the guest experience function

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in aviation, logistics, or hospitality required
  • 2-5 years of experience in load control, freighter operations, ground handling, or airport operations
  • Experience coordinating operational stakeholders in time-critical, safety-focused environments
  • Experience preparing operational documentation, load information, or flight support records
  • Language Requirements:

title: Analyst II, Government Pricing

You will join IntegriChain’s Net Revenue and Compliance team in Pune, which provides managed services and business process outsourcing to biopharmaceutical clients. You will work closely with GP managers, technical teams, and U.S.-based client stakeholders.

This role suits someone early in their finance or accounting career who enjoys working with data, takes pride in getting the numbers right, and wants to build expertise in a high-demand area of the pharma industry. Prior Government Pricing experience is helpful but not required; we will train you.

Working hours: This is a hybrid role based in Pune. Because you will work closely with U.S.-based clients and managers, the role requires some overlap with U.S. Eastern working hours

What you’ll do to thrive in this role:

  • Government Price calculations;
  • Prepare, validate, calculate, and analyse price reporting required under the following U.S. government programs: the Medicaid Drug Rebate Program, Medicare Part B, the VA Federal Supply Schedule (FSS), and the 340B Drug Pricing Program.
  • Prepare and validate the underlying data for price types including Average Manufacturer Price (AMP), Best Price (BP), Average Sales Price (ASP), Non-Federal Average Manufacturer Price (Non-FAMP), Federal Ceiling Price (FCP), Industrial Funding Fee (IFF), and Unit Rebate Amount (URA).

  • Review calculations with the client reviewer and obtain sign-off, following all required SOPs, before prices are submitted to government agencies (such as CMS, VA, and DoD) or shared with internal Medicaid rebate users.

Data management and analysis;

Review and maintain the master data used across all government pricing calculations.

  • Analyze calculation results, investigate variances, and identify their root cause.

Controls and documentation;

  • Document all revisions and adjustments made to client data in line with financial controls and standard operating procedures.
  • Maintain SOPs, SOX documentation, and evidence of work supporting each price calculation.

Where You’ll Grow:

  • As you build confidence in the core role, you will also gain exposure to adjacent areas of Net Revenue and Compliance.
  • Gross-to-Net (GTN): accrual close, forecasting, and related deliverables. transactional data, general ledger reconciliations, and data extraction from internal, external, and client systems
  • State Price Transparency Reporting (SPTR): reporting requirements and the U.S. state regulations behind them. portfolio set up activities and preparation of client reports.
  • Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Finance, Accounting, or Business.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Senior Data Platform Engineer

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Data Platform Engineer to help build, scale, and operate our bespoke enterprise data platform, the foundational infrastructure layer that ingestion, ontology, and business application teams build on top of. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who wants deep technical ownership of platform internals rather than owning specific business data pipelines: our platform stack spans Airflow, Iceberg, Spark, Flink, Kafka, Nessie, Trino, and StarRocks, along with supporting UI components for platform users.

You will not own the business logic of individual data pipelines; those are owned by application and business teams. Instead, you will build and harden the core platform capabilities that make those pipelines possible: ingestion frameworks, data cleansing/harmonization utilities, storage and compute infrastructure, and the APIs and agentic (MCP) interfaces that let both humans and AI agents access and operate on platform data and capabilities. You'll also be expected to bring an agentic software development approach to your own work, using AI coding agents and tooling to meaningfully multiply your engineering throughput, not just as an experiment on the side.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Capability Engineering

  • Design, build, and operate core platform capabilities on top of Airflow, Spark, and Flink for batch and streaming data processing, providing reusable frameworks that application/business teams use to build their own pipelines rather than building pipelines on their behalf.
  • Own the data lakehouse layer built on Iceberg, Nessie (catalog/versioning), Trino, and StarRocks, including table format management, catalog governance, query performance, and storage lifecycle (compaction, partitioning, retention).
  • Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming infrastructure (topics, schema management, connectors) that supports both platform-internal needs and consumption by downstream teams.
  • Develop reusable ingestion, cleansing, and harmonization frameworks/libraries that application teams can adopt to bring data onto the platform in a consistent, quality-controlled way, without the platform team owning each pipeline's business logic.
  • Build and maintain UI components that give platform users (engineers, analysts, business teams) visibility into platform state, data catalogs, job status, and data quality.

API & Agentic (MCP) Enablement

  • Design and build APIs that expose platform data and capabilities (ingestion, querying, catalog metadata, job orchestration) to downstream teams and services in a well-governed, secure, and performant way.
  • Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers/interfaces that expose platform data, catalogs, and lineage to AI agents and LLM-based tools, enabling agentic consumption of platform capabilities.
  • Extend agentic enablement beyond data access by building the tooling and guardrails that allow AI agents to safely operate parts of the platform itself (e.g., triggering pipeline runs, querying job status, remediation actions), with appropriate human-in-the-loop controls where needed.
  • Partner with platform consumers (including the Ontology Platform team) to understand their API/agentic access needs and translate them into platform capability requirements.

Scalability & Resilience

  • Ensure the platform scales reliably as data volume, source count, and consumer count grow, through capacity planning, performance tuning, and architectural evolution across the stack.
  • Design for resilience: fault tolerance, disaster recovery, data consistency guarantees, and graceful degradation across ingestion, storage, and compute layers.
  • Build and maintain observability (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) across the platform stack to detect and diagnose issues before they impact downstream teams.
  • Drive on-call/production support practices for the platform, including runbooks and incident response processes.

Engineering Practice & Productivity

  • Adopt and champion an agentic SDLC approach, using AI coding agents and related tooling as a core part of your own development workflow to substantially multiply engineering throughput (targeting materially higher output than traditional development approaches, not incremental gains).
  • Establish and evolve engineering best practices for the platform team: testing strategy, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and code/architecture review standards suited to a bespoke, multi-technology data platform.
  • Mentor other engineers on platform internals and on effective use of agentic development tooling, even without formal management responsibility.

Required Qualifications

  • 8-12 years of software/data engineering experience, with significant hands-on experience building or operating large-scale data platform infrastructure (not primarily building individual application-level data pipelines).
  • Deep, hands-on experience with at least several of: Apache Airflow, Apache Iceberg, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Nessie, Trino, StarRocks, with the ability to reason confidently about the rest and ramp up quickly where needed.
  • Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture: table formats, catalog management, query engines, and the trade-offs between batch and streaming processing.
  • Experience designing and building APIs for platform capabilities, with an understanding of API governance, versioning, and security for multi-tenant platform consumers.
  • Direct experience with, or strong interest and rapid aptitude for, building MCP servers or similar agent-facing interfaces that expose data/capabilities to AI agents and LLM-based tooling.
  • Practical, hands-on experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as a core part of your development workflow, with a track record of using them to meaningfully increase delivery speed and quality, not just occasional use.
  • Strong systems engineering fundamentals: distributed systems, performance tuning, capacity planning, and building for fault tolerance and resilience at scale.
  • Experience building and maintaining production observability (metrics, logging, tracing) for complex, multi-service data infrastructure.
  • Comfortable operating as an individual contributor with deep technical ownership, while also being able to mentor others and influence engineering practice without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or "paved road" tooling that other engineering teams adopt as self-service infrastructure.
  • Experience building agent-facing tooling or infrastructure beyond MCP (e.g., tool-use frameworks, agent orchestration, guardrails for autonomous agent actions).
  • Familiarity with UI/front-end development sufficient to build or contribute to platform-facing dashboards and tooling (not a primary requirement, but a plus).
  • Experience in financial services or another regulated, data-intensive industry, given the auditability and data-quality expectations typical of the domain.
  • Contributions to open-source projects in the Airflow/Iceberg/Spark/Flink/Trino ecosystem.

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.

title: Senior Energetics Formulation Chemist / Engineer
description:
Solid Rocket Motor Energetics, Scale-Up, Manufacturing Capability, Testing Methodology & Executive

Position Overview

iRocket is seeking a senior Energetics Formulation Chemist or Engineer to lead the formulation, development, scale-up, and manufacturing transition of energetic materials for solid rocket motor applications. The ideal candidate brings strong practical experience in propellant formulation and processing, understands the relationship between formulation, processing, performance, aging, and safety, and can translate customer requirements into repeatable production capability.

This role is intended for a technical leader who can develop both the energetic formulation and the manufacturing capability required to safety produce requirements materials both using traditional and non-traditional manufacturing at scale. Requires work in Long Island, Texas and Indiana, so employee must be willing to travel for extended times.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead formulation and development of solid rocket motor propellants and related energetic material systems, including ingredient selection, formulation optimization, mixing, casting, cure, and test.
  • Plan and execute formulation experiments, characterize material and ballistic performance, analyze test data, troubleshoot anomalies, and drive iterative improvements.
  • Develop and mature processes from laboratory or pilot scale through repeatable manufacturing, with emphasis on producibility, quality, safety, cost, and throughput.
  • Define requirements and support the design, layout, equipment selection, commissioning, and operational readiness of energetic-material manufacturing and processing facilities.
  • Develop manufacturing instructions, process controls, specifications, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation supporting safe and repeatable production.
  • Work closely with SRM design, manufacturing, test, quality, and program personnel to ensure energetic-material characteristics are integrated into motor design and performance.
  • Support hazard analyses, energetic-material handling practices, process safety reviews, environmental/operational controls, and applicable regulatory and explosives-safety requirements.
  • Mentor technical staff and serve as a subject-matter expert for energetics formulation, processing, scale-up, and manufacturing readiness.

Requirements

Minimum of Bachelor’s but preferred advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, or a closely related technical field.

Minimum 5 years of directly relevant professional experience in energetic materials, solid propellants, or solid rocket motor propulsion; 10+ years strongly preferred.

Demonstrated hands-on experience developing and processing solid rocket motor propellant formulations and transitioning formulations toward production.

Experience with energetic-material manufacturing equipment, facility/process development, production scale-up, and safe operations.

Ability to lead technical problem solving independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary engineering and manufacturing teams.

Highly Desired Experience

  • Propellant systems formulation, burn-rate tailoring, mechanical properties, rheology, cure chemistry, aging/life assessment, insensitive-munitions considerations, and/or performance characterization.
  • Design or startup of energetic-material laboratories, pilot lines, or production facilities, including equipment specification and process-flow development.
  • Experience supporting static-fire testing, failure/anomaly investigation, qualification, production readiness, and configuration-controlled technical data.
  • Experience in a rapid-development environment where technical rigor and disciplined safety are paired with aggressive hardware schedules.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Wellness Resources

title: Senior Software Engineer - Web Development
description:
