title: Medical Laboratory Scientist-Inpatient Lab Full-time Evening
description:
The Medical Laboratory Scientist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A Medical Laboratory Scientist performs test procedures in a clinical laboratory and conveys the results to the physician or designee in an accurate and timely manner for the purpose of patient diagnosis and treatment

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Technical responsibilities:
  • Performs all aspects of pre-analytic workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure orders are entered correctly, specimens collected are appropriate for the test ordered and are correctly processed/transported.
  • Verifies order where necessary
  • Verifies non-patient information (e.g., collection time) according to established protocol.
  • Handles unresolved orders, troubleshoots where needed.
  • Verifies with physicians and/or nurses prior to laboratory information system (LIS) order entry to resolve unclear, duplicate or otherwise ambiguous orders.
  • Verifies specimens for add-on tests are available and acceptable and generates add-on test orders.
  • Recognizes when fraud and abuse compliance issues require adjustments to the test order
  • Collecting, receiving and processing of specimens:
  • Verifies specimens are correctly and completely labeled upon receipt. Evaluates specimens for appropriateness and takes necessary corrective action. Appropriately documents unacceptable specimens and proper notifications as needed.
  • Prioritizes specimen processing based on established priorities.
  • Aliquots specimens according to established protocols.
  • Performs all aspects of analytical testing appropriate for the specific laboratory section,following established written protocols and standard operating procedures (SOP)
  • Maintains test system integrity:
  • Performs preventive maintenance on instruments/equipment in a timely fashion according to defined schedule.
  • Verifies reagents and supplies meet defined acceptability criteria upon receipt and prior to use; takes action to ensure unacceptable items are removed from use.
  • Ensures that sufficient reagents and supplies necessary for test performance are available. Notifies senior staff when minimum inventory level is encountered.
  • Performs and records all necessary quality control (QC) required for test system performance.
  • Evaluates QC results and takes necessary corrective actions according to established protocol.
  • Performs specimen preparation:
  • Performs any necessary pretest specimen preparation according to protocols (e.g., microbiology plating, cell cultures, filtering, extraction, separation, elution, absorption, etc.)
  • Transfers or ships specimens to approved testing locations according to SOPs
  • Performs tests:
  • Prioritizes testing based on assignment or established priorities, completes testing within defined turn-around-times (TAT).
  • Recognizes the need for and follows any age-specific protocols
  • Responds effectively to changes in the workflow by coordinating a simultaneous series of tests when needed or adjusting work to incorporate STAT tests or fluctuations in work volume.
  • Monitors daily workflow and priorities to assure meeting service levels.
  • Performs technical review and interpretation:
  • Reviews results for completeness, correctness, and consistency within defined test system
  • Evaluates test results/reactions and provides accurate interpretations as appropriate to include correlation with, and integration of, other patient data as necessary.
  • Performs visual interpretation/identifications as appropriate.
  • Recognizes unusual test results/interpretations and completes indicated reflex testing or other follow-up actions.
  • Follows established notification protocols for critical values, phone/fax/e-mail results requests, abnormalities.
  • Troubleshoots and solves problems:
  • Recognizes test system performance problems and takes necessary corrective actions
  • Recognizes when unresolved problems need to be escalated and takes necessary follow-up action.
  • Prints pending logs and follows-up to ensure pending tests are completed or cancelled when appropriate.
  • Post-test specimen storage:
  • Stores specimens and related materials (blood, slides, tissues, etc.) according to protocols for location and duration.
  • Retrieves specimen and related materials when needed
  • Post-analytical responsibilities:
  • Performs all aspects of the post-analytical workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure accurate results are reported within established time frames, specimens are retained appropriately, test results and/or current status are available upon inquiry, and billed charges are correct for testing performed.
  • Verifies and reports results:
  • Verifies results according to procedure.
  • Performs computer functions necessary for releasing results.
  • Generates written reports according to established protocol.
  • Reviews electronic or printed reports when applicable, recognizes problems and escalates according to protocol.
  • Amends reports:
  • Corrects erroneous reports and amends reports according to procedure
  • Responds to inquiries:
  • Responds to requests for information according to established protocol for confidentiality and release of information
  • Recognizes when unresolved inquiries need to be escalated and takes action
  • Stores documents and records:
  • Stores documents and records according to established protocol.
  • Charge capture/billing:
  • Performs billing and/or enter credits for tests and services when applicable.
  • Recognizes billing problems and escalates accordingly
  • Universal responsibilities:
  • Ensures quality of operations:
  • Follows written standard operating procedures (SOP).
  • Operates instruments/equipment according to protocol.
  • Uses computers according to established protocol; follows downtime procedures as required.
  • Performs required quality system responsibilities
  • Meets proficiency and competency standards of the department.
  • Participates in the training of new employees and students
  • Performs operational review of new SOPs.
  • Participates in new test development, validations and implementation.
  • Attends at least one personal development session per year
  • Performs other duties as assigned, or as needed, to ensure continued quality operations
  • Ensures safety of operations:
  • Follows all required safety procedures, uses personal protective equipment (PPE) appropriate for tasks performed.
  • Maintains cleans and organized work area
  • Provides service excellence:
  • Answers telephone when needed, using NM telephone etiquette
  • Maintains patient confidentiality including protected health information (PHI)
  • Assists patients, visitors and other contacts whenever need occurs

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Technology, Medical Laboratory Science, Clinical Laboratory Science, Chemistry, Biology, or Allied Health qualifying the applicant to take the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or equivalent certification examination.
  • License/Certification and Regulatory Agency
  • General MLS or MT (ASCP) Certification or eligible or
  • Categorical BB, C, H or M (ASCP) Certification or eligible
  • If hired after 1/19/2025 must be ASCP certified (or equivalent certification) within one year of employment

title: Re-Entry Transition Navigator (736207)
description:
Under the supervision of a direct supervisor and as part of a case management team, provides transition services for adult incarcerated offenders; provides record keeping, instructional assistance, and interaction and communication with clients, staff, parole agents, and other agencies.

Program Support:

  • Provides one-on-one and group instruction in adult re-entry program areas; assists clients with self-help, job readiness and social skills
  • assists clients in extra-curricular activities
  • supervises clients in class setting as directed by manager
  • assists clients in using computers; models appropriate behavior for clients
  • maintains site morale to motivate clients
  • reinforces appropriate behavior modifications for clients
  • adapts materials and equipment to meet specific needs and learning styles of the client
  • evaluates client progress on work assignments and shares with manager; develops and uses predetermined daily and weekly lesson/work plans and follow-through
  • operates standard office and classroom equipment
  • maintains awareness of physical and emotional changes in clients and reports concerns to staff and manager; plans and implements special events
  • attends in-services and staff meetings as required.

Service Coordination:

  • Maintains a caseload of program clients
  • acts as liaison for clients, families and other related agencies involved in the transition process
  • provides information and support
  • assists clients in completing various forms and obtaining documents for transition, training, education and employment; provides interventions when necessary
  • conducts a variety of risk/needs assessments with client
  • assists in developing client's Individual Development Plan
  • identifies clients appropriate for phase transition or program completion; may accompany clients to appointments, interviews, and other program-related activities
  • as part of a team, participates in collaborative meetings with staff and agencies to provide information and recommendations.

Record keeping:

  • Maintains accurate records and reports including attendance records, case notes and daily charts of client progress, pertinent client information, transcripts, client intake files/records, client accident and incident reports, and various related forms
  • completes incident reports for both positive and negative circumstances; corrects completed work assignments and records grades
  • assists office staff in ordering and maintaining classroom supplies, equipment, and materials; prepares class lists, schedules, and other documents.

Communications:

  • Communicates with clients, parole agents, Corrections Department, and other agencies as directed by the administrator or other staff
  • develops and maintains a professional rapport with program staff
  • demonstrates sensitivity to needs of clients, families, staff, and parole agents
  • maintains confidentiality of information regarding clients.

Other duties as assigned

  • High School Diploma or equivalent with two years of related experience preferred
  • Excellent computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, Power Point
  • Skills in communicating with diverse populations
  • Experience performing case management and transition plans preferred
  • Ability to work independently and have well developed interpersonal skills
  • Experience in criminal justice or related human service field preferred
  • Ability to travel as needed at least 25%
  • Must pass all required background checks and security clearances necessary for access to correctional, detention, or secure government facilities.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Graduate Systems Engineer
description:
About us

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

What you'll join

Your degree got you this far. Where could fusion energy take you?

If you're looking for your first graduate role and want a career that's meaningful, challenging, and packed with opportunities to grow, UKAEA's Graduate Development Programme could be the perfect next step. Working alongside world-leading experts, you'll help advance ground breaking fusion technology while building the technical, professional, and leadership skills needed for a successful career. This is your chance to be part of an industry that's helping create a sustainable future for generations to come.

What you'll do

  • Help develop innovative engineering solutions that support the future of fusion energy.
  • Work with engineers from different disciplines to solve complex challenges and deliver exciting projects.
  • Learn how to capture requirements, assess design options and support the development of complex systems.
  • Use engineering tools and analysis techniques to help improve system performance, reliability and safety.
  • Develop your technical, communication and project skills through hands-on experience, mentoring and structured development opportunities.

How you'll develop

On the graduate scheme here at the UK Atomic Energy Authority, you will have 20% of your time focused on professional and personal development. This will include a series of core development activities to fast track your business acumen, along with skills for technical, project management and people leadership.

The remaining 80% of time is role-based, working within a team growing your technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. Working with your line manager, you will get the opportunity to experience different roles and responsibilities within projects to broaden your understanding and help decide your future career route.

What you'll need

  • Degree in Science or Engineering from 2025 to 2027.
  • Driven, with a strong appetite to learn and take on new challenges.
  • Able to collaborate effectively and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Well organised and adaptable with the ability to plan and prioritise workload.

Benefits

We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include:

  • £35,227 base salary.
  • Final salary defined benefit scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution.
  • 25 days annual leave, plus 3 days Christmas closure and 2.5 privilege days, in addition to UK bank holidays.
  • Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions.
  • Take part in our Skern Lodge residential to develop new skills and build your network.

Our commitment to ED&I

UKAEA’s mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce. We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, while ensuring all appointments are made on merit.

UK Atomic Energy Authority is committed to being accessible. Please email earlycareerstalent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require any help or adjustments.

AI may be used for preparation purposes only. All responses submitted during interviews and assessments must be your own work.

To maintain a fair recruitment process, candidates are limited to two applications across our Early Careers programmes. If you apply for multiple roles, we may contact you to discuss which opportunities best match your skills and interests.

Applications are due to close at 23:59 on 8th November 2026. As we're expecting strong interest, we encourage you to apply early, as the vacancy may close sooner if we receive a high volume of applications. More information can be found here.

title: Community Health Worker I, Full Time Days
description:
The Community Health Worker I reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines, and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The NMHC Community Health Worker (CHW) is a frontline health professional who is a trusted member or has a very close understanding of the community served. This trusting relationship enables the CHW to serve as bridge between health system, social services, and the community. The CHW facilitates access to services and improves the quality and cultural competence of service delivery. A CHW also builds individual and community capacity by increasing health knowledge and self-sufficiency through outreach, community education, informal counseling, social support and advocacy. The CHW reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as liaison between health system, social services and the community.

  • Supports individuals, families, and communities to strengthen their access to resources related to NM’s social drivers of health screening.
  • Facilitates patient and family education which promotes social wellness and increases knowledge of the health care system.
  • Collaborates with the Population Health team, Primary Care, Community Affairs and FQHCs as appropriate to provide comprehensive patient support.
  • Complete social drivers of health screenings and provide appropriate resources.
  • Follows regulatory reporting requirements

  • Experience in patient tracking/contact tracing.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Technical Program Manager


About ACT

Advanced Cooling Technologies, Inc. (ACT) is a leading provider of thermal management solutions for aerospace, defense, data centers, energy, and industrial applications. For more than 20 years, ACT has engineered and manufactured innovative technologies that solve complex thermal challenges in demanding environments.

Our team is driven by innovation, teamwork, and customer care, delivering reliable solutions that support critical missions and next-generation technologies worldwide.


Position Summary

ACT is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead complex thermal product and system development programs from concept through qualification and transition to production.

In this role, you will be responsible for overall program execution, including schedule, budget, scope, technical performance, and customer requirements. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, manufacturing, functional leadership, suppliers, and customers to ensure successful program delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge of hardware development with proven program management and leadership skills, bringing teams together to solve challenges, manage risks, and deliver results.


What You'll Do

  • Lead the execution of complex thermal product and subsystem development programs, from initial concept and design through prototyping, qualification, and production handoff.
  • Develop and manage comprehensive program plans, including schedules, budgets, resource requirements, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Monitor program performance against schedule, cost, technical, and quality objectives, identifying risks and implementing corrective actions as needed.
  • Serve as the primary program point of contact for customers, internal engineering teams, functional managers, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, and multiple business units to ensure alignment on program objectives, priorities, and deliverables.
  • Partner with functional managers to identify resource needs, coordinate staffing priorities, and resolve resource constraints.
  • Plan and facilitate program milestones, technical reviews, and decision points, including System Requirements Reviews (SRR), Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), Critical Design Reviews (CDR), Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), and Qualification Test Reviews (QTR).
  • Oversee the coordination of prototype builds, testing, qualification activities, and hardware transition to production, ensuring compliance with customer and internal requirements.
  • Apply systems engineering principles to support requirements management, technical integration, configuration control, and risk-based decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to improve program management processes, communication, cross-functional collaboration, and overall execution effectiveness.

title: Software Developer Full Stack / Backend I (Co-op) - Canada
description:

Meet the Team

Join a vibrant community of passionate professionals from around the world, working together in Engineering, IT, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, Security & Trust, and more. Together, we’re shaping the future—one idea at a time.

Your Impact

As a Software Developer Co-op, you will design, develop, and test software features across web applications, cloud microservices, and distributed platforms. Collaborate with agile engineering teams to build responsive user interfaces, robust RESTful APIs, and scalable backend services that power next-generation software platforms and digital solutions. Work with modern developer workflows, including Git version control, Linux environments, containerization tools, and automated testing to ensure reliable software delivery. Success in this co-op work term means learning practical software engineering best practices, writing clean and maintainable code, and contributing to innovative solutions that connect and protect people and organizations worldwide.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program (Associate's or Bachelor's) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field,with the expectation to continue enrollment following completion of the co-op work term.

  • Foundational programming and problem-solving skills in at least one modern language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, or C/C++ through recent academic coursework, personal projects, orpreviouswork experience.

  • Experience writing, testing, and debugging software code, with a solid understanding of core data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design principles.

  • Familiarity with web and API fundamentals (HTTP/HTTPS, RESTful APIs, state management) and standard development workflows, including Linux environments and Git version control.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience or coursework building responsive user interfaces with component-based architectures (React, Vue, or Angular) and modern TypeScript.

  • Familiarity with backendmicroservicesdevelopment or API tooling in Go (Golang), Python (FastAPI/Flask), or Node.js.

  • Introductory exposure to containerization (Docker), cloud concepts (Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, or Azure), or CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).

  • Familiarity with database concepts across relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL), NoSQL, or analytical (OLAP/Redis) data stores.

Why Cisco?

title: Senior Software Engineer, Strategic Defense
location: Costa Mesa, California, United States; Huntsville, Alabama, United States; Irvine, California, United States; Reston, Virginia, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States; Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Defense team at Anduril protects the United States and its allies from ballistic, hypersonic, and air-breathing threats. Those threats now arrive in seconds, maneuver mid-flight, and come in volleys designed to overwhelm the legacy systems meant to stop them — so we're building a software-defined command and control layer that can see, decide, and act faster than any human operator could alone. Our team spans autonomy, tracking, simulation and wargaming, hardware, systems engineering, and test and evaluation to build an accredited fire control system fielded rapidly and at scale. We are at the forefront of incubating and maturing AI-native offerings for the integrated air and missile defense domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

This application is for established coders with 8+ years of experience who will breeze through live coding interviews and it does not require active clearance but you must be eligible.

As a Software Engineer in Strategic Defense, you will write code side-by-side with elite peers to solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more. You’ll make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way to ensure Anduril products achieve a variety of desired outcomes in ambiguous situations where more is on the line than money or corporate gains. By working hand-in-hand with powerhouse teams in AI, Edge Hardware, Space Solutions, Networking, and Test Engineering you will craft cutting-edge, end-to-end systems that redefine mission success for major strategic capabilities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own software solutions that are deployed to customers at the edge of innovation and necessity
  • Write code to improve robust C2 products and scale mission capabilities to broaden our impact
  • Collaborate across multiple engineering teams to plan, build, and test functionality of complex systems
  • Partner with end-users to turn needs into features quickly while balancing user experience and engineering constraints
  • Travel 10 - 30% with the team to build, test, and deploy capabilities in the real world where they’re needed most

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8-12+ years writing production software in languages like C++, Rust, Go, or Python that real users or systems depend on
  • You've owned a feature or service end-to-end including design, implementation, deployment, and dealing with it when it breaks
  • You've debugged problems in code you didn't write and systems you didn't design
  • You're comfortable making engineering decisions with incomplete requirements and revisiting them when reality disagrees
  • You can explain technical tradeoffs to people who aren't software engineers (operators, hardware engineers, customers)
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A desire to work on critical software that has a real-world impact
  • Exposure to robotics, distributed systems, networking, or real-time systems
  • Experience with mid and upper tier Air Defense Command and Control (C2) programs
  • Have worked where software touches physical hardware
  • Experience building software solutions involving significant amounts of data processing and analysis
  • Degree in a relevant field like Computer Science, Math, or Physics
  • Willing to travel up to 20% to Asia Pacific
US Salary Range
$191,000—$292,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

About the job

As Project Manager, you’ll lead the delivery of projects or programme workstreams supporting UKAEA’s fusion energy mission. You’ll manage projects across areas including science, engineering, technology, research and facility development, with typical annual budgets of £500,000 to £5 million. You’ll ensure agreed outcomes are delivered within time, cost and quality requirements.

We are recruiting four Project Managers on 24-month fixed-term appointments. The roles are available on either a full-time or part-time basis, and we welcome applications from candidates seeking flexible working arrangements. If applying part-time, please indicate your preferred working pattern in your cover letter.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Lead projects and multidisciplinary delivery teams through the full project lifecycle.
  • Develop project management plans, schedules, milestones and delivery controls.
  • Select and apply suitable delivery methodologies, including waterfall, agile, hybrid or iterative approaches.
  • Manage budgets, monitor financial performance and address forecast under or overspends.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies and changes.
  • Build effective relationships with senior stakeholders, technical teams, suppliers and external partners.
  • Coordinate project governance, assurance reviews and reporting to boards and senior leaders.
  • Manage supplier contracts, procurement activity and contractual performance.
  • Maintain business cases and benefits realisation plans throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Secure project resources and provide guidance, support and coaching to delivery teams.

What You’ll Bring

  • A strong track record of managing projects, preferably within a related technical, scientific or engineering environment.
  • A recognised project management qualification such as APM PMQ or PRINCE2.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of different project delivery methodologies and their governance requirements.
  • Proven capability in managing project budgets of up to £5 million annually.
  • Previous responsibility for contract management and working with suppliers or contractors.
  • Strong commercial awareness and experience of using project controls to support sound delivery decisions.

UKAEA is an onsite organisation, and this role requires regular onsite presence (usually 3 days per week) in line with business needs. We actively support flexible working arrangements where this is compatible with the role.

Benefits

We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include:

  • A salary of £57117 inclusive of a £5800 specialist allowance
  • Up to 7% corporate performance bonus
  • Final salary defined benefits pension scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution
  • 25 days annual leave plus 2.5 'privilege' days; 8 Bank Holidays
  • Additional 3 days of site closure over Christmas break
  • Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions

Our commitment to ED&I

UKAEA's mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, inclusion and accessibility, and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce.

Please email talent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require adjustments to help you participate fairly in our recruitment process, for example changes to the way we interview or share information. As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience for all candidates.

We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and people from diverse ethnic backgrounds. All appointments are made on merit and further information can be found here.

title: Registered Sleep Technologist-Full Time Nights Sign on Bonus Eligible
description:
**This is a full-time position at 36 hours per week located at our Grayslake Outpatient Clinic. The schedule is 3, 12 hours shifts, 6pm to 6:30am. The role will require working 1 weekend shift per week. A $10,000 sign on bonus for eligible applicants is being offered for this position. **

The Registered Sleep Technologist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

This position performs all aspects of overnight polysomnograms, including CPAP/Bi-PAP titrations. A Registered Sleep Technologist must have achieved competency in the following areas:
• Independently prepare patients for and perform diagnostic polysomnograms.
• Independently perform CPAP and Bi-PAP titrations according to national standards and departmental guidelines. Includes ability to articulate indications for administration of humidification.
• Demonstrate knowledge of indications (and procedure for obtaining orders) for administration of oxygen.
• Demonstrate the ability to score and process sleep records.

This position works closely with other members of the NTC/SDC staff, including physicians.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Completes all required paperwork before study is performed, including consent, relevant patient history, questionnaires, etc. Clarify unclear or inappropriate orders. Complete billing information upon completion of procedure.
• Independently prepare equipment for monitoring by performing necessary calibrations, selecting filter settings, determining appropriate monitoring montage, and entering required patient information.
• Provide CPAP training by utilizing appropriate patient education materials.
• Prepare patients for study by accurately placing recording devices required for procedure. Utilizes International 10-20 system for EEG electrode placement.
• Record study by entering appropriate notations and clinical observations into computer system and on technician worksheet.
• Identify abnormalities such as apneas, PLM’s, and other sleep disturbances. Seeks assistance to adjust recording technique to best enhance and provide a clearly interpretable record.
• Recognize and respond appropriately to medical problems and physiological events, especially cardiac dysrhythmias, respiratory events and seizures.
• Recognize technically inadequate signals and initiate troubleshooting techniques. Obtain additional assistance as needed. Appropriately document barriers to resolution.
• Maintain monitoring equipment in clean and organized condition.
• Participate in departmental in-services and continuing education.
• Encourage teamwork through interdepartmental communication and constructive problem resolution.
• Provide training for new Sleep Technicians and student preceptors.
• Score sleep records according to department guidelines.
• Maintain registry in good standing by completing the necessary CEU requirements (10 CEs or equivalent per year) as established by the American Academy of Sleep Medicine
• Provides testing information, reassures and relaxes patients, and prepares patients for their procedure.
• Provides assistance to all patients as needed.
• Requires interaction with patients of all ages (pediatric, adult and geriatric).

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• High school diploma or equivalent

Certification:

• Certification by Board of Registered Polysomnographic Technologists, RPSGT or Registered Respiratory Therapist.

• BLS CPR certified

Experience:

• At minimum of 12 months prior sleep tech experience.

Behavioral Attributes:

• Knowledge of the International 10-20 system of electrode placement.
• Familiarity with personal computers.

PREFERRED:

• Bachelor’s Degree or additional training in electroneurodiagnostics, anatomy, or successful completion of certification in allied health school.
• Prior sleep experience at a facility accredited by the AASM.
• At minimum of 18 months prior sleep tech experience.

title: Head of Strategic Airline Partnerships & Alliances
description:
Shape the Future of Global Airline Partnerships

Etihad is entering one of the most exciting phases in its growth story. As we continue to expand our global network and deepen our airline partnerships, we are seeking an exceptional Head of Alliances to lead one of the most strategically important areas of our business.

This is a rare opportunity to create a lasting legacy. You will define and execute Etihad's partnership strategy, identifying and securing transformative airline agreements that expand our reach, strengthen our network, and deliver sustainable commercial value. From negotiating industry-leading joint ventures and strategic alliances to shaping how millions of travellers connect across the world, your impact will be felt throughout the aviation industry for years to come.

The Opportunity

As Head of Alliances, you will lead the development, negotiation, implementation, and optimisation of Etihad's strategic airline partnerships. Working at the centre of our commercial organisation, you will collaborate with senior leaders across Revenue Management, Network Planning, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Loyalty to unlock new growth opportunities and maximise partnership performance.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring both strategic vision and commercial execution. You will not only secure new partnerships but also ensure they deliver long-term value through effective governance, performance management, and continuous optimisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Etihad's strategic airline partnership agenda in line with broader commercial objectives.
  • Identify, evaluate, and secure new partnership opportunities including joint ventures, codeshares, interline agreements, capacity arrangements, and other innovative partnership models.
  • Strengthen and expand existing partnerships into deeper, more strategic relationships.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations and secure internal approval for major partnership investments.
  • Build robust business cases and present recommendations to executive leadership and Board-level stakeholders.
  • Implement and govern strategic partnerships to ensure delivery of agreed commercial outcomes.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across Revenue Management, Network Planning, Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Cargo, Operations, Finance, and Legal teams.
  • Expand partnership opportunities beyond passenger revenue into loyalty, cargo, ancillaries, and operational collaboration.
  • Monitor, evaluate, and optimise partnership performance through commercial and profitability metrics.

About You

You are an accomplished aviation leader with a proven track record of developing and managing strategic airline partnerships. You combine deep alliance expertise with broader commercial experience and understand how successful partnerships create value across an airline's entire commercial operation.

You bring:

  • Significant leadership experience within the aviation industry (A minimum of 12 years industry experience)
  • Deep expertise in airline alliances, partnerships, joint ventures, codeshares, or network cooperation agreements.
  • Additional experience in one or more commercial disciplines such as Revenue Management, Network Planning, Sales, Commercial Strategy, or Pricing.
  • A strong record of leading complex negotiations and delivering commercially successful outcomes.
  • Experience building compelling business cases and influencing senior executive stakeholders.
  • Outstanding stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • A global network of airline industry contacts and relationships.
  • The ability to operate strategically while remaining hands-on in execution.

Why Etihad?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of one of the world's most ambitious airlines. You'll join a business with bold growth plans, work alongside industry-leading commercial teams, and have the platform to influence partnership strategy on a truly global scale.

If you're looking for a role where you can build something meaningful, leave a lasting mark on the industry, and help define the next chapter of Etihad's growth story, we'd love to hear from you.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.

To learn more visit

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Senior Front End Software Engineer, React
location: Arlington, Virginia, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States; Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Defense team at Anduril protects the United States and its allies from ballistic, hypersonic, and air-breathing threats. Those threats now arrive in seconds, maneuver mid-flight, and come in volleys designed to overwhelm the legacy systems meant to stop them — so we're building a software-defined command and control layer that can see, decide, and act faster than any human operator could alone. Our team spans autonomy, tracking, simulation and wargaming, hardware, systems engineering, and test and evaluation to build an accredited fire control system fielded rapidly and at scale. We are at the forefront of incubating and maturing AI-native offerings for the integrated air and missile defense domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Software Engineer in Strategic Defense, you will write code side-by-side with elite peers to solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more. We absolutely need React experience for this role. You will be owning all front end decisions for a team of 30+ engineers. You’ll make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way to ensure Anduril products achieve a variety of desired outcomes in ambiguous situations where more is on the line than money or corporate gains. By working hand-in-hand with powerhouse teams in AI, Edge Hardware, Space Solutions, Networking, and Test Engineering you will craft cutting-edge, end-to-end systems that redefine mission success for major strategic capabilities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop tools and capabilities that extend Anduril's Lattice OS to solve unique customer problems in the command and control of complex assets, the planning and execution of missile defense missions, networking, and remote asset management in far-edge environments.
  • Collaborate closely with customers, product designers, and other engineering teams to shape and build new software products and applications, optimizing for maximum value to the end user.
  • Build, test, deploy, and demonstrate mission-critical code in a tight feedback loop with end users.
  • Travel up to 25% of the time to participate in customer events and deploy capabilities in real-world scenarios.
  • Contribute to the development of existing software services across Anduril, aiming to develop reusable components that contribute to success across multiple Anduril product lines.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong engineering background from industry or school, ideally in areas/fields such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics
  • Proficiency with web-based technologies, specifically React and Typescript
  • Ability to empathize with end-users, to turn needs into features, and to balance user experience with engineering constraints
  • Experience with real-time user interfaces that use reactive programming libraries - ReactJS or similar
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases
  • A desire to work on critical software that has a real-world impact
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Development of military operator-facing user interfaces
  • Experience working with military customers
  • Distributed communication networks and message standards
  • Knowledge of military systems and operational tactics

$191,000—$292,000 USD

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers.   • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. title: Relief/On Call Residential Advocate
description:
WHO WE ARE

Volunteers of America Colorado is a nonprofit, faith-based organization dedicated to helping those in need transform their lives. Through more than 50 distinct human service programs, Volunteers of America changes the lives of more than 140,000 vulnerable Coloradoans each year. VOA services include housing and emergency shelters, hunger and nutrition services, and many other community support programs. Our work touches the mind, body, heart, and ultimately the spirit of those we serve. VOA integrates compassion with highly effective programs that build and strengthen communities.


WHAT MAKES VOA SPECIAL?

VOAC recognizes the unique needs of the older adult who needs a wheelchair ramp to stay at home safely, and the preschooler whose family needs additional resources. VOAC supports veteran’s efforts to exit homelessness as well as provides a safe place for survivors of domestic violence. Wherever VOAC goes, it combines relationship-building, volunteers and quality services to lift and support our neighbor’s efforts to become self-sufficient and reach their full potential.


Job Summary


The Relief Residential Advocate provides for the protection of the physical and emotional well-being of the Shelter residents. Responsible for providing residents with crisis intervention services and supervising volunteers on a regular basis.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Provides for the protection of both the emotional and physical well-being of residents within program guidelines.

· Participants in general client and house maintenance such as supplying linen and personal items, implementing the client chore schedule, performing bed checks, enforcing curfew and other rules, checking chore completion, setting and checking alarms, and checking building for complete clearance during fire drills.

· Provides individual counseling on a weekly basis with clients, assists the client with the identification of goals and implementing a plan.

· Provides trauma-informed care.

· Responsible for primary intake interviews with new clients, completing necessary documentation and determining if client is appropriate for admission.

· Answers crisis line and the emergency hotline. Responsible for awareness of agencies as possible referral resources for crisis callers and residents. Maintains records associated with this duty.

· Attends staff meetings weekly, in-service training as required and meets periodically with the Program Manager for input and exchange of information.

· Observes clients’ daily behavior and documents observations in case notes. Also responsible for daily shift notes and notes on any group sessions conducted.

· Ensures maintenance of the facility as a comfortable and orderly environment and provides direct crisis intervention services with clients.

· Responsible for conducting house and group sessions meetings as assigned.

· Responsible for providing supervision and training of new employees and volunteers as assigned.

· Able to give educational presentations to community groups, attend professional meetings when requested and conduct on-site tours.

· Maintains shift log and other paperwork as required.

· Performs job responsibilities in accordance with the Social Work Code of Ethics.

· Ensures guest voice is incorporated into programmatic evaluation and improvement.

· Participate in on-call rotation in conjunction with other Advocates, Senior Managers and Senior Director.

· Performs all other duties as assigned.

title: Scrum Master - IT
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

Job overview and responsibilities
The role of a Scrum master is a pivotal role in guiding Agile teams to deliver high-quality, business-critical products. Your responsibilities will include facilitating Agile ceremonies, identifying and removing impediments, and coaching both the team and stakeholders on Agile principles and practices. You will be instrumental in cultivating a culture of continuous improvement, empowering teams, and fostering seamless cross-functional collaboration.

Impediment and Dependency Management

  • Proactively identify and track impediments, dependencies and delivery risks, ensuring each has a clear owner and next step.
  • Coordinate with partner teams to resolve issues and follow through to closure.
  • Escalate promptly when issues exceed the team’s ability to resolve them, communicating the impact, actions taken and support needed.

Team Coaching and Accountability

  • Coach teams, Product Owners and stakeholders on Agile practices, collaboration and shared accountability.
  • Help teams establish and uphold working agreements, including readiness for planning, timely responses and follow-through on commitments.
  • Facilitate constructive conversations about missed commitments, recurring process gaps and conflicting expectations.
  • Help teams become increasingly self-sufficient through clear working agreements, shared ownership and effective knowledge transfer.
  • Drive follow-through on retrospective actions and assess whether they improve team outcomes.

Delivery Transparency

  • Help teams track progress against sprint goals and release plans, making risks and changes visible early.
  • Partner with Product Owners, engineering leads and quality engineering to clarify dependencies, sequencing and readiness for delivery.
  • Use metrics such as cycle time, work in progress and sprint goal achievement to identify bottlenecks and improve predictability.
  • Support delivery coordination while maintaining clear ownership of product priorities, technical decisions and testing responsibilities.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Provide concise, accurate updates on progress, risks, dependencies and changes to delivery expectations.
  • Facilitate discussions that produce clear decisions, action owners and next steps.
  • Confirm shared understanding across technical teams, business stakeholders and leadership.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering or related field preferred
  • 4+ years of experience in Product Management or Business Analysis, with a proven track record of partnering with technical teams to deliver complex technology solutions.
  • Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, and other Agile frameworks
  • Experience working with Agile project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and conflict resolution skills
  • Ability to lead by example, demonstrating strong servant leadership and a focus on team empowerment
  • Experience working in a collaborative, cross-functional Agile environment, with a strong focus on delivering value
  • Ability to manage and resolve conflict effectively, keeping the team focused on achieving sprint goals
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple teams or projects concurrently
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Master's degree
  • Agile certifications such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or SAFe Agilist (SA) highly desirable
  • Experience as a scrum master, agile coach, or in a similar role within an Agile environment
  • Experience in an environment involving DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud-based application delivery
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks
  • Exposure to Agile transformations and change management
  • Background in software development or technical project delivery is a plus

location: St Leonards, New South Wales, au
description:
Ramsay Health Care is seeking an experienced nurse leader as a Director of Clinical Services to provide clinical leadership and support operational excellence across North Shore Private Hospital; a leading acute care facility located in St Leonards on Sydney’s Lower North Shore. This senior nursing leadership role will be responsible for driving safe, high-quality, patient-centred care, the professional practice and development of the nursing and midwifery workforce, and strengthening clinical governance, and service improvement across the hospital. Working closely with the CEO, Executive Team, clinical leaders, VMOs and corporate stakeholders, you will lead initiatives that enhance patient outcomes, improve operational performance and support the hospital’s continued growth and success. This is an exciting opportunity to influence healthcare delivery within one of Ramsay’s leading Sydney hospitals and lead teams committed to The Ramsay Way – People Caring for People.

What You’ll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve, but are not limited to:

  • Provide visible clinical leadership across North Shore Private Hospital, ensuring the delivery of safe, high-quality patient care.
  • Partner with the Executive Team to drive clinical strategy, operational performance and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead and develop high-performing clinical teams, fostering engagement, accountability and a strong culture of care.
  • Strengthen clinical governance, quality systems and accreditation readiness.
  • Build trusted relationships with VMOs, specialists and multidisciplinary teams to support exceptional clinical outcomes.
  • Support the professional practice and development of the nursing and midwifery workforce, capability development and service optimisation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve patient experience, clinical outcomes, efficiency and sustainable growth.
  • Work collaboratively across the broader North Shore health precinct to strengthen integrated care and service delivery.

What You’ll Bring

You are an experienced nurse leader with a strong clinical background and the ability to influence across a complex hospital environment.

You will bring:

  • Senior nursing leadership experience within an acute hospital or healthcare setting.
  • Previous experience as a Director of Clinical Services, Associate Director of Clinical Services or equivalent senior leadership role.
  • Strong understanding of private hospital operations, clinical governance and quality frameworks.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and drive continuous improvement.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with experience partnering with clinicians, VMOs and executive leaders.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of operational performance drivers.
  • The ability to provide confident clinical leadership while building strong relationships across a complex stakeholder environment.

Essential Qualifications:

  • Current registration as a Registered Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (AHPRA).
  • Postgraduate clinical or health management qualifications.

About The Hospital

North Shore Private Hospital, located on Sydney's lower North Shore, is a 350-bed facility specialising in surgical, medical, and maternity care. Recent expansion ensures every patient enjoys a private room for a quieter, more comfortable experience. Renowned for specialties like orthopaedics, obstetrics, neurosurgery, and cardiac services, the hospital is a leader in medical innovation. The continuous loop of obstetric care prioritises emotional wellbeing assessments, personalised care, and comprehensive maternity services, including preparation for birth and specialised parenting programs.

About Us

Founded in Australia in 1964, Ramsay Health Care is the nation’s largest private hospital operator and a recognised global leader in healthcare delivery. Across Australia, Ramsay operates 76 hospitals and 12 surgical centres, caring for more than 1.1 million patients each year with the support of over 30,000 dedicated professionals. Guided by our ethos, “People Caring for People,” we are committed to delivering exceptional patient care, building meaningful relationships, and driving continuous improvement and sustainable growth. In addition to our hospital network, Ramsay operates a growing community pharmacy network of more than 35 locations. Through our culture, The Ramsay Way, we place our people at the centre of everything we do—fostering collaboration, empowering teams, and achieving outstanding outcomes for patients and communities.

Benefits

  • A competitive remuneration package, complemented by a comprehensive range of employee benefits.
  • Strong opportunities for professional development and career progression.
  • Access to Ramsay Rewards, providing exclusive discounts with leading retailers and service providers.
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the delivery of high-quality healthcare and contribute to the ongoing transformation of the industry.
  • The opportunity to work within a complex and highly connected healthcare environment in Sydney’s Lower North Shore.

To Apply

All applications should include your CV outlining your experience and skills in line with the above criteria. Applications close Tuesday 27th October 2026.

Please Note:

Ramsay Health Care is committed to Child Safety. Details of our commitment are set out in our Code of Conduct, available at .

Applications made by recruitment agencies will not be considered.

description:
The Sterile Processing Tech reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

title: Lid raad van toezicht
description:
Stichting Meerscholen zoekt een lid voor de raad van toezicht (breed profiel)

Wil jij je ervaring en expertise inzetten in een rol als toezichthouder in het voortgezet onderwijs en hiermee bijdragen aan inspirerend onderwijs voor leerlingen van praktijkonderwijs tot gymnasium? Heb je expertise op het gebied van toezicht houden in het onderwijs en herken je je in het profiel? Dan zoeken wij jou ter versterking van ons team als Raad van Toezicht voor Stichting Meerscholen.

Kennis op het gebied van digitalisering is een pré.

De organisatie

Meerscholen bestaat uit tien scholen voor voortgezet onderwijs in de regio Amersfoort, Nijkerk en Bunschoten-Spakenburg. Meerscholen biedt leerlingen kwalitatief goed onderwijs, of een leerling nu praktijkonderwijs, havo-, gymnasium-, vmbo-, vwo- of mavo-onderwijs wil volgen; alles is mogelijk.

Bij Meerscholen geeft iedere school het onderwijs vorm vanuit de eigen onderwijsvisie en levensbeschouwelijke identiteit. Onze scholen staan in de traditie van het bijzonder onderwijs en hebben een katholieke of protestants-christelijke identiteit. Bij Meerscholen staat voorop dat iedere leerling welkom is en dat niemand wordt buitengesloten.

De verscheidenheid van onze scholen zien we als onze kracht: leerlingen en ouders kunnen bij ons een school kiezen die bij hen past. Wel werken we binnen Meerscholen allemaal vanuit dezelfde bedoeling. In ons onderwijs draait het om goed leren, goed leven en goed samenleven.

Meerscholen is een waarden gedreven organisatie. Onze kernwaarden, vertrouwen, vakmanschap, verbinding en lef vertellen hoe we bij Meerscholen willen zijn en willen handelen.

Meer over Meerscholen is te lezen in ons strategisch beleidsplan dat op onze website staat.

De raad van toezicht

De raad van toezicht heeft vier verschillende rollen: de toezichtrol, de klankbordrol, de werkgeversrol en de netwerkrol. De meerwaarde van de raad van toezicht is erin gelegen om vanuit een gevarieerde achtergrond en kennis verschillende perspectieven in de dialoog aan de orde te laten komen. Een goede basis voor doorontwikkeling van de raad is gelegd.

Binnenkort eindigt de zittingstermijn van een van de leden, waardoor er een vacature ontstaat. Het streven is de raad zo samen te stellen dat de leden ten opzichte van elkaar, het college van bestuur en welk deelbelang dan ook, onafhankelijk en kritisch kunnen opereren en vanuit deze diversiteit samen een team vormen in de verschillende te vervullen rollen.

Inmiddels heeft Meerscholen een stevige doorontwikkeling gemaakt na de fusie begin 2023. De uitdaging is daar op voort te bouwen en ‘samen meer’ om te zetten in ‘meer samen’. Dat brengt uiteraard uitdagingen met zich mee voor de scholen, voor de bovenschoolse organisatie en voor het college van bestuur. Per 1 augustus is een nieuwe bestuurder aangesteld binnen het college van bestuur wegens pensionering. Met het CvB in de nieuwe samenstelling staat er ook een stevige basis voor het bestuur voor de volgende periode. De raad van toezicht kan een belangrijke rol vervullen als sparringpartner en toezichthouder. Een mooie opgave om de komende jaren samen stappen in te zetten.

Profiel

  • We zoeken een lid dat zich kan verenigen met de toezichtvisie van Meerscholen en deze weet te vertalen naar de praktijk. Een lid voor wie de identiteit van Meerscholen betekenis heeft en deze kan onderschrijven. We zijn op zoek naar een lid dat in staat is een goede balans te vinden tussen distantie en betrokkenheid. We zoeken iemand die:

  • strategisch denkvermogen heeft en zo mogelijk bestuurlijke ervaring;

  • affiniteit met onderwijs heeft en interesse in de verschillende betrokkenen daarbij zoals ouders, leerlingen en personeel;

  • in staat is te verbinden met interne en externe stakeholders;

  • relevante (maatschappelijke) ontwikkelingen adequaat kan vertalen naar de organisatie en in staat is de maatschappelijke opgave te onderkennen;

  • met het bestuur kan reflecteren op belangrijke strategische en operationele beslissingen en daarover adviseren en waar nodig ondersteunen;

  • in staat is de werkgeversrol goed te vervullen;

  • mede zorg draagt voor een open, transparante en veilige werkcultuur, onafhankelijk is in meningsvorming en op constructieve wijze bijdraagt aan de oordeelsvorming in de raad als team;

  • kan reflecteren op het eigen functioneren en op die van de raad, eigen handelen periodiek evalueert en maatschappelijk kan verantwoorden binnen de normen van de Code Goed Toezicht;

  • integer en betrouwbaar handelt, enige vorm van (schijnbare) belangenverstrengeling vermijdt en zich bewust is van morele dimensies van het functioneren als toezichthouder;

  • bij voorkeur bekend is met de regio Amersfoort en omstreken;

  • voldoende tijd beschikbaar heeft voor de invulling van deze positie (indicatie: ongeveer tien vergaderingen per jaar);

Specifieke kwaliteiten Breed profiel

Wij staan open voor iemand met een breed profiel waarbij het een pré is als de toezichthouder expertise heeft op het gebied van digitalisering, met oog voor de kansen die dat biedt en de risico’s die dat met zich meebrengt. Dit is een belangrijke ontwikkeling, die veel van de organisatie vraagt de komende periode.

Wat biedt Stichting Meerscholen?

We bieden een uitdagende toezichtpositie bij een ambitieuze onderwijsorganisatie in een betrokken team van toezichthouders. Leden van de raad van toezicht ontvangen voor de werkzaamheden uiteraard een vergoeding.

Informatie

Wil je meer weten over onze organisatie, de inhoud van de functie, de opgave en de profielschets, lees dan het functieprofiel dat je op de vacaturesite van Meerscholen kunt downloaden.

Voor inhoudelijke vragen over de functie en over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met Nathalie Hazenberg (voorzitter raad van toezicht), zij is bereikbaar via het telefoonnummer 06-51326553 of per mail via .

Solliciteren

Om te solliciteren kan je op de vacaturesite van Meerscholen, op de solliciteerbutton klikken en de stappen volgen zoals aangegeven. Tijdens het proces wordt gevraagd om je emailadres, persoonsgegevens, cv en een motivatiebrief. We sluiten de vacature op 23 oktober 2026.

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je rond 2 november een reactie en nodigen we je wellicht uit voor een gesprek. Daarna volgt mogelijk nog een tweede gesprek. Zijn we na de gesprekken allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een voordracht en benoeming door de raad van toezicht.

We kijken uit naar je reactie!

title: Contracts Principal
description:
BryceTech is seeking a Contracts Principal to provide senior-level expertise in government contracting, contract negotiation, administration, and compliance in support of U.S. Space Force mission requirements. This position is responsible for preparing, negotiating, accepting, and managing contracts and subcontracts while ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, company policies, customer requirements, and contractual obligations. The Contracts Principal evaluates contract terms, cost estimates, performance requirements, and delivery schedules; advises management on contractual rights and obligations; and recommends policy and procedural improvements. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience managing complex government contracts, sound business judgment, and the ability to independently resolve contractual issues in a highly regulated environment.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare, negotiate, review, accept, and administer government contracts, subcontracts, and related contractual instruments
  • Ensure contract acquisition and fulfillment comply with applicable laws and regulations, company policies, Government requirements, customer specifications, and master agreements
  • Analyze estimates of material, equipment, and production costs, along with performance requirements and delivery schedules, to assess contractual accuracy, completeness, feasibility, and risk
  • Review contractual documents, terms, and conditions to verify compliance with company policies, Government specifications, solicitation requirements, and applicable agreements
  • Advise management and program leadership on contractual rights and obligations, risk exposure, interpretation of terms and conditions, and potential business impacts
  • Interpret contract requirements and provide guidance on contract administration, performance, deliverables, modifications, and compliance matters
  • Coordinate with program management, finance, procurement, legal counsel, technical teams, and other stakeholders to resolve contractual issues and support successful program execution
  • Identify contractual risks, ambiguities, and inconsistencies and recommend mitigation strategies or corrective actions
  • Support the preparation and evaluation of proposals, pricing documentation, contract modifications, negotiation positions, and other acquisition-related materials
  • Monitor contract performance, deliverables, schedules, changes, and compliance obligations throughout the contract lifecycle
  • Recommend changes to policies and establish procedures affecting the immediate organization to improve contracting effectiveness, consistency, and compliance
  • Interpret and administer policies, processes, and procedures that affect assigned sections and subordinate work units
  • Develop and communicate contracting guidance, process improvements, and recommendations to management and relevant stakeholders
  • Maintain accurate contract files, records, correspondence, and supporting documentation in accordance with applicable requirements
  • Independently manage complex contracting assignments, exercise sound judgment, and provide timely recommendations in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment
  • Active DoW Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility (TS/SCI)
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher, meeting one of the following education and experience combinations:
    • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) with 10 or more years of relevant experience
    • Master’s degree (MA/MS) with 8 or more years of relevant experience
    • Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) or Juris Doctor (JD) with 2 or more years of relevant experience
  • Extensive experience in government contracting, contract negotiation, contract administration, subcontract management, or a closely related discipline
  • Experience preparing, negotiating, accepting, and managing government contracts and subcontracts to support proper contract acquisition and fulfillment in accordance with company policies, legal requirements, and customer specifications
  • Experience analyzing estimates of material, equipment, and production costs, as well as performance requirements and delivery schedules, to ensure accuracy and completeness
  • Experience reviewing contractual documents for adherence to company policies, Government specifications and requirements, and applicable master agreements
  • Demonstrated ability to advise management on contractual rights and obligations and interpret contract terms and conditions
  • Experience identifying contractual risks, evaluating proposed changes, resolving complex contract issues, and recommending appropriate courses of action
  • Experience recommending policy changes and establishing procedures that affect an immediate organization
  • Experience interpreting and administering policies, processes, and procedures that affect multiple sections or subordinate work units
  • Working knowledge of applicable Government contracting regulations, acquisition requirements, contract compliance, and contract lifecycle management
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex contractual matters to management and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and collaborate effectively with program, finance, procurement, legal, and technical personnel

Position is contingent upon contract award.

BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
