title: Online Marketeer (32 - 40 uur)
description:
Wil jij meebouwen aan de online zichtbaarheid en conversie van een internationale marktleider? Als Online Marketeer bij Ambius combineer je data-analyse met slimme campagnes en creatieve content. Je helpt om kwalitatieve leads te genereren, bouwt mee aan ons merk en zorgt ervoor dat we ons marketingbudget zo effectief mogelijk inzetten.

Wat ga je doen?
In deze rol word je onderdeel van een compact marketingteam van 3 collega's en speel je een belangrijke rol in onze online groei. Je werkt aan de brede online funnel: van naamsbekendheid tot leadgeneratie en conversie. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met collega's van onder andere Sales en Service, om de klantbehoefte scherp te krijgen en de leadopvolging goed op elkaar af te stemmen.

Je dagelijkse werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het monitoren en optimaliseren van onze prestaties via Google Analytics, Meta Ads en LinkedIn Ads (inclusief SEO, SEA en GEO).

  • Campagnedata en testresultaten vertalen naar praktische verbeterpunten, die je deelt met je collega's.

  • Gerichte social ads en YouTube-campagnes opzetten, A/B-testen en bijsturen waar nodig.

  • Meedenken over en creëren van content die laat zien wie Ambius is en waarom klanten voor ons kiezen.

  • Het overzicht bewaren over lopende campagnes en budgetten in Monday.com, en je marketingcollega's ondersteunen waar nodig.

Binnen deze rol kijk je naar heldere statistieken, zoals de kwaliteit van leads, conversieratio, online zichtbaarheid en de prestaties van onze social- en e-mailcampagnes.

Wie ben jij?
Je bent een pragmatische marketeer die graag ziet dat campagnes ook echt resultaat opleveren. Je kijkt verder dan alleen de kliks, snapt wat onze klanten zoeken en gebruikt data om de online ervaring steeds een beetje beter te maken.

Wat we in ieder geval van je vragen:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, met een achtergrond in marketing, communicatie of digitale media.

  • Je hebt de fase van startende marketeer inmiddels achter je gelaten en hebt de nodige vlieguren gemaakt in een data-gedreven marketingrol.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig campagnes inrichten en optimaliseren binnen Google Ads (SEA) en social media (Meta/LinkedIn), en je haalt je inzichten moeiteloos uit Google Analytics.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Het is een mooie bonus als je zelf visuele content kunt opmaken in tools als Canva, Photoshop of InDesign, en als je al eens met Monday.com hebt gewerkt.

Wat bieden wij jou?
Bij Ambius investeren we in onze mensen en bieden we een professionele, maar informele werkomgeving met veel ruimte voor jouw ideeën. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een salaris van € 4.000,- tot € 4.400,- bruto per maand (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Vakantietoeslag, een bonusregeling, een prima pensioenregeling en (optioneel) een collectieve zorgverzekering.

  • Een laptop en smartphone van de zaak.

  • De mogelijkheid tot hybride werken en flexibele werktijden in overleg.

  • Toegang tot interne trainingen en volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden via de Ambius Academy.

  • Een internationale organisatie met korte lijnen, een open sfeer en regelmatige teamuitjes.

title: Duty Supervisor - MED
description:
Let your career take off with the World’s Leading Airline, Etihad Airways. Work in the forefront of the airline and travel industry, with the airline that has reimagined the flying experience through its pioneering products and services.

As a Duty Supervisor, you will plan, direct, and supervise the airport operation, overseeing team and service provider performance. You will ensure financial, customer service, quality, safety, and security objectives are delivered in accordance with all applicable safety, security, regulatory and company requirements and standards. And supervise all elements of operations while on duty.

Accountabilities

  • Oversee all passenger and aircraft handling operations on a shift basis, ensuring adherence to all arrival/departure checklists, brand requirements, company policy/procedures and regulatory requirements
  • Responsible for the effective management of safety and security outcomes on a shift basis through hazard identification, safety and compliance monitoring and reporting
  • Ensure all flight editing and special guest requirements are met, including but not limited to assessment, planning and coordination of VIP/MAAS, PRM and special category guests
  • Effectively liaise with Guest Control, Network Control and SOC to manage operational disruption recovery and reduce impact to guest service and operational integrity
  • Deliver, maintain, and rehearse station emergency response plan, disruption planning, diversion/delay handling and business continuity plans
  • Responsible for on time performance on a shift basis including coordination, mitigation, accurate reporting, and follow-up of delays
  • Airport ancillary sales promotion, coordination, process compliance monitoring and adherence to associated targets
  • Responsible for promotion, delivery, monitoring and reporting on customer service-related standards, including performance against associated KPIs
  • Ensuring adherence to local authority requirements, including but not limited to arrival/departure documentation and reporting
  • Make day-to-day operational decisions to manage and mitigate operational safety and security-related risks on a shift basis at station level, through effective evaluation and decision-making based on conditions, hazards, and threats
  • Identification and reporting of safety and security-related occurrences and hazards in accordance with company procedures and local regulation
  • Degree level education desirable (A-level or baccalaureate equivalent) or relevant industry experience, with a demonstrable knowledge of frontline service delivery and communication skills
  • Previous exposure to highly pressured and multicultural environment in a supervisory role within a shift environment required
  • Minimum 5-7 years' experience within service, hospitality, airline, or retail industry, with a relevant knowledge of aviation, travel industry and/or airport policies
  • Role requires mature personality with outstanding communication skills, supervisory skills, and passion to deliver service
  • Role must balance guest-centric focus and corporate interest while maintaining highest safety and security standards and coordinating teams and service providers on shift

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.

To learn more visit

Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Servicetekniker (Vikariat 6 månader) – Sweden Recycling, Spånga
description:
Nu söker vi en ny kollega till vårt serviceteam för ett vikariat på 6 månader med utgångspunkt från vårt kontor i Spånga (Stockholm).

I rollen som servicetekniker kommer du att arbeta med miljöservice och rörsaneringar i hela Sverige.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara:

  • Utföra inspektioner och funktionskontroller av tandläkarklinikers sugsystem.

  • Spolning av kontaminerade avloppsrör.

  • Katergorisering och sortering av farligt avfall som sedan transporteras som farligt avfall eller farligt gods.

Arbetet i fält är självständigt men du ingår i ett team med erfarna kollegor. Våra kunder finns i hela Sverige varför övernattningar på annan ort sker regelbundet och kan bli upp till tre dagar per arbetsvecka.

Hos oss arbetar du 40 timmar/vecka men lite längre dagar måndag till torsdag (kl. 07:00–18:00) vilket innebär att du är helt ledig på fredagar. Vi söker dig som gillar att ta det ansvar som en fri arbetsroll innebär.

Som person är du:

  • Serviceminded och brinner för att ge service till kund.

  • Pålitlig och noggrann samt har lätt för att samarbeta och passa tider.

  • Ordningsam.

  • Öppen för att ta egna initiativ när det krävs.

  • Praktiskt lagd.

  • Van vid och bekväm med digitala arbetsredskap (goda IT-kunskaper).

Arbetet kan innebära tunga lyft och långa resor i bil, så du bör vara i god fysisk form. En positiv attityd och hög arbetsmoral ser vi som en självklarhet.

Krav för tjänsten:

  • B-körkort samt god erfarenhet av att köra lätt lastbil / lätt van (upp till 3,5 ton).

  • ADR 1.3 (Allmän utbildning i farligt gods).

  • Goda IT-kunskaper.

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Meriterande:

  • C-körkort.

  • EU-yrkeskompetensbevis (YKB / Varubilschaufförsutbildning).

  • ADR 8.2 (Chafförsutbildning för farligt gods).

  • Truckkort.

  • Erfarenhet av tidigare arbete med transport av farligt avfall eller arbete med vatten och rör.

Vad vi erbjuder dig

  • Fyradagars arbetsvecka (ledig varje fredag).

  • Ett härligt gäng kollegor att samarbeta med.

  • Kollektivavtal (IF Metall).

  • Friskvård och hälsoinspiration.

  • Årlig kick-off.

  • Möjligheter att växa i en internationell organisation.

Ansökan

För frågor kontakta germund.horberg@rentokil-initial.com

Mobil: 070-3901152

För oss är det viktigt att all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden tillvaratas. Vi välkomnar alla sökande och eftersträvar mångfald.

SRAB kontrollerar alltid belastningsregister före anställning.

Vi har valt våra samarbetspartners i denna rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra försäljare av rekrytering/bemanning.

title: Materials Program Manager, Product Operations
description:
The Materials Program Manager (MPM) is responsible for the overall financial health of the Bill of Materials (BOM) and for ensuring a diverse and continuous supply for innovative, highly integrated consumer products.

This individual has a business-oriented mindset and partners with local and remote Operations, Engineering, and Software teams to drive the development, implementation, and management of product costing, budget, and the Supplier Plan of Record (SPOR).

As the business representative, the MPM captures, documents, and communicates financial exposures, supply risks, and expenditures related to their product. They are involved in all stages of the product family's lifecycle to ensure that we meet all financial targets and maintain qualified material availability through the end of the product's life.

Additionally, the MPM supports weekly Executive Product Line reviews, which assess performance against budget, target, and actual costs, as well as the SPOR status.

Key job responsibilities
- Collaborate with Product Management, Finance, Engineering and Supply Chain teams to set product cost target and guardrails.
- Drive initiatives with the Cross-functional Team to create a detailed cost reduction plan to meet or exceed product cost targets.
- Work alongside the Cross-functional Team to identify the cost implications of engineering and process changes.
- Conduct regular cost reviews with Executive Management and thoroughly analyze every aspect of your product costs.
- Plan and manage tooling budget and spend.
- Architect and establish a solid Supplier Plan of Record (SPOR) for the product(s) along with Engineering, Software, Supply Chain, and other Ops functional teams to ensure time-to-market, supply continuity, manufacturability, scalability, and sustainability.
- Coordinate with EMS partners to determine the product purchase order cost for xVT builds.
- Manage purchase price variance claims due to engineering changes, component obsolescence, or forecast discrepancies.
- Drive successful implementation of the SPOR during the development cycle through mass production prior to transferring to sustaining team.

A day in the life
The Materials Program Manager has a business orientation and is responsible for working with the local and remote operations and engineering teams driving development, implementation and management of the product budget. This person is the business voice responsible for capturing, documenting and communicating financial exposures and outlay as it relates to their product. They are involved throughout all stages of the product family's life-cycle to ensure we achieve all financial targets through end-of-life. They support weekly executive product line reviews outlining performance against budget, target and actual cost.

About the team
We are a NPI Product Operation team dedicated to building exceptional products that customers love, delivering seamless connected experiences, and driving profitable growth. From early pre-concept exploration through final product launch, we guide every stage of the innovation journey—identifying bold ideas, transforming them into pioneering products, and managing end-to-end delivery with precision and agility.

title: Supply Officer
description:
Pindara Private Hospital is seeking a reliable and organised Supply Officer to join our team on a permanent full-time basis. This is an important role supporting the day-to-day operation of the hospital by ensuring medical, clinical and general supplies are received, stored and distributed efficiently.

Working as part of our hospital support services team, you will be responsible for maintaining an efficient stores and supply function across the hospital.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Receiving, checking and appropriately storing deliveries
  • Picking and distributing stock and supplies to hospital departments
  • Maintaining accurate inventory records and stock levels
  • Monitoring stock usage and identifying replenishment requirements
  • Conducting regular stocktakes and inventory checks
  • Ensuring stock is stored safely and in accordance with hospital requirements
  • Processing purchase orders and liaising with suppliers as required
  • Maintaining a clean, organised and efficient stores area
  • Supporting the hospital team with ad-hoc stores and supply requirements
  • Following relevant workplace health and safety, infection control and hospital procedures

About You

We are looking for someone who is dependable, organised and takes pride in providing a high level of service.

You will also ideally have:

  • Previous experience in stores, warehousing, inventory or supply chain operations
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Good computer and administrative skills
  • The ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Good communication and customer service skills
  • A proactive approach and willingness to assist wherever required
  • The ability to safely undertake manual handling and physical aspects of the role
  • Previous experience in a healthcare or hospital environment will be highly regarded, but is not essential

What’s in it for You?
At Ramsay, we care for our people by offering benefits that truly support your career, wellbeing and lifestyle, including:

  • Grow your career with recognition programs, employee referral bonuses, scholarships, free access to LinkedIn Learning and the Ramsay Leadership Academy
  • Save more every day with Ramsay Rewards, giving you exclusive deals at 100+ retailers, restaurants, travel providers and more
  • Enjoy peace of mind with lower hospital cover costs and higher extras limits on services like General and Major Dental, plus pharmacy and allied health discounts
  • Find balance through flexible rostering options, flexible leave and access to free, confidential counselling and wellbeing support 24/7
  • Increase your take-home pay through salary packaging and novated leasing, plus discounts on leisure travel, gyms and lifestyle services.

Remuneration: An hourly rate of $30.59 - $32.94 + superannuation

title: Pathologists Assistant Float I-Full Time Days
description:
**This is a full time position at 40 hours per week. This role is a float role, with main support being at Catherine Gratz Griffin Lake Forest Hospital and McHenry Hospital but also possible support at Kishwaukee hospital and Delnor Hospital. The schedule is Monday to Friday, 8-hour shifts. **

The Pathologists’ Assistant Float I reflect the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

In collaboration with the pathologist, the Pathologists’ Assistant Float I is responsible for the gross pathology description and sampling of biopsy and/or other selected complex surgical tissue specimens. The dissection sampling and description is performed in accordance with established procedures to aid the pathologist in establishing the diagnosis. The Pathologists’ Assistant I assist with resident training and provides a variety of activities in support of basic laboratory operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Performs all duties as scheduled by pathologist.
  • Performs gross examination and dissection of surgical biopsies and large complicated specimens. Maintains specimen integrity and accurate legible specimen identification throughout all technical and clerical processes. Produces high-quality, high-volume work in a timely fashion, always finding better/more efficient ways to do things.
  • Provides assistance with intra-operative consultations. Cuts, stains, and coverslips cryostat sections for timely review. Documents appropriate turn-around-time tracking information.
  • Prepares specimens for imaging and photographs specimens. Maintains imaging equipment and files. Organizes radiology files and photography.
  • Prepares materials and participates in conferences with residents, pathologists, and clinical staff.
  • Exercises independent judgment in the performance of technical responsibilities. Prioritizes technical workload based on assignment or established priorities, responds effectively to changes in workflow adjusting work to incorporate STAT requests or fluctuations in work volume.
  • Practices the proficient and safe use of all equipment necessary for the completion of all duties and responsibilities within defined turn-around times. Cleans, disinfects, performs, and documents routine equipment and workspace maintenance per SOP. Reports equipment or instrument malfunctions appropriately.
  • Assists manager and/or pathologist in development and implementing new and special procedures or techniques. May assist in maintaining procedure manuals in accordance with practice guidelines and requirements of regulatory agencies.
  • Participates in quality and process improvement efforts. Identifies ways to improve work processes and improve customer satisfaction. Makes recommendations to manager, implements and monitors changes as requested.
  • Maintains a clean and safe work area. Follows established laboratory safety procedures in accordance with those regulatory bodies such as OSHA, FDA, EPA, etc. Observes and practices Universal Precautions when handling biohazardous material. Assumes a proactive role in laboratory safety and participates in development of safety protocols in surgical pathology. Performs minor spill cleanup per SOP when necessary.
  • Participates in cost containment initiatives. Responsible for efficient use of supplies and reagents and proper operation of instrumentation.
  • Provides backup assistance in a variety of activities in support of basic laboratory operations.
  • Records all documentation consistently and legibly. May create Standard Operating Procedures. Maintains manuals and electronic records for easy retrieval of data as necessary. Investigates, escalates, and documents any discrepancies or unresolved issues appropriately.
  • Fosters department and laboratory teamwork through effective communication. Adapts to change and handles stressful situations effectively
  • Takes initiative for personal development by attending teleconferences, educational sessions, and required meetings, etc.

Required:

  • Master of Science
  • Pathologists’ Assistant’s degree
  • Pathologists’ Assistant Certification (ASCP) or eligible for certification or Illinois licensed MD/DO with current or completed enrollment in anatomical pathology

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Brightsmith are pleased to be partnering with an advanced fuel cell technology company looking to build a product that is manufacturable, cost-effective, reliable, and scalable. You will directly impact system stability, fault handling, and readiness for scale in a real, deployed energy product. This position is based in Pittsburgh.


Responsibilities Required: Embedded Engineer

  • Design and maintain embedded firmware and control systems
  • Own system behavior (state machines, control logic, configuration)
  • Improve reliability by identifying failure modes and edge cases
  • Support field and production issues
  • Lead next-gen control architecture (fault handling, scalability)
  • Build automated testing and validation infrastructure
  • Drive systems from prototype → production → scale


Mindset

Ownership-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. You challenge weak designs, move quickly, and prioritise systems that work in the field.


Experience Required: Embedded Engineer

  • 3+ years in embedded firmware and control systems
  • Strong programming skills in:C / C++, Python, MATLAB / Simulink
  • Experience with: State machine design and control logic, Firmware validation and repeatable system behavior
  • Debugging across hardware/software boundaries
  • Familiarity with: CAN networks (e.G., SAE J1939), Vector tools (CANalyzer, CANoe), Linux-based development environments
  • Ownership-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. You challenge weak designs, move quickly, and prioritise systems that work in the field.

title: Spec-Driven Software Developer
description:
We are looking for a Software Developer to become the first engineer at RedTrack hired specifically for a spec-driven, AI-first development model.

This is a new approach for us. Rather than focusing primarily on writing code, the role puts strong emphasis on turning requirements into precise technical specifications, identifying ambiguity and hidden assumptions before implementation, and defining how the solution should behave under real-world conditions.

As the first developer joining RedTrack in this model, you will also help us learn, refine, and establish how spec-driven, AI-assisted engineering should work in practice.

Tasks

  • Turn product and technical requirements into clear, implementation-ready specifications.

The person in this position will be deployed as a Innovation Chief Engineer for a large business area within L3Harris, responsible for the technical strategy and technical execution of ongoing customer funded efforts. This includes all phases of technology development from mission and technology roadmapping, planning and execution of internal R&D, identifying and assisting with capture of external R&D, through technology insertion and implementation. The Innovation Chief Engineer will also be responsible for identifying broader functional needs for insertion and successful implementation of new technologies (process improvements, identification of capital needs, etc.).

**Essential Functions:**

- Application of knowledge of national, civil, and commercial space imaging missions to develop sensors, payloads, and space vehicles.
- Provide leadership on optical, electrical, and mechanical assemblies, and drive consistency within technology roadmaps and architectures in area of focus
- Drive innovation in technical competencies like segmented optical systems, composite optics, smart payloads, and on-board processing.
- Works with business development and business area leads to create and maintain technology roadmaps
- Develop and determine an execution plan for R&D projects consistent with the technology roadmaps, in alignment with XIS business strategy
- Identifies IR&D, CR&D, and process improvement efforts in alignment with technology roadmaps to create technology differentiators
- Provide mentorship to develop lower-level engineering staff into future SMEs
- Responsible for technical leadership and management of current R&D projects
- Identify areas of common technology needs across the division by working with other Innovation CEs within SSID
- Interface with Universities and Industrial partners for collaboration on development
- Identify emerging technologies

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or similar technical field or equivalent and a minimum of 12 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 10 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 16 years of prior related experience.
- 3+ years of functional management experience, leading a large team >50 resources across multiple disciplines
- Professional experience working with EO/IR space payloads
- Active TS/SCI security clearance required

**Preferr****ed Additional Skills:**

- Strong multi-disciplinary technical breadth in Space and Optical Systems
- Understanding of precision optical component and subsystem requirements generation, manufacturing, and testing
- Ability to quickly understand missions, customer sets, drive strategy
- Experience in technical issue resolution, ability to ensure root cause is identified
- Experience with NDAs, Master Research Agreements, & other partnership agreements consistent with co-development projects
- Experience with development of detailed R&D plans and execution strategies
- Experience with or understanding of earned value metrics
- Experience successfully executing multi-site development efforts
- Able to present results and communicate with customers and senior management

description:
Join our Austin lab team to operate and maintain sophisticated test fixtures for a world-renowned technology company. As a Senior Test Automation Engineer specializing in Hardware and Robotics, you'll deploy hardware test systems, execute daily testing protocols, and troubleshoot complex electrical and mechanical components while working with cutting-edge consumer electronics used by billions globally.

At EPAM, you'll work on cutting-edge technologies, solve complex challenges, and shape the future of digital innovation. With access to continuous learning, mentorship, and global projects, your expertise will drive meaningful change.

Req.#1027450004

title: Kommerciel Direktør (CCO)
description:
Vil du være med til at forme den næste fase af GS1 Denmarks udvikling?

GS1 Denmark spiller en central rolle i dansk erhvervsliv. Gennem globale standarder, fælles identifikation og datainfrastruktur gør organisationen det muligt for virksomheder, myndigheder og institutioner at udveksle information, skabe sporbarhed, dokumentere produkter og samarbejde effektivt på tværs af værdikæder.

Med mere end 15.000 medlemsvirksomheder, 35 medarbejdere og en stærk position i markedet står GS1 Denmark samtidig foran en ambitiøs udviklingsrejse. Nye regulatoriske krav, øgede forventninger til transparens, AI's voksende behov for strukturerede data og den digitale transformation af værdikæder skaber et stigende behov for præcis de kompetencer og løsninger, som GS1 repræsenterer.

Organisationen arbejder derfor målrettet på at styrke sin relevans over for medlemmerne, udvide sin position i eksisterende markeder og skabe nye vækstmuligheder gennem data, standarder, sporbarhed og digitale services.

Til at stå i spidsen for denne udvikling søger vi nu en Kommerciel Direktør, som kan omsætte strategiske muligheder til konkret markedsværdi og være med til at definere, hvordan GS1 Denmark skal skabe vækst, relevans og gennemslagskraft i de kommende år.

Rollen

Som Kommerciel Direktør bliver du medlem af direktionen og en tæt sparringspartner for CEO. Du får det overordnede ansvar for den kommercielle agenda og bliver organisationens vigtigste bindeled mellem markedets behov og GS1’s samlede portefølje af standarder, services, partnerskaber og løsninger.

Rollen rækker langt ud over klassisk salgsledelse. Du får ansvar for at styrke organisationens markedsposition, udvikle nye vækstområder, skabe strategiske partnerskaber og sikre, at GS1 fortsat er relevant i en verden, hvor data, dokumentation og tillid bliver stadig vigtigere konkurrenceparametre.

Du bliver den tydeligste eksterne repræsentant for GS1 Denmark og forventes at kunne navigere naturligt blandt topledere, beslutningstagere, brancheorganisationer, myndigheder og strategiske samarbejdspartnere. Samtidig får du en central rolle i at omsætte komplekse standarder og tekniske løsninger til konkret medlemsværdi og forretningsmæssig relevans.

Der er direkte ledelsesansvar for marketing- og public relations-funktionerne samt det samlede customer engagement-setup med i alt 6-8 medarbejdere, herunder nye stillinger, som skal etableres og udvikles. Rollen har samtidig en betydelig indirekte indflydelse på resten af organisationens prioriteringer, mindset og arbejdsformer og en del af GS1 ledelse.

Du bliver derfor ikke alene ansvarlig for den kommercielle udvikling, men også en vigtig drivkraft i den fortsatte transformation af GS1 Denmark mod en endnu mere markedsorienteret og udviklingsdrevet organisation.

Stillingen er placeret på hovedkontoret Vesterbrogade 149 ved Carlsberg Byen, hvor 30 af organisationens 35 medarbejdere er samlet.

Ansvarsområder

Dine væsentligste ansvarsområder omfatter blandt andet:

  • Udvikling og implementering af den samlede kommercielle strategi
  • Udvikling og eksekvering af go-to-market-strategier på tværs af eksisterende og nye sektorer
  • Styrkelse af relationerne til medlemmer,partnere og øvrige interessenter
  • Identifikation og udvikling af strategiske partnerskaber og markedsøkosystemer
  • Ansvar for marketing-, kommunikations- og public relations-indsatsen
  • Forretningsudvikling i krydsfeltet mellem standarder, services, regulering og markedsbehov
  • Udvikling af organisationens customer engagement-tilgang og medlemsværdi
  • Aktiv deltagelse i direktionens arbejde med strategi, vækst og organisationsudvikling

Hvem er du?

Du er en erfaren kommerciel leder med dokumenterede resultater inden for salg, forretningsudvikling og markedsudvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du i dag sidder som Kommerciel Direktør, Salgsdirektør, Business Director eller i en tilsvarende rolle med bredt kommercielt ansvar. Du har sandsynligvis opbygget et stærkt netværk og en solid troværdighed i markedet, og du er vant til at skabe resultater gennem relationer, partnerskaber og langsigtet forretningsudvikling.

Vi forventer desuden, at du har:

  • Erfaring med salg og forretningsudvikling i komplekse politiske og kommercielle miljøer
  • Dokumenterede resultater inden for kommerciel udvikling og go-to-market
  • Erfaring med udvikling af partnerskaber og økosystemer
  • Stærk strategisk og forretningsmæssig forståelse
  • Gerne erfaring med marketing, kommunikation og/eller public relations
  • Erfaring fra komplekse B2B-miljøer, hvor flere interessenter skal samles omkring fælles løsninger

Som person formår du at skabe følgeskab omkring en retning. Du er relations stærk, tillidsvækkende og kommunikativt stærk, men samtidig ambitiøs på organisationens vegne. Du trives i et miljø, hvor formål og forretning går hånd i hånd, og hvor resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, indflydelse og langsigtet værdiskabelse.

Derfor er rollen interessant

Denne rolle tilbyder en sjælden kombination af strategisk indflydelse, samfundsmæssig relevans og kommercielt mandat.

Du får mulighed for at sætte et markant personligt aftryk på en organisation, som spiller en vigtig rolle i dansk erhvervslivs digitale infrastruktur, og som står midt i en transformation med betydelige vækstambitioner.

Samtidig bliver du en central aktør i nogle af de dagsordener, som kommer til at præge virksomheder de kommende år. Det gælder blandt andet sporbarhed, digitalisering af værdikæder, bæredygtighedsdata, AI, Digital Product Passport, compliance og fremtidens dataudveksling på tværs af virksomheder og sektorer.

Rollen giver en usædvanlig bred berøringsflade på tværs af industri, detailhandel, sundhedssektor, teknologi, myndigheder og brancheorganisationer. Du får adgang til stærke nationale og internationale netværk, høj ekstern synlighed og mulighed for at påvirke både organisationens retning og de markeder, den opererer i.

For den rette kandidat er dette en mulighed for at kombinere purpose og forretning i en rolle, hvor man både kan skabe konkrete resultater her og nu og samtidig være med til at forme de standarder og løsninger, som virksomheder og samfund vil bygge videre på i mange år frem.

Ansøg nu eller kontakt os hvis du har spørgsmål til rollen

I denne rekruttering samarbejder GS1 med Hudson Nordic. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Partner hos Hudson Nordic, Søren Bentsen på mail sbe@hudsonnordic.com.

Læs mere om GS1**: https://www.gs1.org/home**

title: Pit Technician
description:
The Pit Technician is responsible for inspecting and lubricating cars in a quick, yet thorough manner for customers in a professional and efficient manner. This position will adhere to and promote the Company mission while operating within the confines of the Company’s core values and contributing to the success of their functional team.

Primary Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Complete work accurately and quickly allowing customers to remain in their vehicles
  • Perform multi-point inspection
  • Advise service consultant/tech for any additional work needed
  • Service grease fittings, universal joints and steering knuckles, using hand or compressed air powered grease gun
  • Inspect fluid levels of rear differential and rear axle housings
  • Inspect vehicles for additional repairs needed
  • Demonstrate behaviors consistent with the company’s vision, mission, and core values in all interaction with customers, co-workers, managers, and suppliers
  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and safety standards
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work area

We are looking for:

  • Knowledge in automotive repair and maintenance desired but not required
  • Ability to read and comprehend written instructions and information
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Ability to pass a pre-employment drug test and background screen
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills
  • Customer-focused attitude with ability to work well in a team environment
  • Willingness to work Saturdays and/or Sundays

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

  • Prolonged periods of standing, stooping, and bending
  • At time, exerting 50 - 100 lbs of force occasionally and/or 10 - 25 lbs of force frequently and/or greater than 10 lbs of force constantly to move objects
  • Requires working at a production rate pace entailing the constant pushing and/or pulling of materials

title: Senior DevOps/Platform Engineer
description:
Part-Time Contract | Remote | Approximately 20 Hours per Week

About the Role

A mission-critical SaaS platform used by approximately 800 flooring businesses to manage leads, estimates, product selection, inventory, scheduling, installations, invoicing, and paymentsis being modernized from a legacy .NET/ASP, SQL Server, stored-procedure-heavy environment to React, Node.js, TypeScript, native PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and AWS. Much of the initial conversion has been completed using AI-assisted development. The immediate priority is to clean up, test, validate, and safely release the converted system while existing customers remain active.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps/Platform Engineer who can strengthen the delivery platform, observability, security, and production safeguards required for frequent, low-risk releases.

Responsibilities

  • Assess the current AWS infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, environments, deployment process, and production risks.
  • Improve automated build, test, security-scanning, deployment, and rollback workflows.
  • Support small, frequent releases through feature flags, staged rollouts, health checks, and automated validation.
  • Establish safe coexistence between legacy and modern services during the migration.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code for repeatable, auditable environment provisioning.
  • Strengthen monitoring, centralized logging, distributed tracing, alerting, dashboards, and incident-response procedures.
  • Define service-level indicators for availability, latency, error rates, database health, queues, and critical business workflows.
  • Help diagnose performance and stability issues involving AWS, Node.js services, APIs, PostgreSQL, Babelfish, and legacy .NET components.
  • Support the transition from Babelfish and SQL Server-oriented behavior to native PostgreSQL.
  • Review capacity, connection-pool, timeout, retry, queue, and load-shedding configurations.
  • Improve resilience for asynchronous and event-driven workloads using services such as Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, Redis, and dead-letter queues.
  • Implement secure secrets management, access controls, audit logging, vulnerability management, backup, and recovery procedures.
  • Verify that rollback remains safe after application or database writes, including backward-compatible schema changes.
  • Review AI-generated infrastructure and deployment changes for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational risk.
  • Document deployment standards, incident procedures, environment configuration, and operational ownership.
  • Partner closely with engineering and product teams, with meaningful overlap during US working hours.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 7 years of professional DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure experience .
  • Strong hands-on experience operating production workloads in AWS.
  • Proven ownership of CI/CD architecture, automated deployments, monitoring, incident response, and rollback.
  • Experience supporting production systems built with Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, and .NET.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Infrastructure as code
    • Networking, DNS, load balancing, and API gateways
    • Containers and serverless workloads
    • Logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and production dashboards
    • Secrets management and least-privilege access
    • Backups, disaster recovery, and production readiness
    • Database migrations and backward-compatible schema changes
    • Connection pooling, capacity planning, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery
  • Experience introducing staged deployments, feature flags, canary releases, or blue-green deployments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot across application, infrastructure, network, and database layers.
  • Experience working on incremental modernization where legacy and modern systems must run in parallel.
  • Strong written and spoken English with the ability to communicate risk and recommendations clearly.
  • Ability to work independently and deliver senior-level ownership within a part-time schedule.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, Redis, CloudWatch, and container-based AWS services.
  • Experience migrating SQL Server workloads to PostgreSQL, particularly through Babelfish.
  • Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling.
  • Experience operating workflow-heavy SaaS involving inventory, scheduling, invoicing, payments, or other production-critical transactions.
  • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, and structured logging.
  • Experience reviewing infrastructure or deployment code generated through Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar AI tools.
  • Experience improving engineering platforms for teams releasing daily or near-daily.

What Success Looks Like

During the initial engagement, this person will:

  • Produce a clear assessment of the current infrastructure, deployment risks, and release blockers.
  • Establish reliable CI/CD and environment-management standards.
  • Improve monitoring across the core quote-to-invoice workflow.
  • Make deployments smaller, repeatable, observable, and safely reversible.
  • Strengthen production readiness for the AI-converted React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL platform.
  • Reduce instability associated with Babelfish, database connections, asynchronous workloads, and legacy-modern coexistence.
  • Create practical operational documentation the engineering team can maintain after the engagement.

Engagement Details

  • Remote, part-time contract
  • Approximately 20 hours per week
  • Regular overlap with the US-based team required
  • Initial focus on release readiness and platform stabilization, followed by modernization, scalability, and support for AI-enabled product capabilities

title: Engineering Operations Lead
description:
Engineering Operations Lead

Location: Huntsville, AL
Employment Type: Full-Time
Position Level: Principal / Engineer IV
Security Clearance: Active DoD Secret Clearance Required
Work Arrangement: Customer Site; Telework Permitted
Travel: Required



Position Overview

Created Solutions is seeking an experienced Engineering Operations Lead to support the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) Targets and Countermeasures Program Directorate (DTT) within the Chief Engineer / Targets Systems Engineering Division (DTTE) under the TEAMS Next MDS Engineering program.



In this role, you will serve as the central operational integrator and technical synchronization point for Targets Systems Engineering. You will manage high-tempo executive engineering activities, oversee tasker operations through government systems such as the Enhanced Tasking Management System 2 (ETMS2), coordinate major lifecycle and governance documentation, and facilitate communication across directorates, prime contractors, and partner organizations.



The ideal candidate brings extensive experience supporting DoD engineering organizations, exceptional organizational and communication skills, and the ability to coordinate complex technical and programmatic activities in a fast-paced environment.



Key Responsibilities

Executive Engineering Coordination & Operational Briefings

  • Manage the end-to-end coordination of weekly Targets Systems Engineering (DTTE) staff meetings, including presentation inputs, technical briefings, logistics, and leadership pre-brief packages.
  • Coordinate and submit executive engineering updates to the MDA Directorate for Engineering (DE), including requirements baselines, schedule changes, and technical accomplishments.
  • Consolidate Directorate-wide programmatic and technical status briefings for DTT leadership.
  • Track and coordinate 30/60/90-day Engineering Technical Reviews (ETRs) across target programs, including milestone reporting and delivery of executive summaries.

Tasker & Workflow Management

  • Serve as the primary DTTE Action Officer within ETMS2, managing the distribution, tracking, and timely closure of Congressional, Office of the Secretary of Defense (OSD), and internal agency taskers.
  • Process classified and unclassified tasking across SIPRNet and NIPRNet environments while maintaining strict compliance with security and operational requirements.
  • Coordinate industry media engagement requests and MDA public release packages with Acquisition, Legal, and Strategic Communications teams.
  • Prepare Staff Summary Sheets (SSS) and facilitate formal review and approval processes.
  • Lead annual historical summary collection efforts and coordinate Federally Funded Research and Development Center (FFRDC) data calls and technical conference nominations.

Systems Engineering Governance & Documentation

  • Lead operational coordination of the annual Targets Cost Analysis Requirements Description (CARD) update supporting the President's Budget submission to Congress.
  • Coordinate inputs from Logistics, Acquisition, Contracts, Software, Cyber, and IMTP Manifest teams.
  • Consolidate classified and unclassified documentation, adjudicate comments using Form 100 matrices, and manage executive review and approval.
  • Coordinate biennial Programmatic Environment, Safety, and Occupational Health Evaluation (PESHE) updates.
  • Oversee review cycles, administrative accuracy, comment adjudication, formal routing, and publication of program baseline documentation and standard operating procedures.
  • Maintain configuration-controlled engineering documentation and baseline archives across agency SharePoint, DoD365, and SIPR environments.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Active DoD Secret security clearance, with the ability to maintain clearance and access classified environments, including SIPRNet.
  • Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific discipline.
  • Minimum of 12 years of related professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing executive engineering operations, technical meeting coordination, and briefing preparation for senior military and civilian leadership.
  • Experience tracking, reviewing, and adjudicating technical comments using formal processes, including DoD Form 100 comment matrices or equivalent systems.
  • Familiarity with DoD acquisition lifecycle documentation, including CARD, Systems Engineering Plans (SEP), Risk Management Plans (RMP), PESHE, and Test and Evaluation Master Plans (TEMP).
  • Strong experience preparing and routing executive correspondence, Staff Summary Sheets, and official action packages.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Working knowledge of ETMS2 or comparable DoD tasking and correspondence management systems.
  • Excellent organizational, written communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and demanding deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Technical Management, or a related STEM discipline.
  • Experience supporting DoD or federal program offices in a Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA), Advisory & Assistance Services (A&AS), or Systems Engineering & Integration (SE&I) capacity.
  • Direct experience supporting the Missile Defense Agency, particularly the Targets and Countermeasures Directorate (DTT) or Engineering Directorate (DE).
  • Familiarity with DoW/MDA workflows and organizational processes.
  • Experience coordinating technical activities across multiple organizations, including U.S. Army DEVCOM (S3I), prime contractors, national laboratories, and FFRDCs.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, establish priorities, coordinate deadlines, and resolve competing technical and programmatic demands.

Culture & Values

At Created Solutions, our motto, “Consider it done,” is more than a slogan—it reflects our commitment to innovation, excellence, and integrity. We seek team members who:

  • Thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Bring a problem-solving mindset and a strong work ethic.
  • Value collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Are committed to making a positive impact—both in their work and in their community.

Our company believes that all people are created equal for a purpose. We hold ourselves accountable to high standards in our work and in our mission to support our community through Created Outreach, our 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.



About Created Solutions

Founded in 2024 in Huntsville, AL, Created Solutions is a fast-growing small business delivering advanced engineering solutions to the DoD and NASA. We provide expert government support services in flight vehicle design, electrical and mechanical systems, material science, manufacturing, and hypersonic technologies—helping solve some of the nation's most complex and critical defense challenges.



Join us and be part of a team where purpose and excellence come together.

title: Senior QA Engineer (AI) | 12 month FTC
description:

Your best at Rest means focusing on what matters, being trusted to get on with it, and knowing your work genuinely makes a difference. That’s how we operate every day, guided by our values: Be Daring, Keep It Simple, Take Action and Have Grit.

Join us as a Senior QA Engineer (AI) on a 12 month FTC, where you’ll shape quality assurance for AI-powered solutions, strengthening automation, reducing risk and delivering reliable experiences for our members This is your opportunity to make a real contribution to the financial wellbeing of millions of Australians.

Responsible for identifying defects early, improving product performance, and ensuring that the final deliverables meet business and user requirements, thereby reducing risks and enhancing customer satisfaction.

  • Build business-flow API automated tests across services to validate end-to-end system behaviour, including parity checks between modernised and legacy functionality.
  • Automate end-to-end user journeys through the Angular UI WebApp using Playwright, with API-first test setup and role-based access control (RBAC) permutations.
  • Contribute to and evolve the Playwright and TypeScript automation framework, including the shared locator library, extensible Page Object Model, reusable fixtures and parallel execution.
  • Plan for opportunities to develop and maintain automated test scripts to improve efficiency and repeatability of testing processes, where applicable.
  • Effectively manage test data, review and refine test scenarios, and ensure the seamless execution of testing processes to meet quality standards using tools like Jira / Zephyr
  • Create & Update Test Reporting Dashboards, providing insights into test coverage, defect status, and overall quality metrics to stakeholders with industry standard Quality Matrices.
  • Identify, document, and track defects using Jira, working closely with developers & vendors to ensure timely resolution and conduct defect triages with the wider delivery team members as required.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, business analysts, and project managers, to align testing activities with project goals and timelines.
  • Tertiary qualifications in technology.
  • Formal QA certification/s relevant to the role.

Required experience, understanding or credentials including:

  • Proven experience as a Senior Test Analyst.
  • Experienced in strong coding capability in Python, SQL or similar languages, together with experience in version control, testing and automation.
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, intelligent agents and other LLM-based services.
  • Experience carrying out Test Planning, stakeholder management.
  • Knowledge of testing principles, methods, tools and technologies, including plans, scenarios, strategies and related procedures
  • Experience designing and developing Test Plans and Test Cases with minimal Requirements and Design documents.
  • Working knowledge of test automation frameworks and its implementation
  • Ability to work autonomously and act as the point of contact on projects where required.
  • Industry experience within Superannuation is preferred.

  • Learning and development opportunities, including AI & Data Academy, leadership programs, LinkedIn Learning, study assistance and professional memberships

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
CapTech’s Customer Experience (CX) team seeks a Sr. Product Designer with a track record of designing sophisticated digital brand experiences that are intuitive, impactful, and accessible.

As a Sr. Product Designer, you help influence user behavior and enhance brand-to-customer relationships by guiding the delivery of elegant and engaging digital products and services. You will partner with project managers, user researchers, other product designers, content strategists, and developers to bring end-to-end digital experiences to life.

Although most of your work will be hands-on and client-delivery focused, you may also mentor and coach more junior talent. Your management and leadership skills will help nurture client relationship and account growth, as well as inspire future design leaders and expand our practice.

This could be the position for you if:

  • You have a proven understanding of product strategy, heuristic analysis, information architecture, user research, user interface design, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing.

  • You are a strategic thinker who can translate business goals and user needs into thoughtful design solutions.

  • You bring exceptional creative insight and drive, delivering projects from research through implementation in partnership with multi-discipline teams and the client.

  • You seek the best ideas, regardless of source, and deliver persuasive client presentations with confidence, but as a servant leader, you check your ego at the door.

  • You are comfortable with enterprise-scale challenges, inspiring and motivating teams of researchers and designers to produce engaging, multi-channel digital solutions.

  • You excel as a leader, consistently driving client growth and delivering high-quality results independently in a fast-paced environment, without the need for oversight.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Leading the creation of personas, customer journey maps, wireframes, responsive visual designs, and interactive prototypes that follow interaction design and usability best practices.

  • Managing the project team to nurture junior creatives, develop their talents, and elevate the overall quality of the client deliverables.

  • Presenting design concepts and rationale to clients and internal teams in a clear and compelling manner.

  • Producing clean, informative, and concise presentations to clients and internal teams that communicate the rationale behind your designs

  • Giving insightful and constructive feedback on the design of the experience, including interactions, information architecture, content, layout, and overall alignment with goals and brand.

  • Performing competitive assessments and providing innovative alternatives, as well as researching and understanding design and technology trends.

  • Contributing to the evolution of CX methodologies, capabilities, approaches, and toolset. Attending and leading CX meetings and trainings. Engaging in professional development and industry involvement.

  • Strong knowledge of user interface design best practices across various platforms, including web, OS-native, and embedded apps. Advocating the benefits of accessible experience and visual design with clients and team members.

  • Exploring and leveraging AI-powered design tools and workflows, staying current with emerging technologies, and experimenting with new approaches to enhance creativity, efficiency, and impact

  • 8+ years of professional experience, ideally in a design consultancy or digital agency

  • 4-year degree in design, HCI, or similar preferred

  • Demonstrated ability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, while successfully delivering against scope and budget.

  • Experience with multiple domains of human-centered design including user and market research, product and experience strategy, information architecture, experience design, content strategy, and customer insight.

  • Proven written, verbal, conceptual, and visual communication skills

  • Proficiency in designing developer-ready visual assets and UI components in Figma is required, with preference given to candidates who demonstrate expertise in organizing files for clarity, applying consistent styles and naming conventions, and utilizing advanced features such as auto layout, component libraries, variables, and design tokens to support scalable and efficient design handoff.

  • Experience using AI-powered prototyping tools—such as Claude Code, Claude for Design, Lovable, UX Pilot, Figma Make, or similar—to create production-minded prototypes that support effective developer handoff.

  • Proficiency with Powerpoint, Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign is a plus.

  • Familiarity with user research tools (e.g., Optimal Workshop, User Testing, SurveyMonkey) is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of Agile product development lifecycles and practices is a plus

  • Familiarity with WCAG 2.2 Accessibility standards and Inclusive Design principals is a plus

We want everyone at CapTech to be able to envision a lasting and rewarding career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions. You decide where and how you want to develop, and we help get you there with customizable career progression and a comprehensive benefits package to support you along the way. Alongside our suite of traditional benefits encompassing generous PTO, health coverage, disability insurance, paid family leave and more, we’ve launched extended benefits to help meet our employees’ needs.

  • CapTech is committed to providing a flexible work environment and helping our employees achieve a work-life balance that suits their individual needs. Employees must be available to work onsite in a client location or a CapTech office as requested. We allow CapTech employees to work remotely when compatible with CapTech and client needs.

  • 401(k) Matching – Generous matching and no vesting period to help you continue to build financial wellness

title: [8GS] Senior Agentic Engineering Consultant

  • Design, code, test, and maintain skill files, tool definitions, prompts, schemas, personas, repository instructions, and reusable components for the agentic harness across product, development, architecture, and quality workflows.

Deliver production-quality applications, APIs, services, and automation using C#/.NET, Angular, Azure SQL, Python or TypeScript, Azure, Git, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD.
  • Use an advanced agent-based coding tool for autonomous and multi-step delivery, multi-file and cross-repository changes, modernization, refactoring, test-and-fix loops, code review, and documentation. GitHub Copilot experience is strongly preferred.
  • Implement quality, security, and governance controls including automated tests, protected-branch approvals, least privilege, secrets management, traceability, prompt-injection defenses, and safe tool execution.
  • Instrument agent runs and delivery outcomes for quality, reliability, cycle time, rework, cost, tool use, and human intervention.
  • Work directly with the Sr. Director to convert priorities into an executable backlog, apply a solution-oriented mindset to ambiguous engineering challenges, demonstrate progress, document standards, and transfer knowledge to the current enginerring team.

Preferred Experience
• Claude Code experience, especially for terminal-based autonomous engineering, cross-repository work, and tool-driven development workflows.
• Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure API Management, Azure Functions, Application Insights, Key Vault, Service Bus, or Cosmos DB.

title: Full-Stack Developer (.NET)
description:
Full-Stack Developers at CapTech are part of a capable, highly-motivated community who strive to continuously learn the latest tools and architectures to deliver innovative solutions for our clients. We design, develop, and deliver high-quality enterprise systems, as well as systems integrations and work in a project-based consulting environment.

CapTech developers enjoy a collaborative environment and have many opportunities to learn from and share knowledge with other developers, architects, and our clients. Our solutions include API-driven clients, microservice architectures, event-driven integrations, cloud deployments, serverless applications, and web and portal front ends.

Specific responsibilities for the Full-Stack Developer position include:

  • Leverage CapTech’s internal programs and self-directed training to continually develop industry relevant knowledge and skills

Qualifications

  • Strong background in database design and development, including SQL Server and NoSQL.

  • Proficient with modern development tools, including Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code

  • Solid understanding of application performance tuning, scalability, and optimization techniques
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, designs, and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

title: Project Manager
description:
Are you a current Austin Health employee?

If yes, please log in to the Austin Health careers website via ‘Employee Login' using your network login details to search, view and apply for all career opportunities available.

  • 12 months, fixed term
  • Part time (0.8EFT), with flexibile working hours
  • Convenient Heidelberg location

Austin Health is the major provider of tertiary health services, health professional education and research across three campuses in the north-east of Melbourne and statewide. We have a highly engaged, diverse and collaborative workforce that is unified by our goal to help people live healthy and fulfilled lives.

About the Continuing Care department

Austin Health's Continuing Care Service comprises the following Divisional specialties and services, which are provided within a range of care settings including inpatient, outpatient and community -based locales across Austin Health's three key campuses:

  • Health Independence Programs
  • Community Aged Care Services
  • Admitted Aged Care services
  • Rehabilitation
  • Acquired Brain Injury Unit
  • Spinal Cord Rehabilitation Service
  • Residential In-Reach Services
  • Medical & Cognitive Research Unit
  • Better@Home Acute and Subacute

About the role

The Continuing Care Project Manager is responsible for providing expert improvement advisory services across the Continuing Care department, to support and drive measurable and sustainable improvements in patient access, experience and outcomes.

They are responsible for delivering this by building divisional capability through delivery of training and education in improvement science, engagement of staff through the Improvement Network, advice and coaching to staff members leading improvement work, and direct leadership of priority divisional improvement initiatives.

About you

You will be someone who has excellent communication skills and strong commitment to improvement and project work resulting in excellent patient outcomes.

To be successful in this role you'll bring with you:

  • Track record leading complex, improvement and transformation initiatives, delivering measurable clinical, operational and financial outcomes
  • Ability to analyse complex datasets, quantify opportunities, model impact, and track benefits realisation to inform decision-making and drive performance improvement
  • Understanding of healthcare service delivery, performance drivers, and operating models within large, complex health systems
  • Capability in applying improvement methodologies (e.g. Improvement Science, Lean) at scale to achieve sustained change
  • Experience in engaging staff and embedding sustainable improvement capability through coaching, training and structured programs
  • Strong project management skills, with capability in setting direction, prioritising work, navigating ambiguity, managing risks, and driving delivery against agreed timelines and performance targets

Our benefits

Working at Austin Health means enjoying a strong sense of purpose, engaging in meaningful work every day. Our people also receive a variety of rewarding benefits, including:

  • Greater take-home pay through generous salary packaging, for living expenses, meals, and holiday accommodation.
  • A suite of wellness initiatives designed to support you, including discounted fitness memberships and special offers on health insurance, and a comprehensive wellbeing program.
  • Onsite childcare at Austin Hospital, easy access via public transport and car parking options.
  • Mentoring and career development opportunities.

Work with us!

We are committed to cultural safety and health equity for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander People. We celebrate, value, and include people of all backgrounds, genders, identities, cultures, bodies, and abilities. We welcome and support applications from talented people identifying as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, people with disability, neurodiverse people, LGBTQIA+ and people of all ages and cultures.

If you feel this role is right for you, we encourage your early application. Even if you don't meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. What matters most is your passion, your drive and your willingness to learn and contribute. Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and interviews may take place prior to the closing date. This means we reserve the right to close a job ad prior to the advertised closing date.

All appointments are made subject to a satisfactory National Police Check and if required, a Working with Children Check. Austin Health is a child safe organisation, committed to upholding the rights, safety, and wellbeing of children and young people in line with Child Safe Standards. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process, you are welcome to reach out to the hiring manager: Karan Sharma, Divisional Director Continuing Care at Karan.SHARMA@austin.org.au
